English: Comprehensive COVID-19 health and safety protocols for school reopening including mandatory masks and temperature monitoring
Kiswahili: Itifaki kamili za afya na usalama za COVID-19 kwa ajili ya kufungua shule ikiwa ni pamoja na barakoa za lazima na ufuatiliaji wa halijoto
Dholuo: Chenro mag thieth: Chenro mag thieth kod ritruok kuom COVID-19 ma oriwo tiyo gi maske kod ng'iyo chal mar liet e kinde ma skul chako tiyo kendo
Somali: Barnaamijyada caafimaadka iyo amniga ee COVID-19 ee dhamaystiran ee dib u furitaanka dugsiyada oo ay ku jiraan maaskaro qasab ah iyo kormeerka heerkulka

English: Digital learning platform providing free educational content during COVID-19 pandemic for remote learning continuity
Kiswahili: Jukwaa la kujifunza kidijitali linalotoa maudhui ya kielimu bila malipo wakati wa janga la COVID-19 kwa ajili ya mwendelezo wa kujifunza kwa mbali
Dholuo: Kenya Education Cloud: Ohinga mar somo mar dijitol ma chiwo weche mag somo maonge chudo e kinde mag tuo mar COVID-19 mondo ji opuonjre mabor
Somali: Barashada dhijitaalka ah ee bixisa waxyaabaha waxbarasho ee bilaashka ah inta lagu jiro masiibada COVID-19 si loo sii wado barashada fog

English: KUCCPS portal will open in March 2025 for university placement and course selection for 2024 KCSE candidates
Kiswahili: Lango la KUCCPS litafunguliwa Machi 2025 kwa nafasi za chuo kikuu na uteuzi wa kozi kwa watahiniwa wa KCSE wa 2024
Dholuo: KUCCPS Portal: KUCCPS portal biro yawore e dwe mar Mach higa mar 2025 mar keto ji e yunivasiti kod yiero jopuonjre mag KCSE e higa mar 2024
Somali: Gudaha KUCCPS waxaa la furi doonaa bishii Maarso ee sannadka 2025 si loo helo booska jaamacadaha iyo xulashada koorsooyinka loogu talagalay musharixiinta 2024 ee KCSE

English: Target to increase school feeding beneficiaries from 1.9 million to over 10 million children by 2030
Kiswahili: Lengo ni kuongeza wanufaika wa chakula shuleni kutoka milioni 1.9 hadi zaidi ya watoto milioni 10 ifikapo mwaka 2030
Dholuo: Medo kwan mar pidho nyithindo e skunde: Dwaro mar medruok mar joma yudo kony mar chiemo e skunde kowuok e nyithindo milion 1.9 nyaka nyithindo mokalo milion 10 e higa mar 2030
Somali: Ujeedada ah in la kordhiyo dadka ka faa'iideysta quudinta dugsiga laga bilaabo 1.9 milyan ilaa in ka badan 10 milyan oo caruur ah marka la gaaro sanadka 2030

English: Launch of inclusive education programs with assistive technology for learners with disabilities
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa programu za elimu jumuishi zenye teknolojia saidizi kwa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu
Dholuo: Somo mar Dwaro Manyien: Chako chenro mag somo ma oriwo ji duto gi teknoloji makonyo jopuonjre ma nigi ng'ol
Somali: Bilaabista barnaamijyo waxbarasho oo dhanka ah oo leh tiknoolajiyad caawiya ardayda naafada ah

English: Advertisement for 46,000 teaching positions across primary, junior secondary, and secondary schools with application deadline October 7, 2024
Kiswahili: Tangazo la nafasi 46,000 za kufundisha katika shule za msingi, sekondari za chini, na sekondari huku tarehe ya mwisho ya kutuma maombi ikiwa Oktoba 7, 2024
Dholuo: TSC Recruitment: Lando mar tije mag puonjo maromo ji 46,000 e skunde mag praimari, junia sekondari, kod sekondari ka tarik mogik mar kwayo en Oktoba 7, 2024
Somali: Xayeysiis loogu talagalay 46,000 oo jago oo macalimiin ah oo ku yaal dugsiyada hoose, hoose, iyo sare oo leh waqtiga ugu dambeeya ee codsiga Oktoobar 7, 2024

English: 1,500 new special needs units built – transfer your child before Jan 6!
Kiswahili: Vitengo vipya 1,500 vya mahitaji maalum vilivyojengwa. Hamishia mtoto wako kabla ya Januari 6!
Dholuo: Ne oger udi 1,500 manyien mag joma nigi dwaro makende. lok nyathini kapok Januar 6 ochopo!
Somali: 1,500 oo qaybood oo cusub oo loogu talagalay baahiyaha gaarka ah ayaa la dhisay si aad ilmahaaga ugu wareejiso 6-da Janaayo ka hor!

English: 100% transition policy: Every child must be in school January 6 – no excuses!
Kiswahili: Sera ya mpito 100%: Kila mtoto lazima awe shuleni Januari 6 hakuna visingizio!
Dholuo: Chenro mar lokruok mar 100%: Nyithindo duto nyaka bed e skul Januar 6 onge weche ma digiloko!
Somali: Siyaasadda gudbinta 100%: caruur kastaa waa inay iskuulka tagaan 6-da Janaayo.

English: 100% transition policy: No child to repeat Class 8 from 2025.
Kiswahili: Sera ya mpito 100%: Hakuna mtoto kurudia Darasa la 8 kuanzia 2025.
Dholuo: Chenro mar lokruok mar 100%: Onge nyathi mabiro nwoyo somo mar klas 8 chakre higa mar 2025.
Somali: Siyaasadda gudbinta 100%: Ilmaha aan dib u dhicin fasalka 8 laga bilaabo 2025.

English: 100% transition: Every Grade 6 must report to JSS – no staying home!
Kiswahili: Mpito 100%: Kila Darasa la 6 lazima aripoti kwa JSS "hakuna kukaa nyumbani!"
Dholuo: Lokruok mar 100%: Ng'ato ka ng'ato manie klas mar auchiel nyaka dhi e ofis mar JSS.
Somali: 100% gudbinta: fasalka 6aad oo dhan waa inuu u sheegaa JSS in uusan guriga joogin!

English: 15,000 full secondary scholarships for arid counties – apply before Nov 30 via county office!
Kiswahili: Ufadhili kamili wa masomo 15,000 wa sekondari kwa kaunti kame ...
Dholuo: 15,000 mar basaris mag sekondari ma opong'o ne counties ma onge pi, kwa kapok Novemba 30 ochopo kokalo kuom ofis mar county!
Somali: 15,000 oo deeq waxbarasho oo dhameystiran oo loogu talagalay degmooyinka qalalan ayaa la dalban karaa 30-ka Nofeembar iyada oo loo marayo xafiiska degmada!

English: 2,000 new mental health counselors deployed to secondary schools – book today!
Kiswahili: Washauri wapya 2,000 wa afya ya akili waliotumwa katika shule za upili "weka nafasi leo!"
Dholuo: Jochiw-parogo manyien 2,000 ma ne oor e skunde sekondar, ondikgi kawuono!
Somali: 2,000 oo lataliye cusub oo caafimaadka dhimirka ah ayaa maanta loo adeegsaday dugsiyada sare.

English: 2,014 permanent and pensionable posts for secondary school teachers.
Kiswahili: Nafasi 2,014 za kudumu na za kustaafu kwa walimu wa shule za upili.
Dholuo: 2,014 ma nyaka chieng' kendo ma nyalo yudo pension ne jopuonj mag skul sekondar.
Somali: 2,014 shaqooyin joogto ah iyo hawlgabka ah oo loogu talagalay macalimiinta dugsiga sare.

English: 200 Stipendium Hungaricum scholarships open for Kenyan undergraduate students.
Kiswahili: Ufadhili wa masomo 200 wa Stipendium Hungaricum umefunguliwa kwa wanafunzi wa shahada ya kwanza wa Kenya.
Dholuo: Scholarships 200 mag Stipendium Hungaricum oseyawore ne jopuonjre mag Kenya.
Somali: 200 Stipendium Hungaricum deeq waxbarasho oo u furan ardayda dugsiga hoose ee Kenya.

English: 3,000 new special needs teachers deployed – your child gets support from Jan!
Kiswahili: Walimu wapya 3,000 wenye mahitaji maalum waliotumwa "mtoto wako anapata usaidizi kutoka Jan!
Dholuo: Jopuonj manyien 3,000 ma nigi dwaro makende ne oket e skul. Nyathni yudo kony kowuok kuom Jan!
Somali: 3,000 oo macallimiin cusub oo baahiyo gaar ah leh ayaa loo adeegsaday. Ilmahaagu wuxuu ka helayaa taageero Jan!

English: 500 schools get free counseling rooms – book session with your principal!
Kiswahili: Shule 500 zinapata vyumba vya ushauri nasaha bila malipo na kuweka miadi na mkuu wa shule!
Dholuo: Skunde 500 yudo ute mag konyruok maonge chudo. Dhi ir japuonj maduong' mondo okonyi!
Somali: 500 dugsi ayaa helaya qolal la talin oo lacag la'aan ah, kalfadhiga buugaagta ee macalinkaaga!

English: Access education! Enroll pastoralist children in mobile schools.
Kiswahili: Pata elimu! Waandikishe watoto wafugaji katika shule zinazohamishika.
Dholuo: Bed gi thuolo mar puonjruok! Ket nyithindo ma jokwath obed e skunde mag wuoth.
Somali: Waxbarashada helitaanka! Carruurta adhijirka ah ku qor dugsiyada dhaqdhaqaaqa.

English: Access EduTV via Kenya Education Cloud daily.
Kiswahili: Fikia EduTV kupitia Kenya Education Cloud kila siku.
Dholuo: Yud EduTV kokalo kuom Kenya Education Cloud pile.
Somali: Helitaanka EduTV iyada oo loo marayo Kenya Education Cloud maalin kasta.

English: Access EduTV via Kenya Education Cloud.
Kiswahili: Fikia EduTV kupitia Wingu la Elimu la Kenya.
Dholuo: Yud EduTV kokalo kuom Kenya Education Cloud.
Somali: Helitaanka EduTV adoo adeegsanaya Kenya Education Cloud.

English: Access free resources! Distribute free textbooks to rural schools.
Kiswahili: Pata rasilimali za bure! Sambaza vitabu vya kiada vya bure kwa shule za vijijini.
Dholuo: Yudo gik ma itiyogo ma nono! Pogi buge mag somo ma nono ne skul mag gwenge.
Somali: Helitaanka kheyraadka bilaashka ah! Buugaag waxbarasho oo bilaash ah u qaybi dugsiyada miyiga.

English: Access KPSEA results from December 1 via school portal.
Kiswahili: Pata matokeo ya KPSEA kuanzia Desemba 1 kupitia lango la shule.
Dholuo: Inyalo yudo duoko mag KPSEA chakre Desemba 1 kokalo kuom portal mar skul.
Somali: Helitaanka natiijooyinka KPSEA laga bilaabo 1da Diseembar iyada oo loo marayo bogga dugsiga.

English: Access KPSEA results via school portal from December 1, 2025.
Kiswahili: Fikia matokeo ya KPSEA kupitia lango la shule kuanzia Desemba 1, 2025.
Dholuo: Yudo duoko mag KPSEA kokalo kuom mbui mar skul chakre tarik 1 dwe mar apar gi ariyo higa mar 2025.
Somali: Helitaanka natiijooyinka KPSEA iyada oo loo marayo bogga dugsiga laga bilaabo Diseembar 1, 2025.

English: Access results from Dec 1 via portal.
Kiswahili: Fikia matokeo kuanzia Desemba 1 kupitia lango.
Dholuo: Yudo duoko chakre tarik 1 dwe mar apar gi ariyo kokalo kuom mbui.
Somali: Natiijada helitaanka laga bilaabo 1-da Diseembar iyada oo loo marayo bogga.

English: Access results via school portal from December 1.
Kiswahili: Pata matokeo kupitia lango la shule kuanzia Desemba 1.
Dholuo: Yudo duoko kokalo kuom mbui mar skul chakre tarik 1 dwe mar apar gi ariyo.
Somali: Natiijooyinka helitaanka bogga dugsiga laga bilaabo 1-da Diseembar.

English: Accessible legal text for learners and public
Kiswahili: Maandishi ya kisheria yanayopatikana kwa urahisi kwa wanafunzi na umma
Dholuo: Ndiko mag chik manyalo yudore ne jopuonjre kod oganda
Somali: Qoraalka sharciga ah ee loo heli karo ardayda iyo dadweynaha

English: Act now! Communities, prevent FGM to protect girls.
Kiswahili: Chukua hatua sasa! Jamii, zuia ukeketaji ili kuwalinda wasichana.
Dholuo: Kaw okang' sani! jodak duto, geng'uru nyang'e mar joma nyiri mondo uritgi.
Somali: Bulshooyinka, ka hortagga FGM si aad u ilaaliso gabdhaha.

English: Adult education centers reopen January 13 – register free at any public primary school.
Kiswahili: Vituo vya elimu ya watu wazima vitafunguliwa tena Januari 13 jiandikishe bure katika shule yoyote ya msingi ya umma.
Dholuo: Skunde mag joma dongo chako tiyo kendo Januar 13. Inyalo donjo maonge chudo e skul moro amora mar piny mar praimari.
Somali: Xarumaha waxbarashada dadka waaweyn ayaa dib u furmaya 13-ka Janaayo si bilaash ah loogu diiwaangeliyo dugsiyada hoose ee dowladda.

English: Adult literacy classes resume Jan 13 – register free at chief's office now!
Kiswahili: Madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima yataanza tena Januari 13 jiandikishe bure katika ofisi ya mkuu wa shule sasa!
Dholuo: Puonjruok ndiko gi ndiko mar joma dongo dhi nyime Januar 13 donj e ofis maduong' maonge chudo!
Somali: Fasalka akhriska dadka waaweyn wuxuu bilaabmayaa 13-ka Janaayo. Isdiiwaangelinta waa lacag la'aan xafiiska madaxa hadda!

English: All belong! Enroll refugee children in schools today.
Kiswahili: Wote ni wa lazima! Waandikishe watoto wakimbizi shuleni leo.
Dholuo: Giduto gin magwa! Ndik nyithindo moringo thuchegi e skundegi kawuono.
Somali: Dhammaantood waa kuwo iska leh, caruurta qaxootiga ah maanta iskuulada ku qor.

English: All boarding schools must conduct safety audit by September 30, 2025.
Kiswahili: Shule zote za bweni lazima zifanye ukaguzi wa usalama ifikapo Septemba 30, 2025.
Dholuo: Skunde duto ma nigi kar nindo nyaka tim nonro mar ritruok kapok Septemba 30, 2025.
Somali: Dhammaan iskuulada joogtada ah waa inay sameeyaan tijaabooyinka badbaadada 30-ka Sebtember 2025.

English: All boarding schools must install fire alarms + sprinklers by Jan 6 – CS orders!
Kiswahili: Shule zote za bweni lazima ziweke kengele za moto + vinyunyizio ifikapo Januari 6 - maagizo ya CS!
Dholuo: Skunde duto ma nigi boarding nyaka ti gi gik makwedo mach kod gik ma thiro pi kapok ochopo tarik 6 Januar kaluwore gi chike mag CS!
Somali: Dhammaan dugsiyada xanaanada ah waa in ay rakibtaan digniino dab-damis ah + waraabiyeyaal marka la gaaro 6-da Janaayo amarka CS!

English: All can learn! Use braille and ramps for disabled students.
Kiswahili: Wote wanaweza kujifunza! Tumia braille na ramps kwa wanafunzi walemavu.
Dholuo: Ji duto nyalo puonjore! Ti gi Braille kod kuonde ma nyithindo nyalo kaloe.
Somali: Dhammaantood way baran karaan! Isticmaal qoraalka Braille-ka iyo roogaha loogu talagalay ardayda naafada ah.

English: All dormitories must have emergency exits – inspection starts Dec 1!
Kiswahili: Bwenzi wote lazima wawe na njia za dharura za kutokea - ukaguzi unaanza Desemba 1!
Dholuo: Od nindo duto nyaka bed gi dhoudi mag geng'o masira chakre Desemba 1!
Somali: Dhammaan qolka hoyga waa in ay leeyihiin albaabada degdegga ah. Kormeerka wuxuu bilaabmayaa 1-da Diseembar!

English: All Form 3 students must register as voters this week – no excuses!
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wote wa kidato cha 3 lazima wajiandikishe kama wapiga kura wiki hii - hakuna visingizio!
Dholuo: Jopuonjre duto mag Form 3 nyaka ndik nyingegi e list mar joma biro yiero e juma ma kawuononi onge ng'at ma biro ng'wononegi!
Somali: Dhamaan ardayda fasalka 3aad waa in ay isdiiwaangaliyaan sida codbixiyayaasha todobaadkan.

English: All Form Four students must register as voters before leaving school – IEBC directive.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wote wa kidato cha nne lazima wajiandikishe kama wapiga kura kabla ya kuondoka shuleni - maagizo ya IEBC.
Dholuo: Jopuonjre duto mag klas ang'wen nyaka ndik nyinggi e list mar joma biro yiero kapok giwuok e skul kaluwore gi chik mar IEBC.
Somali: Dhammaan ardayda fasalka afraad waa in ay iska diiwaangeliyaan codbixiyayaasha ka hor inta aysan ka bixin dugsiga.

English: All Grade 6 learners automatically placed in junior secondary – no exam needed.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wote wa Darasa la 6 huwekwa kiotomatiki katika shule ya upili ya junior "hakuna mtihani unaohitajika."
Dholuo: Jopuonjre duto mag klas mar auchiel ne iketo e sekondari mar sekondari maonge penj madwarore.
Somali: Dhamaan ardayda fasalka 6aad waxaa si toos ah loogu dhigaa dugsiga dhexe ee hoose iyada oo aan loo baahnayn imtixaan.

English: All public university students to get free data bundles for e-learning – Safaricom partners.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wote wa vyuo vikuu vya umma watapata vifurushi vya data bila malipo kwa ajili ya kujifunza mtandaoni "Washirika wa Safaricom."
Dholuo: Jopuonjre duto mag yunivasiti mag sirkal mondo oyud data maonge chudo mar e-puonjruok ma jo Safaricom timo.
Somali: Dhammaan ardayda jaamacadaha dadweynaha si ay u helaan xogta lacag la'aanta ah ee loogu talagalay barashada elektaroonigga ah waa wada-hawlgalayaasha Safaricom.

English: All refugee children in Kenya to join public schools from January – no fees.
Kiswahili: Watoto wote wakimbizi nchini Kenya watajiunga na shule za umma kuanzia Januari "hakuna ada."
Dholuo: Nyithindo duto moringo thuchegi e Kenya mondo odonj e skunde mag sirkal chakre Januar maonge chudo.
Somali: Dhamaan caruurta qaxootiga ah ee Kenya si ay u galaan dugsiyada dadweynaha laga bilaabo Janaayo waa lacag la'aan.

English: All registered candidates must appear in the attendance register.
Kiswahili: Watahiniwa wote waliosajiliwa lazima waonekane kwenye rejista ya mahudhurio.
Dholuo: Jogo duto mosedonjo e skundno nyaka ndik nyingegi e kalatas manyiso kwan mar joma osedhi e skundno.
Somali: Dhamaan musharixiinta diiwaangashan waa inay ka muuqdaan diiwaanka ka qaybgalka.

English: All schools get Ksh 10M for ICT upgrade – principal must apply by Nov 30!
Kiswahili: Shule zote zitapokea Ksh 10M kwa ajili ya kuboresha ICT "Mkuu wa shule lazima aombe ifikapo Novemba 30!
Dholuo: Skunde duto yudo Ksh 10M mar medo lony e yore mag ICT.
Somali: Dhamaan dugsiyada hela Ksh 10M ee kor u qaadista ICT waa in ay codsadaan 30 November!

English: All schools get Ksh 15M for library upgrade – apply before Dec 15!
Kiswahili: Shule zote zinapata Ksh 15M kwa ajili ya uboreshaji wa maktaba ... Shule zote zinaweka CCTV + kuajiri walinzi ifikapo Desemba 31 – Maagizo ya Wizara au kufungwa kwa uso!
Dholuo: Skunde duto yudo Ksh 15M mar medo kuonde somo e laibrari, timuru kamano kapok Desemba 15 ochopo!
Somali: Dugsiyada oo dhami waxay helayaan Ksh 15M si ay u cusbooneysiiyaan maktabadda. Codso ka hor 15-ka Diseembar!

English: All schools get Ksh 2M digital lab grant – principal must apply by Friday.
Kiswahili: Shule zote zapata ruzuku ya maabara ya kidijitali ya Ksh 2M – mkuu wa shule lazima aombe ifikapo Ijumaa.
Dholuo: Skunde duto biro yudo Ksh 2M mar kony mar lab dijitol.
Somali: Dhammaan dugsiyada helitaanka deeqaha Ksh 2M digital lab waa in ay codsadaan ilaa Jimcaha.

English: All schools get Ksh 5M for perimeter wall + gate – works start Jan!
Kiswahili: Shule zote zapata Ksh 5M kwa ajili ya ukuta wa mzunguko + lango – kazi zinaanza Januari!
Dholuo: Skunde duto yudo Ksh 5M mar gero ohinga kod rangach chakre Jan!
Somali: Dugsiyada oo dhami waxay helayaan Ksh 5M darbiga xuduudda + iridda. Shaqooyinka ayaa bilaabanaya Jan!

English: All schools get Ksh 5M for science lab upgrade – apply before Dec 5!
Kiswahili: Shule zote zapata Ksh 5M kwa ajili ya uboreshaji wa maabara ya sayansi – tuma maombi kabla ya Desemba 5!
Dholuo: Skunde duto yudo Ksh 5M mar medo lony mar lab mar sayans. Tiuru kapok Desemba 5!
Somali: Dugsiyada oo dhami waxay helayaan Ksh 5M si ay u cusbooneysiiyaan shaybaarka sayniska waxay codsan karaan ka hor 5-ta Diseembar!

English: All schools install CCTV + hire guards by Dec 31 – Ministry directive or face closure!
Kiswahili: Shule zote zaweka CCTV + kuajiri walinzi ifikapo Desemba 31 – Maagizo ya Wizara au tutalazimika kufungwa!
Dholuo: Skunde duto onego oket kamera mag CCTV + kendo gikaw jorit e kind Desemba 31 kaluwore gi chik mar Migawo mar somo, ka ok kamano to ibiro loro skundegi!
Somali: Dugsiyada oo dhami waxay rakibayaan CCTV + waxay shaqaaleysiiyaan ilaalada 31-ka Diseembar marka laga reebo tilmaamaha Wasaaradda ama waa la xiraa!

English: All schools must conduct fire drill before Dec 20 – no excuses!
Kiswahili: Shule zote lazima zifanye mazoezi ya kuzima moto kabla ya Desemba 20 "hakuna visingizio!" Hakuna visingizio!
Dholuo: Skunde duto nyaka tim ikruok ne masira mar mach kapok Desemba 20 ochopo.
Somali: Dugsiyada oo dhan waa inay qabtaan tababarka dab-damiska ka hor 20-ka Diseembar.

English: All schools must have functional GBV reporting desk – inspection starts Dec 1!
Kiswahili: Shule zote lazima ziwe na dawati linalofanya kazi la kuripoti GBV "ukaguzi unaanza Desemba 1!
Dholuo: Skunde duto nyaka bed gi kuonde ma ji nyalo ndikoe weche mag timbe gero mag nindruok chakre Desemba 1!
Somali: Dugsiyada oo dhan waa in ay lahaadaan xafiis shaqo oo warbixinta GBV ah. Kormeerka wuxuu bilaabmayaa 1-da Diseembar!

English: All schools must screen for TB before reopening – free testing starts Monday!
Kiswahili: Shule zote lazima zichunguzwe kwa TB kabla ya kufungua tena "upimaji wa bure" unaanza Jumatatu!
Dholuo: Skunde duto nyaka tim nonro mar TB kapok ochak timo nonro maonge chudo chakre Tich Ariyo!
Somali: Dugsiyada oo dhan waa in ay baaritaan ku sameeyaan cudurka TB ka hor inta aysan dib u furmin baaritaanka bilaashka ah wuxuu bilaabmayaa Isniinta!

English: All teachers get free medical cover upgrade – NHIF to full package Jan 1!
Kiswahili: Walimu wote wanapata uboreshaji wa bima ya matibabu bila malipo "NHIF" hadi kifurushi kamili Januari 1!
Dholuo: Jopuonje duto yudo thieth maonge chudo NHIF biro medore e paket duto Jan 1!
Somali: Macalimiinta oo dhan waxay helayaan lacag la'aan kor u qaadista caymiska caafimaad ee NHIF ilaa xirmada buuxda Janaayo 1!

English: All TTC students must complete civic education module before graduation – KICD directive.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wote wa TTC lazima wamalize moduli ya elimu ya uraia kabla ya kuhitimu "agizo la KICD".
Dholuo: Jopuonjre duto mag TTC nyaka tiek somo mar somo mar dak mar oganda kapok gi tieko tiegruok.
Somali: Dhamaan ardayda TTC waa inay dhammeeyaan koorsada waxbarashada rayidka ah ka hor inta aysan qalinjabin tilmaamaha KICD.

English: All TVET graduates guaranteed 6-month paid internship from January 2026.
Kiswahili: Wahitimu wote wa TVET wamehakikishiwa mafunzo ya muda ya miezi 6 yanayolipiwa kuanzia Januari 2026.
Dholuo: Jopuonjre duto ma osetieko tiegruok e weche mag tiegruok kod tiegruok e yore mag teknoloji biro yudo chudo mar dweche auchiel mar internship kochakore Januar 2026.
Somali: Dhammaan shahaadada ka qalin jabisay TVET waxay dammaanad qaadeen 6-bilood oo shahaadooyin mushahar leh laga bilaabo Janaayo 2026.

English: All TVET students get Ksh 10,000 monthly stipend + free laptop from Jan!
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wote wa TVET wanapata posho ya Ksh 10,000 ya kila mwezi + kompyuta mpakato bila malipo kuanzia Januari!
Dholuo: Jopuonjre duto mag TVET yudo Ksh 10,000 dwe ka dwe + laptop ma onge chudo koa kuom Jan!

English: Free bus passes for all TVET students reporting in January – collect from principal.

English: Free counseling for exam stress – call 0800721524 or visit school counselor!

English: Free digital library with 50,000 books launched – no login needed!

English: Free Google Workspace for all Kenyan teachers – claim your account today!
Kiswahili: Sehemu ya Kazi ya Google ya Bure kwa walimu wote wa Kenya – dai akaunti yako leo!

English: Free national digital library launched – 100,000 books, no login required!

English: Free revision materials uploaded for KCPE and KCSE candidates.
Kiswahili: Nyenzo za bure za marekebisho zimepakiwa kwa watahiniwa wa KCPE na KCSE.

English: Free revision timetable + notes for all subjects – download from education.go.ke NOW!
Kiswahili: Ratiba ya bure ya marekebisho + maelezo kwa masomo yote – pakua kutoka education.go.ke SASA!

English: Free sanitary towels + underwear for 2 million girls – collect from class teacher!

Kiswahili: Kozi za bure za TVET katika AI, roboti na uandishi wa msimbo – Nafasi 5,000 zimefunguliwa kote nchini.

Kiswahili: Programu ya kulisha bila malipo ya Darasa la 7 inaanza Januari – Milo 3 kila siku imehakikishwa!

English: Grade 7 reporting January 13: Bring only birth certificate – no shopping list allowed.

Somali: Qeybta 7aad ee warbixinta Janaayo 13: Keliya keena shahaadada dhalashada. Liiska wax iibsiga looma oggola.

Kiswahili: Kuza ujuzi! Panga shule na maabara ya mafunzo ya kilimo.

English: Heal together! Access school counselors after protests.
Kiswahili: Ponyeni pamoja! Wafikieni washauri wa shule baada ya maandamano.

Kiswahili: Wasaidieni wanafunzi! Lipa ada ili kusaidia shughuli za shule.
Dholuo: Konyuru jopuonjre! Chulo osuru mondo gikony tij skul.
Somali: Ka caawi ardayda! Bixi lacag si aad u taageerto hawlaha dugsiga.

English: Honor academic excellence 2025.
Kiswahili: Heshimu ubora wa kitaaluma 2025.
Dholuo: Nyis luor ne somo mamalo mar 2025.
Somali: Si loo sharfo heerka aqooneed ee 2025.

English: Honor community educators 2025.
Kiswahili: Heshimu waelimishaji wa jamii 2025.
Dholuo: Nyis luor ne joma puonjo e gweng'no e higa mar 2025.
Somali: Macallimiinta bulshada ee lagu sharfo 2025.

English: Honor innovators 2025.
Kiswahili: Heshimu wavumbuzi 2025.
Dholuo: Miuru duong' jo manyien e higa mar 2025.
Somali: Maamulitaanka hal-abuurnimada sanadka 2025.

English: Honor outstanding teachers 2025.
Kiswahili: Heshimu walimu bora 2025.
Dholuo: Miuru luor jopuonj madongo 2025.
Somali: Macallimiinta cajiibka ah ee 2025.

English: IEBC launches digital voter education app – download now on Google Play.
Kiswahili: IEBC yazindua programu ya elimu ya wapiga kura kidijitali "pakua sasa" kwenye Google Play.
Dholuo: IEBC chako tiyo gi app mar somo ne joma oyiero e yor digital ma inyalo download sani e Google Play.
Somali: IEBC waxay bilaabaysaa barnaamijka waxbarashada codbixiyayaasha digital ah ee hadda laga soo dejisan karo Google Play.

English: IEBC to issue 1 million voter cards in schools next week – be ready!
Kiswahili: IEBC itatoa kadi za wapiga kura milioni 1 shuleni wiki ijayo "kuwa tayari!
Dholuo: IEBC biro golo kad mar yiero mar milion achiel e skunde juma mabiro beduru moikore!
Somali: IEBC waxay soo saari doontaa 1 milyan oo kaararka codbixiyaha ee iskuulada todobaadka soo socda.

English: IEBC to issue 500,000 voter cards in schools next week – be ready with ID!
Kiswahili: IEBC itatoa kadi za wapiga kura 500,000 shuleni wiki ijayo "kuwa tayari na kitambulisho!
Dholuo: IEBC biro golo kad 500,000 mag yiero e skunde juma mabiro ikreuru gi kad mar ID!
Somali: IEBC waxay toddobaadka soo socda u soo saari doontaa 500,000 kaararka codbixiyaha dugsiyada si ay u diyaar garoobaan aqoonsiga!

English: IEBC to visit 1,000 secondary schools for mass voter registration this month.
Kiswahili: IEBC kutembelea shule za upili 1,000 kwa ajili ya uandikishaji wa wapiga kura wengi mwezi huu.
Dholuo: IEBC biro limo skunde 1,000 mag sekondar mondo ondik joma biro yiero e dwe maeni.
Somali: IEBC waxay booqan doontaa 1,000 oo dugsi sare oo loogu talagalay diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha ballaaran bishaan.

English: IEBC to visit 2,000 schools next week – ensure all Form 4 have voter cards.
Kiswahili: IEBC itatembelea shule 2,000 wiki ijayo ili kuhakikisha wanafunzi wote wa kidato cha 4 wana kadi za wapiga kura.
Dholuo: IEBC biro limo skunde 2,000 juma mabiro mondo one ni Form 4 duto nigi kad mag yiero.
Somali: IEBC waxay booqan doontaa 2,000 oo dugsi toddobaadka soo socda si loo hubiyo in dhammaan Form 4 ay leeyihiin kaararka codbixiyeyaasha.

English: IEBC voter registration in every school Nov 20–30 – bring ID or birth cert!
Kiswahili: Usajili wa wapiga kura wa IEBC katika kila shule Novemba 20, 2020, 3 ... Ofisi ya mkuu SASA!
Dholuo: IEBC ndiko ji e ombulu e skunde duto Nov 2030 kel ID kata satifiket mar nyuol!
Somali: Diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha IEBC ee iskuulada oo dhan 20 Noofembar 30 saacadood ka dib waxaad keentaa shahaadada aqoonsiga ama shahaadada dhalashada!

English: IEBC voter registration starts Monday – bring ID to your school or chief's office NOW!
Kiswahili: Usajili wa wapiga kura wa IEBC unaanza Jumatatu. Lete kitambulisho shuleni kwako au ofisini kwa mkuu wa shule SASA!
Dholuo: IEBC chako ndiko ji e ombulu chieng' Tich Ariyo. Kel kad mar injili e skul kata e ofis mar jatend skul KINDEGI!
Somali: Diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha ee IEBC waxay bilaabmaysaa Isniinta. U keen aqoonsiga dugsigaaga ama xafiiska madaxaaga HADDII!

English: Implement policies! Schools, prevent gender-based violence.
Kiswahili: Tekeleza sera! Shule, zuia ukatili wa kijinsia.
Dholuo: Tiuru gi yore mag konyruok! Skunde, geng'o timbe gero mag nindruok.
Somali: Iskuulada, ka hortagga rabshadaha jinsiga.

English: Implement protocols! Schools, address unrest safely.
Kiswahili: Tekeleza itifaki! Shule, shughulikia machafuko kwa usalama.
Dholuo: Tiuru gi chenro moketi! Skunde, kawuru okang' mar tieko ywaruok e yor ritruok.
Somali: Dugsiyada, si nabadgelyo leh ula dhaqma rabshadaha.

English: Include all! Provide laptops for rural students.
Kiswahili: Jumuisha yote! Toa kompyuta mpakato kwa wanafunzi wa vijijini.
Dholuo: Winjuru ji duto! Chiw kompyuta mag lwedo ne jopuonjre modak e gwenge.
Somali: Dhammaantood ku dar, ardayda reer miyiga ah u siiya laptops.

English: Include all! Provide ramps and resources for disabled students.
Kiswahili: Jumuisha yote! Toa njia na rasilimali kwa wanafunzi walemavu.
Dholuo: Winjuru ji duto! Chiw kuonde mag wuoth kod gige konyo jopuonjre ma nigi midekre.
Somali: Dhammaantood ka qaybqaada, ardayda naafada ah u siiya xarumo iyo kheyraad.

English: Include deaf students! Provide sign language training.
Kiswahili: Jumuisha wanafunzi viziwi! Toa mafunzo ya lugha ya ishara.
Dholuo: Wuo gi nyithindo ma rodin bende! Tieggi tiyo gi dho ranyisi.
Somali: Ardayda dhegaha la'aanta ah ka qaybqaada!

English: Include everyone! Ensure schools accommodate students with disabilities.
Kiswahili: Jumuisha kila mtu! Hakikisha shule zinawapa nafasi wanafunzi wenye ulemavu.
Dholuo: Ji duto mondo oriwre! Neno ni skunde rwako jopuonjre ma nigi midekre.
Somali: Isku day in dugsiyada ay la kulmaan ardayda naafada ah.

English: Inclusion of learners with disabilities in CBC assessment framework.
Kiswahili: Kujumuishwa kwa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu katika mfumo wa tathmini ya CBC.
Dholuo: Tiyo gi jopuonjre ma nigi midekre e nonro mar CBC.
Somali: Ka mid noqoshada ardayda naafada ah ee ku jira qaab-dhismeedka qiimeynta CBC.

English: Inclusive CBC exams: Braille & sign language papers ready – collect from KNEC!
Kiswahili: Mitihani ya CBC jumuishi: Karatasi za Braille na lugha ya ishara tayari "kukusanywa kutoka KNEC!
Dholuo: Nonro mag CBC: Barupe mag Braille kod dhok mar ranyisi oikore mar kawo e KNEC!
Somali: Imtixaannada CBC oo ay ku jiraan: Imtixaannada Braille & Afka Calaamadaha ayaa diyaar u ah in laga soo qaado KNEC!

English: Inclusive education now law – every public school must admit disabled learners!
Kiswahili: Elimu jumuishi sasa sheria "kila shule ya umma lazima iwapokee wanafunzi wenye ulemavu!" Sera ya elimu jumuishi ilizinduliwa "kila shule lazima iwaandikishe wanafunzi wenye ulemavu!"
Dholuo: Somo mar ji duto koro en chik, skunde duto mag sirkal nyaka yien jopuonjre ma nigi midekre mondo odonj e skundego!
Somali: Waxbarashada ka kooban hadda waa sharci. Dugsi kasta oo dawladeed waa inuu aqbalaa ardayga naafada ah!

English: Inclusive education policy launched – every school must admit disabled learners!
Kiswahili: Sera ya elimu jumuishi yazinduliwa "kila shule lazima iwaandikishe wanafunzi wenye ulemavu!"
Dholuo: Chenro mar somo ma oriwo ji duto osechako skul ka skul nyaka yie rwako jopuonjre ma nigi midekre!
Somali: Siyaasadda waxbarashada oo dhanka ka mid ah ayaa la bilaabay. Dugsi kasta waa inuu aqbalaa ardayga naafada ah!

English: Inclusive sports day mandatory in all schools Dec 10 – every child must participate!
Kiswahili: Siku ya michezo jumuishi lazima katika shule zote Desemba 10 "kila mtoto lazima ashiriki!"
Dholuo: Odiechieng' mar tuke moriwo ji duto en gima ochuno e skunde duto Desemba 10 nyathi ka nyathi nyaka riwre!
Somali: Xilliga isboortiga oo dhan waxaa lagu qasbaa dhammaan dugsiyada 10-ka Diseembar. Ilmaha oo dhami waa inay ka qeyb galaan!

English: Inspect dorms! Ensure fire safety compliance in schools.
Kiswahili: Kagua mabweni! Hakikisha unazingatia usalama wa moto shuleni.
Dholuo: Nonuru kuonde ma ji nindoe! Neno ni nitie ritruok e yore mag geng'o mach e skunde.
Somali: Hubi badbaadada dabka ee dugsiyada.

English: Inspect school buses 2020.
Kiswahili: Kagua mabasi ya shule 2020.
Dholuo: Nonuru mtokni mag skul 2020.
Somali: Kormeerka basaska dugsiga 2020.

English: Install CCTV in schools 2020.
Kiswahili: Sakinisha CCTV shuleni 2020.

English: Install solar power in remote schools 2020.
Kiswahili: Sakinisha umeme wa jua katika shule za mbali 2020.
Dholuo: Ket teko mar chieng' e skunde man kuonde maboyo e higa 2020.
Somali: Ku rakib tamarta qoraxda dugsiyada fog 2020.

English: Integrate AI education 2024.
Kiswahili: Unganisha elimu ya akili bandia (AI) 2024.
Dholuo: Ti gi rieko mar dhano e puonjo ji e higa mar 2024.
Somali: Isku dar waxbarashada AI 2024.

English: Integrate all! Support refugee students in local schools.
Kiswahili: Unganisha wote! Wasaidie wanafunzi wakimbizi katika shule za mitaa.
Dholuo: Winjuru ji duto! Kony jopuonjre moringo thuchegi e skunde manie alworagi.
Somali: Isku dar dhammaan! Taageero ardayda qaxootiga ah ee dugsiyada deegaanka.

English: Integrate digital literacy in curriculum 2025.
Kiswahili: Unganisha uandishi wa habari kidijitali katika mtaala wa 2025.
Dholuo: Ti kod somo mar digital e somo mar 2025.
Somali: Isku darka akhriska dhijitaalka ah ee manhajka 2025.

English: Integrate entrepreneurship 2023.
Kiswahili: Unganisha ujasiriamali 2023.
Dholuo: Riwruokwa mar bedo jolok ohala e higa mar 2023.
Somali: Isdhexgalka ganacsiga 2023.

English: Integrate music education 2022.
Kiswahili: Unganisha elimu ya muziki 2022.
Dholuo: Ti kod somo mar thum e higa 2022.
Somali: Isku dar waxbarashada muusikada sanadka 2022.

English: Integrate values education 2022.
Kiswahili: Unganisha thamani za elimu 2022.
Dholuo: Ti gi puonj kod chike mag ngima e higa mar 2022.
Somali: Isku-darka qiimaha waxbarashada 2022.

English: Intern teachers salary rises to Ksh 55,000 + medical cover from Jan!
Kiswahili: Mshahara wa walimu wa mafunzo ya ndani waongezeka hadi Ksh 55,000 + bima ya matibabu kuanzia Januari!
Dholuo: Chudo mag jopuonj ma oket e tich medore maromo Ksh 55,000 + thieth chakre Januar!
Somali: Mushaharka macalimiinta xirfadlayaasha ah ayaa kor u kacaya Ksh 55,000 + caymis caafimaad laga bilaabo Janaayo!

English: Intern teachers' salary jumps to Ksh 50,000 from January – TSC confirms!
Kiswahili: Mshahara wa walimu wa mafunzo ya ndani waongezeka hadi Ksh 50,000 kuanzia Januari TSC inathibitisha!
Dholuo: Pesa ma jopuonj ma interns yudo biro medore maromo Ksh 50,000 chakre Januar, TSC wacho kamano!
Somali: Macallimiinta shaqaalaysiinta ah ee shaqaalaysiinta ah waxay kor u qaadaan mushaharka Ksh 50,000 laga bilaabo Janaayo, sida ay xaqiijisay TSC!

English: Itâ€TMs okay to talk! Reduce mental health stigma in schools.
Kiswahili: Ni sawa kuzungumza! Punguza unyanyapaa wa afya ya akili shuleni.

Somali: Waa wax fiican in la hadlo, yareynta cilmiga caafimaadka maskaxda ee dugsiyada.

English: Join community schools! Affordable education for low-income families.
Kiswahili: Jiunge na shule za jamii! Elimu ya bei nafuu kwa familia zenye kipato cha chini.
Dholuo: Donj e skunde mag jopiny! Somo ma nengone yot ne joot ma nigi pesa matin.
Somali: Ku biir dugsiyada bulshada! Waxbarasho la awoodi karo oo loogu talagalay qoysaska dakhligoodu hooseeyo.

English: Keep learning! Enroll in nomadic schools for pastoralists.
Kiswahili: Endelea kujifunza! Jiandikishe katika shule za kuhamahama kwa wafugaji.
Dholuo: Dhi nyime puonjori! Dhi e skunde mag jokwath ma jowuoth.
Somali: Isku qor dugsiyada dhaqdhaqaaqa ee loogu talagalay adhijirrada.

Kiswahili: Endelea kujifunza! Jiandikishe katika shule licha ya changamoto za ukame.
Dholuo: Dhi nyime puonjori! Dhiuru e skunde kata obedo ni nitie pek moko.
Somali: Waxbarashada sii wad! Iskuulka gal inkastoo ay jiraan caqabado abaar ah.

English: Keep schools open! Parents, pay fees promptly.
Kiswahili: Weka shule wazi! Wazazi, lipa ada haraka.
Dholuo: Weuru mondo skul osiki ka oyawore! Un jonyuol, chuluru nyithindo kaka dwarore.
Somali: Waalidiinta, si deg deg ah u bixiya khidmadaha.

English: KICD urges schools to embrace e-learning platforms to ensure continuity of learning during unforeseen emergencies.
Kiswahili: KICD inahimiza shule kukumbatia mifumo ya kujifunza mtandaoni ili kuhakikisha mwendelezo wa kujifunza wakati wa dharura zisizotarajiwa.
Dholuo: KICD jiwo skunde mondo oti gi yore mag e-puonjruok mondo omi gibed gi thuolo mar dhi nyime gi puonjruok e kinde mag chandruok.
Somali: KICD waxay ku boorineysaa dugsiyada inay qaataan barnaamijyada barashada elektaroonigga ah si loo hubiyo joogteynta barashada inta lagu jiro xaaladaha degdegga ah ee aan la filayn.

English: KNEC opens KCSE 2025 registration extension – pay late fee before Nov 30!
Kiswahili: KNEC yafungua nyongeza ya usajili wa KCSE 2025 – kulipa ada ya kuchelewa kabla ya Novemba 30!
Dholuo: KNEC oyawo KCSE 2025 kuom medo chudo mag duoko chien kapok Nov 30!

English: KNEC opens KCSE remarking window – pay Ksh 1,000 per paper before Nov 30!
Kiswahili: KNEC yafungua dirisha la kuashiria KCSE – lipa Ksh 1,000 kwa kila karatasi kabla ya Novemba 30!
Dholuo: KNEC oyawo thuolo mar KCSE mar chiwo paro ka ichulo Ksh 1,000 e kalatas ka kalatas kapok Nov 30!
Somali: KNEC waxay fureysaa daaqadda qoraalka KCSE-da si ay u bixiso Ksh 1,000 warqad kasta ka hor 30-ka Nofeembar!

English: KNEC releases KCSE 2025 chief examiner reports early – download before exams!
Kiswahili: KNEC yatoa ripoti za mtahini mkuu wa KCSE 2025 mapema – pakua kabla ya mitihani!
Dholuo: KNEC golo ripode mag KCSE 2025 mar jatend penj ma ibiro gol chon kapok penj ochakore!
Somali: KNEC waxay soo saartay warbixinnada imtixaanka ugu weyn ee KCSE 2025 si aad u soo dejiso ka hor imtixaanada!

English: KNEC releases KCSE 2025 marking scheme early – download before leak!
Kiswahili: KNEC yatoa mpango wa kusahihisha KCSE 2025 mapema – pakua kabla ya kuvuja!

Somali: KNEC waxay soo saartaa qorshaha calaamadeynta KCSE 2025 ka hor inta aan la daadin!

English: Ksh 22,244 capitation per day-scholar released – principals must NOT ask for extra money!

English: Ksh 30,000 HELB graduation loan released – apply via app in 2 minutes!
Kiswahili: Mkopo wa kuhitimu wa HELB wa Ksh 30,000 umetolewa – tuma maombi kupitia programu ndani ya dakika 2!

English: Ksh 50,000 HELB final-year loan released – check app before midnight!
Kiswahili: Mkopo wa mwaka wa mwisho wa HELB wa Ksh 50,000 umetolewa angalia programu kabla ya saa sita usiku!

Kiswahili: KUCCPS ilifungua lango lake kwa watahiniwa wa KCSE wa 2015 kutuma maombi ya kozi za stashahada na cheti cha TVET huku tarehe ya mwisho ikiwa Mei 31, 2016.

English: KUCCPS opened its portal for 2018 KCSE candidates and past candidates from 2000 to 2018 to apply for TVET courses closing April 30 2019.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS ilifungua lango lake kwa watahiniwa wa KCSE wa 2018 na wagombea wa zamani kuanzia 2000 hadi 2018 ili kutuma maombi ya kozi za TVET zinazofungwa Aprili 30, 2019.

English: KUCCPS opened its portal for 2023 KCSE candidates to apply for Teacher Training College diploma programs with a deadline of April 21 2024.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS ilifungua lango lake kwa watahiniwa wa KCSE wa 2023 kutuma maombi ya programu za diploma za Chuo cha Mafunzo ya Ualimu zenye tarehe ya mwisho ya Aprili 21, 2024.

Somali: KUCCPS waxay albaabkeeda u furtay 2023 musharixiinta KCSE si ay ugu dalbadaan barnaamijyada shahaadada Koleejka Tababarka Macallinka iyadoo waqtigeedu yahay 21 Abriil 2024.

English: KUCCPS opened its portal for 2024 KCSE candidates to apply for Teacher Training College diploma programs with a deadline of April 21 2025.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS ilifungua lango lake kwa watahiniwa wa KCSE wa 2024 kutuma maombi ya programu za diploma za Chuo cha Mafunzo ya Ualimu zenye tarehe ya mwisho ya Aprili 21, 2025.
Dholuo: KUCCPS ne oyawo kadne mar 2024 mar KCSE mondo gichiw kwayo mar dhi e tiegruok mar jopuonj e chenro mag diploma mag Koleji mar Tiego Jopuonj ka tarik mogik mar timo kamano en April 21 2025.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay boggeeda u furtay 2024 musharixiinta KCSE si ay ugu dalbadaan barnaamijyada shahaadada Koleejka Tababarka Macallinka iyadoo waqtigeedu yahay 21 Abriil 2025.

English: KUCCPS opens direct university entry for TVET graduates – apply before Dec 31!
Kiswahili: KUCCPS yafungua kiingilio cha moja kwa moja cha chuo kikuu kwa wahitimu wa TVET – kutuma maombi kabla ya Desemba 31!
Dholuo: KUCCPS oyawo thuolo mar donjo e yunivasiti achiel kachiel ne jogo ma osetieko tiegruok e yore mag TVET.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay fureysaa gelitaanka jaamacadaha tooska ah ee ardayda ka qalin jabisay TVET waxay dalban karaan ka hor 31-ka Diseembar!

English: KUCCPS opens emergency course change window – switch before midnight!
Kiswahili: KUCCPS yafungua dirisha la kubadilisha kozi ya dharura – badilisha kabla ya saa sita usiku!
Dholuo: KUCCPS oyawo dirise mag lokruok e kor yo kapok sa auchiel otieno ochopo!
Somali: KUCCPS waxay fureysaa daaqadda isbeddelka koorsada degdegga ah ka hor saqdii dhexe!

English: KUCCPS opens emergency university transfer window – move courses before Dec 10!
Kiswahili: KUCCPS yafungua dirisha la dharura la uhamisho wa vyuo vikuu – kozi za kuhama kabla ya Desemba 10!
Dholuo: KUCCPS oyawo thuolo mar dar dhi e yunivasiti mapiyo, dhi e tiegruok mag dhi e yunivasiti kapok Desemba 10 ochopo!
Somali: KUCCPS waxay furaysaa daaqadda xaaladaha degdegga ah ee wareejinta jaamacadaha si ay u guuraan koorsooyinka ka hor 10-ka Diseembar!

English: KUCCPS opens final course change window – switch degree before servers crash!
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inafungua dirisha la mwisho la kubadilisha kozi – shahada ya kubadili kabla ya seva kuanguka!
Dholuo: KUCCPS oyawo dirise mogik mar loko yo kapok servers okethore!
Somali: KUCCPS waxay fureysaa daaqadda ugu dambeysa ee isbeddelka koorsada shahaadada ka hor inta server-yada aysan burburin!

English: KUCCPS opens final revision window – change course before midnight TONIGHT!
Kiswahili: KUCCPS yafungua dirisha la mwisho la marekebisho badilisha njia kabla ya saa sita usiku wa manane!
Dholuo: KUCCPS chako chenro manyien mar timo nonro kapok saa auchiel mar otieno ochopo!
Somali: KUCCPS waxay fureysaa daaqadda ugu dambeysa ee dib u eegista ee isbeddelka koorsada ka hor saqdii dhexe ee maanta!

English: KUCCPS opens second revision of courses – change your degree choice before Dec 1.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inafungua marekebisho ya pili ya kozi na kubadilisha chaguo lako la shahada kabla ya Desemba 1.
Dholuo: KUCCPS yawo somo mar ariyo mar somo mag loko digri midwaro kapok Dec 1.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay furaysaa dib u eegis labaad oo koorsooyin ah si aad u bedesho doorashada shahaadadaada ka hor 1da Diseembar.

English: KUCCPS third revision opens tomorrow – change your course before it's too late!
Kiswahili: Marekebisho ya tatu ya KUCCPS yanafunguliwa kesho badilisha mwelekeo wako kabla haijachelewa!
Dholuo: KUCCPS somo mar adek chako kiny lok yo ma idhi luwo kapok sa odeko ahinya!
Somali: Dib-u-eegiskii saddexaad ee KUCCPS wuxuu furmayaa berrito. Isbeddel koorsadaada ka hor inta aysan noqonin mid aad u gaabis ah!

English: Launch innovation challenges 2022.
Kiswahili: Changamoto za uvumbuzi za uzinduzi 2022.
Dholuo: Loso chenro mar timo nonro manyien e higa mar 2022.
Somali: Bixinta caqabadaha hal-abuurnimada sanadka 2022.

English: Launch mentorship programs 2024.
Kiswahili: Zindua programu za ushauri 2024.

English: Launch podcast lessons 2021.

English: Launch reading campaigns 2022.
Kiswahili: Anzisha kampeni za kusoma 2022.
Dholuo: Loso kampen mag somo e higa mar 2022.
Somali: Bilow olole akhriska sanadka 2022.

English: Lawmakers warned of underpreparedness for Grade 9 rollout.
Kiswahili: Wabunge walionya kuhusu kutojiandaa vya kutosha kwa ajili ya kuanza kwa masomo ya Daraja la 9.
Dholuo: Jong'ad chik ne ochiwo siem ni ne ok giikore maber ne tij loko ji e Grade 9.
Somali: Sharci-bixiyeyaashu waxay ka digeen in aanay diyaar u ahayn in fasalka 9-aad la soo bandhigo.

English: Lead the way! Participate in school leadership elections.
Kiswahili: Ongoza njia! Shiriki katika uchaguzi wa uongozi wa shule.
Dholuo: Nyisa yo! Dhi e chokruoge mag yiero jotelo mag skunde.
Somali: Ka qaybqaad doorashada hoggaanka dugsiga.

English: Learn anywhere! Join mobile schools for pastoralist children.
Kiswahili: Jifunze popote! Jiunge na shule zinazotembea za watoto wafugaji.
Dholuo: Puonjri kamoro amora! Dhiuru e skunde mitimoe limbe ne nyithindo modak e gwenge maboyo.
Somali: Wax ka baro meel kasta! Isku soo biir dugsiyada dhaqdhaqaaqa ee loogu talagalay carruurta adhijirka ah.

English: Learn at any age! Join adult literacy classes in your county.
Kiswahili: Jifunze katika umri wowote! Jiunge na madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima katika kaunti yako.
Dholuo: Puonjri gimoro amora ma in-go kata bed mana ni in jahigini adi! Dhi e klas mar somo ne joma dongo e gweng'u.
Somali: Wax ka baro da' kasta, ka qaybqaato koorsooyinka akhriska dadka waaweyn ee degmadaada.

English: Learn comfortably! Provide desks and chairs for students.
Kiswahili: Jifunze kwa raha! Wape wanafunzi madawati na viti.
Dholuo: Puonjri e yo maber! Chiw kombe kod mesni ne jopuonjre.
Somali: Waxbarashada si raaxo leh u samee!

English: Learn equally! Provide braille and aids for disabled students.
Kiswahili: Jifunze kwa usawa! Toa braille na vifaa vya usaidizi kwa wanafunzi walemavu.
Dholuo: Puonjreuru duto! Chiw buge mondik gi Braille kaachiel gi gik mamoko manyalo konyo jopuonjre ma nigi midekre.
Somali: Waxbarashada isku midka ah! ardayda naafada ah u siiya qoraalka Braille iyo caawimaad.

English: Learn ethics! Include anti-corruption in school curricula.
Kiswahili: Jifunze maadili! Jumuisha kupambana na rushwa katika mitaala ya shule.
Dholuo: Puonjri timbe mabeyo! Ket weche mag kedo gi mibadhi obed achiel kuom gik ma ipuonjo e skul.
Somali: Waxbarashada anshaxa! Isku dar musuqmaasuqa barnaamijyada dugsiga.

English: Learn farming! Enroll in agricultural vocational courses.
Kiswahili: Jifunze kilimo! Jiandikishe katika kozi za ufundi za kilimo.
Dholuo: Puonjri bedo japur! Dhi e skunde mag tiegruok e weche mag pur.
Somali: Baro beeraha! Isku qor koorsooyinka xirfadaha beeraha.

English: Learn farming! Include agricultural education in schools.
Kiswahili: Jifunze kilimo! Jumuisha elimu ya kilimo shuleni.
Dholuo: Puonjri bedo japur! Ket weche mag pur e skunde.
Somali: Waxbarashada beeraha iskuulka ku dar.

English: Learn on the job! Join apprenticeship programs in industries.
Kiswahili: Jifunze kazini! Jiunge na programu za uanagenzi katika tasnia.
Dholuo: Puonjri timo kamano sama in e tich! Bed achiel kuom jogo matimo tiegruok mar apprenticeship e tije mopogore opogore.
Somali: Waxbarashada shaqada! Ku biir barnaamijyada tababarka ee warshadaha.

English: Learners sitting for Kenya Primary School Education Assessment (KPSEA) and Kenya Junior School Education Assessment (KJSEA) will now be required to shade their answers using Optical Mark Recognition (OMR) sheets
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wanaofanya Tathmini ya Elimu ya Shule ya Msingi ya Kenya (KPSEA) na Tathmini ya Elimu ya Shule ya Wadogo ya Kenya (KJSEA) sasa watahitajika kuficha majibu yao kwa kutumia karatasi za Utambuzi wa Alama za Optical (OMR).
Dholuo: Jopuonjre mobiro e penj mar Kenya Primary School Education Assessment (KPSEA) kod Kenya Junior School Education Assessment (KJSEA) koro biro dwaro ni gipiem dwoko margi ka gitiyo gi Optical Mark Recognition (OMR) sheets
Somali: Ardayda ku fadhiya Qiimaynta Waxbarashada Dugsiyada hoose ee Kenya (KPSEA) iyo Qiimaynta Waxbarashada Dugsiyada hoose ee Kenya (KJSEA) ayaa hadda looga baahan doonaa inay jawaabooda hoos u dhigaan iyagoo adeegsanaya waraaqaha Aqoonsiga Calaamadaha Optical Mark (OMR)

English: Maintain playgrounds safely 2021.

Somali: In la ilaaliyo kaabayaasha dugsiga sanadka 2023.

Kiswahili: Fanya shule zipatikane! Weka njia panda kwa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu.

Somali: La soco barnaamijyada nafaqada ee 2024.

English: Monitor student attendance post-COVID 2021.
Kiswahili: Fuatilia mahudhurio ya wanafunzi baada ya COVID 2021.
Dholuo: Luwre kod kwan mar jopuonjre bang' COVID 2021.
Somali: Kormeerka ka qaybgalka ardayda ka dib COVID 2021.

English: Monitor teacher absenteeism 2023.
Kiswahili: Fuatilia utoro wa walimu 2023.
Dholuo: Luwo kwan mar jopuonj ma ok yudre e skul 2023.
Somali: Kormeerka maqnaanshaha macalimiinta sanadka 2023.

English: More teachers! Support hiring in underserved regions.
Kiswahili: Walimu zaidi! Saidia kuajiri katika maeneo ambayo hayana huduma za kutosha.
Dholuo: Jopuonj mang'eny! Konyuru joma dwaro tich e gwenge ma ji ok yudie tich.
Somali: Macallimiin badan! Taageero shaqaaleysiinta gobollada aan la adeegsan karin.

English: Motivate teachers! Offer bonuses for rural school postings.
Kiswahili: Wahamasishe walimu! Toa bonasi kwa nafasi za shule za vijijini.
Dholuo: Jiw jopuonj! Chiw mich mag pesa ne joma dhi e skunde man kuonde maboyo.
Somali: Dhiirigelinta macalimiinta! Bixi gunno shaqooyinka dugsiyada miyiga.

English: Multi-agency team monitors school safety during KCSE exams.
Kiswahili: Timu ya mashirika mengi hufuatilia usalama wa shule wakati wa mitihani ya KCSE.
Dholuo: Grube ma nigi tije mopogore opogore nono chal mar kuonde somo e kinde penj mag KCSE.
Somali: Koox ka kooban hay'ado badan ayaa kormeera ammaanka dugsiga inta lagu jiro imtixaannada KCSE.

English: New Competency-Based Curriculum for TVET launched – download free from KICD.
Kiswahili: Mtaala Mpya Unaozingatia Umahiri wa TVET ulizinduliwa na – pakua bure kutoka KICD.
Dholuo: Ne ochak chenro manyien mar tiegruok kuom lony e yore mag tiegruok gi lony e yore mag TVET ma ng'ato nyalo download nono e KICD.
Somali: Barnaamijka cusub ee TVET ee ku saleysan aqoonta ayaa la bilaabay si lacag la'aan ah loogu soo dejiyo KICD.

English: New green-energy TVET curriculum launched – free download on KICD site now!
Kiswahili: Mtaala mpya wa TVET wa nishati ya kijani ulizinduliwa "upakuaji wa bure kwenye tovuti ya KICD sasa!"
Dholuo: Chenro manyien mar tiegruok e yore mag TVET ma tiyo gi teko mar lowo ne ochak download e websait mar KICD sani!
Somali: Barnaamijka cusub ee TVET ee tamarta cagaaran ayaa la bilaabay si bilaash ah loogu soo dejiyo bogga KICD hadda!

English: No arson in schools! Keep flammables away from dorms.
Kiswahili: Hakuna uchomaji moto shuleni! Weka vifaa vya kuwaka moto mbali na mabweni.
Dholuo: Onge wang'o ji e skul! Rit gik manyalo wang' gi mach kik donj e udi.
Somali: Iskuullada dab-damiska ha ka dhigin.

English: No changes to KCSE 2025 timetable after October 1.
Kiswahili: Hakuna mabadiliko kwenye ratiba ya KCSE 2025 baada ya Oktoba 1.
Dholuo: Onge lokruok e chenro mar KCSE 2025 bang' Oktoba 1.
Somali: Ma jiro wax isbeddel ah oo ku yimaada jadwalka KCSE 2025 ka dib 1da Oktoobar.

English: No child left behind: 100% transition from primary to secondary enforced nationwide.
Kiswahili: Hakuna mtoto aliyeachwa nyuma: Mpito wa 100% kutoka shule ya msingi hadi shule ya upili unatekelezwa kote nchini.
Dholuo: Onge nyathi moro amora mowe chien: lokruok mar 100% koa e skul mar praimar nyaka e sekondar osemi teko e piny mangima.
Somali: Ilmo la'aan: 100% gudbinta dugsiga koowaad ilaa dugsiga koowaad waxaa lagu qasbay dalka oo dhan.

English: No child to repeat Grade 6 – automatic promotion to JSS enforced nationwide!
Kiswahili: Hakuna mtoto wa kurudia Daraja la 6 – kupandishwa cheo kiotomatiki kwa JSS kunatekelezwa kote nchini!
Dholuo: Onge nyathi ma biro nwoyo somo mar 6 ma biro miyo okete e JSS e piny mangima!
Somali: Ilmaha aan ku celcelin fasalka 6-aad ee kor u qaadista tooska ah ee JSS ee dalka oo dhan lagu qasbay!

English: No delay in school reopening 2025 due to floods.
Kiswahili: Hakuna kuchelewa kwa kufungua shule mwaka 2025 kutokana na mafuriko.
Dholuo: Onge deko e chako skul kendo e higa mar 2025 nikech ataro.
Somali: Dib-u-furitaanka dugsiyada 2025 ma dib u dhicin sababtoo ah fatahaadaha.

English: No entry without uniform and ID from January 6, 2025.
Kiswahili: Hakuna kiingilio bila sare na kitambulisho kuanzia Januari 6, 2025.
Dholuo: Ok oyiene ng'ato donjo ka oonge gi yunifom kod ID chakre Januar 6, 2025.
Somali: Ma jiro wax soo galo ah oo aan lahayn uniform iyo aqoonsi laga bilaabo 6-da Janaayo 2025.

English: No fees for public primary – report any demand to 0800721490 immediately!
Kiswahili: Hakuna ada kwa ajili ya shule za msingi za umma toa taarifa kuhusu ombi lolote kwa 0800721490 mara moja!
Dholuo: Onge chudo moro amora ne sirkal mar Primary. Ka ng'ato dwaro kony, goch ne 0800721490 mapiyo!
Somali: Lacag la'aan doorashooyinka doorashooyinka dadweynaha si dhakhso leh ugu soo sheeg codsi kasta 0800721490!

English: No learner to be locked out for lack of uniform – principals warned!
Kiswahili: Hakuna mwanafunzi atakayefungiwa nje kwa kukosa sare za shule, "wakuu wa shule walionya!"
Dholuo: Onge japuonjre mabiro bedo oko nikech onge japuonj maduong' morwakore gi yunifom!
Somali: Ma jiro arday lagu xiro dhar la'aantiis, macallimiinta ayaa ka digay!

English: No learner to miss school due to fees – call 0800721490 if blocked at the gate.
Kiswahili: Mwanafunzi asikose shule kutokana na ada piga 0800721490 ikiwa amezuiwa langoni.
Dholuo: Onge japuonjre ma biro deko e skul nikech chudo mag somo luong 0800721490 kapo ni ogeng'gi e rangach.
Somali: Ma jiro arday ka maqnaan doona dugsiga lacag la'aan ah. Wac 0800721490 haddii lagu xannibo iridda.

English: No learner to walk more than 5km to school – free buses deployed in rural areas!
Kiswahili: Hakuna mwanafunzi anayeruhusiwa kutembea zaidi ya kilomita 5 kwenda shuleni, mabasi ya bure yanapelekwa vijijini!
Dholuo: Onge japuonjre mabiro wuotho mokalo kilomita abich mondo odhi e skul gi bas ma onge chudo moketi e gwenge maboyo!
Somali: Ardaygu ma socdo wax ka badan 5km ilaa dugsiga basaska lacag la'aanta ah ee loo adeegsado meelaha miyiga ah!

English: No violence! Report student issues to school management.
Kiswahili: Hakuna vurugu! Ripoti masuala ya wanafunzi kwa usimamizi wa shule.
Dholuo: Onge timbe gero! Lend ne jotelo mag skundno kuom weche ma chando jopuonjre.
Somali: Dhibaatooyinka ardayda u sheeg maamulka dugsiga.

English: No visits to secondary schools during third term as per circular.
Kiswahili: Hakuna ziara katika shule za upili wakati wa muhula wa tatu kulingana na waraka.
Dholuo: Onge limbe e skunde sekondar e kinde mar adek kaka oler e barua.
Somali: Ma jiro booqasho dugsiyada dhexe muddada saddexaad sida ku cad wareegga.

English: OMR answer sheets for KPSEA 2025 now use circles instead of lines.
Kiswahili: Karatasi za majibu za OMR za KPSEA 2025 sasa zinatumia miduara badala ya mistari.
Dholuo: Buge mag dwoko mag OMR mar KPSEA 2025 sani tiyo gi circles kar tiyo gi line.
Somali: Bogga jawaabaha OMR ee KPSEA 2025 hadda waxay isticmaalaan wareegyo halkii ay ku jiri lahaayeen khadadka.

English: Open doors! Integrate refugee students into national schools.
Kiswahili: Milango wazi! Wajumuishe wanafunzi wakimbizi katika shule za kitaifa.
Dholuo: Yawuru dhoudi! Riwo jopuonjre ma oringo thuchegi lwedo e skunde mag jopinyno.
Somali: albaabada u fur, ardayda qaxootiga ah iskuulada qaranka.

English: Open schools! Enroll refugee children in education.
Kiswahili: Fungua shule! Waandikishe watoto wakimbizi katika elimu.
Dholuo: Nyis ji ni isedonjo e skul! Kony nyithindo moringo thuchegi mondo oyud somo.
Somali: Dugsiyada fur, caruurta qaxootiga ku qor waxbarashada.

English: Organize career guidance days 2021.
Kiswahili: Panga siku za mwongozo wa kazi 2021.
Dholuo: Chenro mar bedo gi odiechienge mag chiwo paro e wi tije 2021.
Somali: Abaabulka maalmaha tababbarka xirfadaha 2021.

English: Organize debate clubs 2020.
Kiswahili: Panga vilabu vya mijadala 2020.
Dholuo: Chenro mar goyo mbaka e kind ji e higa 2020.
Somali: Ururinta kooxaha doodda 2020.

English: Organize exchange programs 2020.
Kiswahili: Panga programu za kubadilishana 2020.
Dholuo: Loso chenro mag loko ji e higa mar 2020.
Somali: Abaabulka barnaamijyada isweydaarsiga 2020.

English: Organize science fairs annually 2022.
Kiswahili: Kuandaa maonyesho ya sayansi kila mwaka 2022.
Dholuo: Loso nyasi mag sayans higa ka higa e higa 2022.
Somali: Abaabulka bandhigyada cilmiga sanadlaha ah ee 2022.

English: Over 1.5 million learners placed in junior secondary – check SMS *222# now.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya wanafunzi milioni 1.5 waliojiunga na shule ya upili ya junior angalia SMS *222# sasa.
Dholuo: Jopuonjre mokalo milion 1.5 moket e sekondar mar sekondar nono SMS *222# sani.
Somali: In ka badan 1.5 milyan oo arday ah oo ku jira dugsiga hoose ee dugsiga sare ayaa hadda hubinaya SMS *222#.

English: Over 2 million learners to get free textbooks Jan 6 – no buying allowed!
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya wanafunzi milioni 2 watapata vitabu vya kiada bila malipo Januari 6 – hakuna ununuzi unaoruhusiwa!
Dholuo: Jopuonjre mokalo milion 2 biro yudo buge maonge chudo Jan 6 onge ng'iewo ma oyienegi!
Somali: In ka badan 2 milyan oo arday ayaa heli doona buugaag bilaash ah 6-ka Janaayo.

English: Parents in arid areas: Apply now for 15,000 secondary school scholarships – deadline Nov 30.
Kiswahili: Wazazi katika maeneo kame: Tuma maombi sasa kwa ufadhili wa masomo 15,000 wa shule za upili tarehe ya mwisho Novemba 30.
Dholuo: Jonyuol modak e gwenge motwo: Kwauru sani mondo uyud buse 15,000 mag somo sekondari tarik mogik Novemba 30.
Somali: Waalidiinta ku nool meelaha abaaruhu ku nool yihiin: hadda codso 15 kun oo deeq waxbarasho oo dugsiga sare ah 30ka Nofeembar.

English: Parents in slums: 50,000 full scholarships available – apply before Nov 30!
Kiswahili: Wazazi katika makazi duni: Ufadhili kamili 50,000 unapatikana – tuma maombi kabla ya Novemba 30!
Dholuo: Jonyuol modak e gwenge mag joma odhier: 50,000 mar burses mag somo ma nigi thuolo moromo orom kapok Nov 30!
Somali: Waalidiinta ku nool xaafadaha foosha xun: 50,000 oo deeq waxbarasho oo dhamaystiran oo la heli karo ayaa la dalban karaa 30-ka Nofeembar!

English: Parents must register Grade 6 learners for KPSEA by February 28, 2025.
Kiswahili: Wazazi lazima wawaandikishe wanafunzi wa Darasa la 6 kwa KPSEA ifikapo Februari 28, 2025.
Dholuo: Jonyuol nyaka ndiki jopuonjre mag klas 6 e KPSEA kapok ochopo tarik 28 Februar 2025.
Somali: Waalidiintu waa inay diiwaangeliyaan ardayda fasalka 6aad ee KPSEA 28-ka Febraayo 2025.

English: Parents urged to enroll all children in free primary education before January 2025 deadline.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wamehimizwa kuwaandikisha watoto wote katika elimu ya msingi bila malipo kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya Januari 2025.
Dholuo: Ne ojiw jonyuol mondo ondik nyithindgi duto e skul mar praimari maonge chudo kapok ochopo Januar 2025.
Somali: Waalidiinta ayaa lagu booriyay in dhammaan caruurta lagu qoro waxbarashada hoose ee bilaashka ah ka hor taariikhda Janaayo 2025.

English: Parents, be alert! Report terror risks near schools.
Kiswahili: Wazazi, kuwa macho! Ripoti hatari za ugaidi karibu na shule.
Dholuo: Jonyuol, beduru motang'! Nyis kama nitie jo mahundu machiegni gi skunde.
Somali: Waalidiinta, ka digtoonaada!

English: Parents, engage! Attend school meetings to support education access.
Kiswahili: Wazazi, shiriki! Hudhuria mikutano ya shule ili kusaidia upatikanaji wa elimu.
Dholuo: Jonyuol, beduru motang'! Dhi e chokruoge mag skul mondo ikony ji yudo somo.
Somali: Waalidiinta, ka qaybqaada shirarka dugsiga si aad u taageerto helitaanka waxbarashada.

English: Parents, stay cautious! Monitor children to prevent abductions.
Kiswahili: Wazazi, kuwa mwangalifu! Wafuatilie watoto ili kuzuia utekaji nyara.
Dholuo: Un jonyuol, beduru motang'! Rit nyithindo mondo kik ng'ato omakgi.
Somali: Waalidiinta, ka digtoonaada!

English: Parents, stay vigilant! Protect children from banditry risks.
Kiswahili: Wazazi, endeleeni kuwa macho! Lindeni watoto dhidi ya hatari za ujambazi.
Dholuo: Un jonyuol, beduru motang'! Rit nyithindo kik hinyre gi jonjore.
Somali: Waalidiinta, ka digtoonaada! Carruurta ka ilaali khatarta tuugada.

English: Parents: Ask your child if they're registered to vote – guide available on education.go.ke
Kiswahili: Wazazi: Muulize mtoto wako kama amejiandikisha kupiga kura. Mwongozo unapatikana kwenye education.go.ke
Dholuo: Jonyuol: Penjuru nyithindu ka be gin kod ratiro mar goyo ombulu.
Somali: Waalidiinta: Weydii ilmahaaga haddii uu diiwaan gashan yahay codbixinta. Tilmaamaha lagu heli karo education.go.ke

English: Parents: Check if your child is registered to vote – guide on education.go.ke!
Kiswahili: Wazazi: Angalia kama mtoto wako amesajiliwa kupiga kura. Mwongozo wa elimu.go.ke!
Dholuo: Janyuol: Ne ka nyathini ondik nyinge mondo oyier ng'at ma biro chike e websait mar education.go.ke
Somali: Waalidiinta: Hubi in ilmahaagu diiwaan gashan yahay codbixinta.

English: Parents: Pay zero fees for public secondary – report any school demanding money to 0800721490 now.
Kiswahili: Wazazi: Lipa ada sifuri kwa shule za sekondari za umma – ripoti shule yoyote inayodai pesa kwa 0800721490 sasa.
Dholuo: Jonyuol: Chuluru osara mar skul mar sekondar mar sirkal. Nyis skul moro amora madwaro pesa e 0800721490 sani.
Somali: Waalidiinta: Lacag la'aan bixinta dugsiyada dugsiga sare ee dadweynaha u sheeg dugsi kasta oo lacag dalbanaya 0800721490 hadda.

English: Parents: Teach your child their voter rights tonight – free guide at education.go.ke
Kiswahili: Wazazi: Mfundisheni mtoto wenu haki zake za kupiga kura usiku wa leo mwongozo wa bure katika education.go.ke
Dholuo: Jonyuol: Puonjuru nyithindu ratiro mag goyo ombulu kawuono nono e websait mar education.go.ke
Somali: Waalidiinta: baro ilmahaaga xuquuqda codbixinta caawa

English: Pipe up! Enroll in plumbing vocational courses.
Kiswahili: Jiunge nasi! Jiandikishe katika kozi za ufundi za mabomba.
Dholuo: Wuo gi chir! Dhi e skunde mag tiegruok e tije mag stima.
Somali: Isku qor koorsooyinka xirfadeed ee biyaha.

English: Plan ahead! Develop landslide evacuation plans for schools.
Kiswahili: Panga mapema! Tengeneza mipango ya uokoaji wa maporomoko ya ardhi kwa shule.
Dholuo: Chanuru gik moko chon! Loso chenro mag golo ji e skunde sama koth ochue.
Somali: Qorshee qorshe ka hor, qorshe gurmad ah oo loogu talagalay dugsiyada.

English: Plan for safety! Develop school lockdown plans for terror threats.
Kiswahili: Panga kwa usalama! Tengeneza mipango ya kufungwa shuleni kwa ajili ya vitisho vya ugaidi.
Dholuo: Chenro mar ritruok! Loso chenro mar keto sikul oko nikech timbe mahundu.
Somali: Qorshaynta amniga, qorshaynta xiritaanka dugsiga ee hanjabaadaha argagixisada.

English: Power up! Join vocational courses in renewable energy.
Kiswahili: Ongeza nguvu! Jiunge na kozi za ufundi katika nishati mbadala.
Dholuo: Chako tiyo! Dhi e tiegruok e yore mag manyo yore mag tiyo gi teko manyien.
Somali: Ku biir koorsooyinka xirfadeed ee tamarta la cusboonaysiin karo.

English: Prepare for fees! Support schools by paying fees on time despite funding delays.
Kiswahili: Jiandae kwa ada! Saidia shule kwa kulipa ada kwa wakati licha ya ucheleweshaji wa fedha.
Dholuo: Ikreuru ne chudo! Konyuru skunde kuom chulo osuru e wang' sa kata obedo ni pesa ma ne ichulogi ne odeko.
Somali: Iskuulka ku taageero adoo waqti ku bixinaya lacag bixinta inkastoo maalgelinta dib loo dhigo.

English: Prepare for KPSEA assessments Grade 6.
Kiswahili: Jiandae kwa tathmini za KPSEA Daraja la 6.
Dholuo: Ikri ne penj mar KPSEA mar Grade 6.
Somali: Diyaar u noqo qiimaynta KPSEA Darajada 6.

English: Prevent exam leakage 2020.
Kiswahili: Zuia uvujaji wa mtihani 2020.
Dholuo: Geng'o somo mar 2020 kik olandre.
Somali: Ka hortagga baxsiga imtixaanka 2020.

English: Prevent sexual harassment 2020.
Kiswahili: Zuia unyanyasaji wa kijinsia 2020.
Dholuo: Geng'o timbe mag chode e higa 2020.
Somali: Ka hortagga dhibaatada galmada 2020.

English: Prevent substance abuse in schools 2025.
Kiswahili: Kuzuia matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya shuleni 2025.
Dholuo: Geng'o tiyo marach gi yedhe mamero e skunde e higa mar 2025.
Somali: Ka hortagga isticmaalka maandooriyaha dugsiyada 2025.

English: Priority for bursary to needy students.
Kiswahili: Kipaumbele cha ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji.
Dholuo: Yudo pesa mar somo biro bedo motelo ne jopuonjre modhier.
Somali: Horumarinta deeqaha deeqda waxbarasho ee ardayda u baahan.

English: Priority for bursary to needy TVET students.
Kiswahili: Kipaumbele cha ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wa TVET wenye uhitaji.
Dholuo: Chenro mar bursary ne jopuonjre mag TVET man gi chan.
Somali: Horumarinta deeqaha deeqda waxbarasho ee loogu talagalay ardayda TVET ee u baahan.

English: Priority for TVET bursary given to needy students.
Kiswahili: Kipaumbele cha ufadhili wa TVET kinatolewa kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji.
Dholuo: Chenro mar bursary mar TVET imiyo jopuonjre ma nigi chan.
Somali: Horumarinta deeqaha waxbarasho ee TVET ee la siiyo ardayda u baahan.

English: Process for profit! Learn food processing in TVET programs.
Kiswahili: Mchakato wa kupata faida! Jifunze usindikaji wa chakula katika programu za TVET.
Dholuo: Timuru kamano mondo uyud ohala! Puonjri kaka itiyo gi chiemo e program mag TVET.
Somali: Waxbarashada cuntada barnaamijyada TVET.

English: Project builds English-to-KSL dataset for deaf learners using AI.
Kiswahili: Mradi huunda seti ya data ya Kiingereza hadi KSL kwa wanafunzi viziwi kwa kutumia AI.
Dholuo: Chenro mar gero weche mag Kisungu-to-KSL ne joma itgi odino ka gitiyo gi AI.
Somali: Mashruuca wuxuu dhisaa xogta Ingiriisiga ilaa KSL ee ardayda maqalka la' ee isticmaala AI.

English: Project documents education struggles and hopes for rural girls.
Kiswahili: Mradi unaonyesha mapambano ya elimu na matumaini kwa wasichana wa vijijini.
Dholuo: Chenrono nyiso pek ma nyiri manie gwenge yudo kod geno ma gin - go kuom somo.
Somali: Mashruuca wuxuu soo bandhigayaa halganka waxbarashada iyo rajada gabdhaha reer miyiga ah.

English: Project helps Nairobi schools access teacher training and learning tools.
Kiswahili: Mradi husaidia shule za Nairobi kupata mafunzo ya walimu na zana za kujifunzia.
Dholuo: Chenrono konyo skunde mag Nairobi yudo tiegruok mar jopuonj kod gige puonjruok.
Somali: Mashruuca ayaa ka caawiya dugsiyada Nairobi inay helaan qalabka tababarka macalimiinta iyo barashada.

English: Promote arts education 2024.
Kiswahili: Kukuza elimu ya sanaa 2024.
Dholuo: Jiw somo mar lony mar goro e higa 2024.
Somali: Horumarinta waxbarashada farshaxanka 2024.

English: Promote coding clubs 2024.
Kiswahili: Kukuza vilabu vya uandishi wa misimbo 2024.
Dholuo: Jiw program mag koding e higa mar 2024.
Somali: Dhiirrigelinta kooxaha codaynta sanadka 2024.

English: Promote cultural education 2020.
Kiswahili: Kukuza elimu ya kitamaduni 2020.
Dholuo: Dhi nyime gi puonjo ji weche mag kit ngima dhano e higa 2020.
Somali: Horumarinta waxbarashada dhaqanka 2020.

English: Promote entrepreneurship education 2024.
Kiswahili: Kukuza elimu ya ujasiriamali 2024.
Dholuo: Jiw tiegruok mar bedo jolok ohala e higa 2024.
Somali: Horumarinta waxbarashada ganacsiga sanadka 2024.

English: Promote environmental education in curriculum.
Kiswahili: Kukuza elimu ya mazingira katika mtaala.
Dholuo: Jiw tiegruok e weche mag alwora e chenro mar somo.
Somali: Horumarinta waxbarashada deegaanka ee manhajka.

English: Promote equality! Ensure equal access for boys and girls.
Kiswahili: Kukuza usawa! Hakikisha upatikanaji sawa kwa wavulana na wasichana.
Dholuo: Ji duto onego obed gi paro machal! Ne ni nyithindo duto ma yawuowi gi ma nyiri yudo thuolo machal.
Somali: Dhiirrigelinta sinnaanta, hubinta helitaanka isku midka ah ee wiilasha iyo gabdhaha.

English: Promote gender parity 2023.
Kiswahili: Kukuza usawa wa kijinsia 2023.
Dholuo: Konyuru joma chwo gi mon e higa mar 2023.
Somali: Horumarinta sinnaanta jinsiga sanadka 2023.

English: Promote green schools 2024.
Kiswahili: Kukuza shule za kijani 2024.
Dholuo: Jiw skunde ma nigi ler 2024.
Somali: Dhiirrigelinta dugsiyada cagaaran ee 2024.

English: Promote health education 2021.
Kiswahili: Kukuza elimu ya afya 2021.
Dholuo: Jiw tiegruok e weche thieth 2021.
Somali: Horumarinta waxbarashada caafimaadka sanadka 2021.

English: Promote lifelong learning 2025.
Kiswahili: Kukuza ujifunzaji wa maisha yote 2025.
Dholuo: Jiw puonjruok kuom ngima duto 2025.
Somali: Horumarinta waxbarashada nolosha oo dhan 2025.

English: Promote peace education in conflict areas 2025.
Kiswahili: Kukuza elimu ya amani katika maeneo yenye migogoro 2025.
Dholuo: Jiw tiegruok mar kuwe e gwenge ma lweny nitie 2025.
Somali: Horumarinta waxbarashada nabadda ee goobaha khilaafaadka sanadka 2025.

English: Promote research collaborations 2025.

English: Promote volunteerism 2025.
Kiswahili: Kukuza kujitolea 2025.

Kiswahili: Linda watoto! Ripoti unyanyasaji au usafirishaji haramu kwa 116.

English: Protect our children! Report trafficking risks to 116.
Kiswahili: Linda watoto wetu! Ripoti hatari za usafirishaji haramu kwa 116.

English: Protect our planet! Join school environmental clubs.

English: Protect schools! Communities, guard against banditry.
Kiswahili: Linda shule! Jamii, jilinde dhidi ya ujambazi.

English: Protect students! Create GBV-free school environments.
Kiswahili: Linda wanafunzi! Unda mazingira ya shule yasiyo na GBV.
Dholuo: Rituru jopuonjre! Loso kuonde ma onge timbe gero mag chwo gi mon.
Somali: Ka ilaali ardayda! Abuur jawi dugsiyeed oo aan lahayn GBV.

English: Provide access! Supply braille digital tools for students.
Kiswahili: Toa ufikiaji! Wape wanafunzi zana za kidijitali za Braille.

English: Provide aids! Supply sign language tools for deaf students.
Kiswahili: Toa vifaa vya kusaidia! Toa vifaa vya lugha ya ishara kwa wanafunzi viziwi.
Dholuo: Chiw kony madwarore! Chiw ne nyithindo ma rodin gik ma konyogi ng'eyo dho ranyisi.

English: Provide assistive devices 2020.
Kiswahili: Toa vifaa vya usaidizi 2020.

Kiswahili: Toa vifaa vya huduma ya kwanza 2020.

English: Provide internet in schools 2024.

English: Provide resources! Fund mental health programs in schools.
Kiswahili: Toa rasilimali! Fadhili programu za afya ya akili mashuleni.
Dholuo: Chiw kony madwarore! Kony e weche mag thieth mag paro e skunde.
Somali: Hayso kheyraad, maalgeliso barnaamijyada caafimaadka dhimirka ee dugsiyada.

English: Provide scholarships for orphans 2021.
Kiswahili: Kutoa ufadhili wa masomo kwa yatima 2021.
Dholuo: Chiwo pesa mag somo ne nyithind kiye 2021.

English: Provide scholarships for sports 2020.
Kiswahili: Toa ufadhili wa masomo kwa ajili ya michezo 2020.
Dholuo: Chiwo pesa mag somo ne tuke 2020.
Somali: Bixinta deeqaha waxbarasho ee isboortiga 2020.

English: Provide shelters! Ensure safe spaces during floods.
Kiswahili: Toa makazi! Hakikisha kuna maeneo salama wakati wa mafuriko.
Dholuo: Chiwuru kuonde ma unyalo pondoe! Ne ni nitie kuonde ma ji nyalo dakie ka pi ataro nitie.

English: Publish annual reports 2022.
Kiswahili: Chapisha ripoti za kila mwaka za 2022.
Dholuo: Goyo ripode higa ka higa e higa 2022.
Somali: Daabaca warbixinnada sanadlaha ah ee 2022.

English: Publish exam results promptly 2024.
Kiswahili: Chapisha matokeo ya mtihani mara moja 2024.
Dholuo: Goyo nonro mag penj e higa mar 2024.
Somali: Soo bandhig natiijooyinka imtixaanka ugu dhakhsaha badan 2024.

English: Publish learning resources 2022.
Kiswahili: Chapisha nyenzo za kujifunzia 2022.
Dholuo: Goyo buge mag puonjruok e higa 2022.
Somali: Daabac ilo waxbarasho sanadka 2022.

English: Radio Taifa CBC lessons air from 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM daily.
Kiswahili: Masomo ya Radio Taifa CBC hurushwa hewani kuanzia saa 10:00 asubuhi hadi saa 11:00 asubuhi kila siku.

English: Raise awareness! Educate on landslide risks in schools.
Kiswahili: Kuongeza uelewa! Elimu kuhusu hatari za maporomoko ya ardhi shuleni.
Dholuo: Meduru ji ng'eyo! Puonj ji e wi masira mar yiengni piny e skunde.

English: Raise awareness! Educate students on protest safety.
Kiswahili: Kuongeza uelewa! Waelimishe wanafunzi kuhusu usalama wa maandamano.
Dholuo: Meduru ji ng'eyo! Puonj nyithindo kaka ginyalo bedo motang' sama gitimo ng'anyo.
Somali: Waxbarashada ardayda ku saabsan badbaadada banaanbaxyada.

English: Raise awareness! Schools, educate on FGM prevention.
Kiswahili: Kuongeza uelewa! Shule, toa elimu kuhusu kuzuia ukeketaji.

English: Raise awareness! Schools, educate on GBV prevention.
Kiswahili: Kuongeza uelewa! Shule, toa elimu kuhusu kuzuia GBV.
Dholuo: Meduru ji ng'eyo! Skunde, puonjre kuom geng'o GBV.
Somali: Iskuulada, wacyi galinta ka hortagga cudurka GBV.

English: Raise awareness! Teach abduction prevention in schools.
Kiswahili: Kuongeza uelewa! Fundisha kuzuia utekaji nyara shuleni.
Dholuo: Meduru ji ng'eyo! Puonjuru nyithindo kaka ginyalo geng'o joma omaki.
Somali: Waxbarashada ka hortagga afduubka dugsiyada.

English: Read anywhere! Access mobile libraries in rural areas.
Kiswahili: Soma popote! Fikia maktaba za simu katika maeneo ya vijijini.
Dholuo: Som kamoro amora! Bed gi thuolo mar dhi e laibrari kuonde ma ji mang'eny odakie.
Somali: Wax ka akhriso meel kasta!

English: Read to succeed! Ensure every student has textbooks.
Kiswahili: Soma ili ufanikiwe! Hakikisha kila mwanafunzi ana vitabu vya kiada.
Dholuo: Som Muma mondo ibed gi ngima maber! Ne ni japuonjre ka japuonjre nigi buge.
Somali: Akhri si aad u guulaysato! Hubi in arday kasta uu haysto buugaag waxbarasho.

English: Rebuild safely! Restore classrooms after floods.
Kiswahili: Jenga upya kwa usalama! Rejesha madarasa baada ya mafuriko.
Dholuo: Gedo maber! Loso klase bang' ataro.
Somali: Dib u dhiska si nabad ah! Dib u dhiska qolalka fasalka ka dib fatahaadaha.

English: Recover learning! Join remedial classes after floods.
Kiswahili: Pata nafuu ya kujifunza! Jiunge na madarasa ya tiba baada ya mafuriko.
Dholuo: Puonjruok kendo! Dhi e klas mag rieyo nyithindo bang' ataro.
Somali: Waxbarashada dib u soo celinta! Ku biir fasallada dayactirka ka dib fatahaadaha.

English: Recruit qualified teachers 2023.
Kiswahili: Kuajiri walimu waliohitimu 2023.
Dholuo: Kony jopuonj molony e higa mar 2023.
Somali: Shaqaaleysiinta macalimiinta aqoonta u leh 2023.

English: Reduce barriers! Apply for government fee subsidies for low-income families.
Kiswahili: Punguza vikwazo! Omba ruzuku ya ada ya serikali kwa familia zenye kipato cha chini.
Dholuo: Goluru gik manyalo geng'ou! Kwa kony mar sirkal kuom chulo osuru ne joot ma nigi pesa matin.
Somali: Isticmaal lacago dowladeed oo loogu talagalay qoysaska dakhligoodu hooseeyo.

English: Reduce class sizes 2022.
Kiswahili: Punguza ukubwa wa madarasa 2022.
Dholuo: Duoko kwan mar jopuonjre chien e higa mar 2022.
Somali: Si loo yareeyo tirada fasallada sanadka 2022.

English: Refugee learners join public schools free from January – bring UNHCR card only.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wakimbizi hujiunga na shule za umma bila malipo kuanzia Januari. Lete kadi ya UNHCR pekee.

Kiswahili: Jiandikishe kama mpiga kura leo katika chuo kikuu cha umma kilicho karibu nawe. Usindikaji wa vitambulisho ni bure.

Somali: Diiwaangelinta KCSE waxay ku majaajiloodaan bilowga 2025.

Kiswahili: Rekebisha shule! Jenga upya miundombinu iliyoharibiwa na mafuriko.

Somali: Dhis dugsiyada, dib u dhiska kaabayaasha burburay fatahaadaha.

Kiswahili: Ripoti ada zozote za shule zinazotoza zaidi ya Ksh 0 hadi 0800721490 – tunaangalia!

Somali: Warbixinta khaladaadka ku saabsan khadka tooska ah ee KNEC.

English: Report risks! Call police or teachers to prevent abductions.
Kiswahili: Ripoti hatari! Piga simu polisi au walimu ili kuzuia utekaji nyara.

English: Report sexual harassment in school via 0800721524 – anonymous & free!
Kiswahili: Ripoti unyanyasaji wa kijinsia shuleni kupitia 0800721524 – bila kujulikana na bure!

Dholuo: Jokanyo kelo penjo e wi ratiro mag sirkal

English: Resolve disputes! Train students in peer mediation.
Kiswahili: Tatua migogoro! Wafunze wanafunzi kuhusu upatanishi wa rika.
Dholuo: Tiuru gi rieko e tieko ywaruok. Tiego jopuonjre e yore mag goyo mbaka gi jowetegi.

Kiswahili: Shule za vijijini zinapokea kompyuta kibao na muunganisho ili kuongeza ujifunzaji wa kidijitali.

Kiswahili: Kufunguliwa tena kwa usalama: Shule zote lazima zifuate itifaki ya COVID ya pointi 10 - maagizo ya CS!

Kiswahili: Itifaki za kufungua shule salama zililazimisha baada ya mafuriko.
Dholuo: Chenro mag chako somo e skunde ma nigi ritruok ne ochak tiyo bang' ataro.
Somali: Barnaamijyada dib-u-furitaanka dugsiyada ammaanka ah ayaa la hirgeliyay ka dib daadadka.

English: Safe school transport: All matatus ferrying students must have speed governors!
Kiswahili: Usafiri salama shuleni: Matatu zote zinazosafirisha wanafunzi lazima ziwe na vidhibiti mwendo!
Dholuo: Wuoth maber mar dhi e skul: Jopuonjre duto ma ting'o matatu nyaka bed gi gik ma geng'o ng'wech!
Somali: Gaadiidka iskuulka ee ammaan ah: Dhammaan ardayda maraakiibta matatus waa inay lahaadaan maamulayaasha xawaaraha!

English: Safe schools! Communities, protect schools from banditry.
Kiswahili: Shule salama! Jamii, linda shule dhidi ya ujambazi.
Dholuo: Skunde mag geng'ruok! Jo gweng', rituru skunde kik hiny.
Somali: Dugsiyada nabadgelyo leh, bulshooyinka, dugsiyada ka ilaalinta burcad-badeedda.

Kiswahili: Ukaguzi wa usalama ifikapo Septemba 30 kwa kutumia Mwongozo wa 2008.

Somali: Tilmaamaha badbaadada ee dib u furitaanka dugsiyada 2021.

Kiswahili: Okoa maji! Wafundishe wanafunzi uhifadhi wa maji katika maeneo yanayokabiliwa na ukame.

Kiswahili: Kataa rushwa! Ripoti vitendo vya ufisadi kwa EACC.
Dholuo: Tamri kawo asoya! Lando timbe mag mibadhi ne EACC.

Kiswahili: Sema hapana kwa ukeketaji! Piga simu 116 ili kuripoti hatari na kuwalinda wasichana.

Somali: Wac 116 si aad u sheegto khataraha iyo ilaalinta gabdhaha.

English: School records full transition to high school, expands vocational training.
Kiswahili: Shule inarekodi mpito kamili hadi shule ya upili, inapanua mafunzo ya ufundi.
Dholuo: Skundego chiwo thuolo mondo nyithindo odonj e skunde mamalo, kendo gipuonjogi tije mopogore opogore.
Somali: Dugsigu wuxuu diiwaangeliyaa gudbinta buuxda ee dugsiga sare, wuxuu ballaariyaa tababarka xirfadeed.

Dholuo: Tieguru jopuonj! Puonjuru nyithindo kaka ginyalo geng'o kolera.
Somali: Waxbarashada ka hortagga kolera dugsiyada.

English: Train teachers! Teach protest safety protocols.
Kiswahili: Wafundishe walimu! Wafundishe itifaki za usalama wa maandamano.
Dholuo: Tieguru jopuonj! Puonjgi yore mag ritruok sama itimo nyasi.
Somali: Tababar macallimiinta, baro nidaamyada badbaadada banaanbaxyada.

English: Travel safely! Use designated safe routes to school in conflict zones.
Kiswahili: Safiri salama! Tumia njia salama zilizotengwa kwenda shuleni katika maeneo yenye migogoro.
Dholuo: Dhi maber! Ti gi yore moket mag chopo e skul kuonde ma lweny nitie.
Somali: Si nabadgelyo leh u safra! Isticmaal waddooyinka ammaanka ah ee lagu magacaabo dugsiga meelaha colaadu ka taagan tahay.

English: Treasury gamifies budget learning for young audiences.
Kiswahili: Hazina hucheza kamari kuhusu ujifunzaji wa bajeti kwa hadhira changa.
