English: The Governor urged citizens to actively participate in the county's development journey.
Kiswahili: Gavana aliwasihi wananchi kushiriki kikamilifu katika safari ya maendeleo ya kaunti.
Dholuo: Gavana nojiwo raia duto mondo oriwre lwedo e wuodh dongruok e kaunti.
Somali: Guddoomiyuhu wuxuu muwaadiniinta ugu baaqay inay si firfircoon uga qaybqaataan safarka horumarinta gobolka.

English: He encouraged the group to apply for the County Enterprise Fund, which provides financial assistance to community organisations and youth and women's groups to implement their projects.
Kiswahili: Aliwahimiza kikundi hicho kuomba Mfuko wa Biashara wa Kaunti, ambao hutoa usaidizi wa kifedha kwa mashirika ya kijamii na vikundi vya vijana na wanawake ili kutekeleza miradi yao.
Dholuo: Ne ojiwo grubno mondo oket kwayo ne pesa mar chenro mag kaunti, ma chiwo kony mar pesa ne riwruoge mag oganda koda grube mag rowere kod mon mondo otiek chenrogi.
Somali: Wuxuu kooxda ku dhiiri geliyey inay dalbadaan Sanduuqa Ganacsiga Gobolka, kaas oo bixiya kaalmo dhaqaale ururada bulshada iyo kooxaha dhalinyarada iyo haweenka si ay u hirgeliyaan mashaariicdooda.

English: Governor Dr. Bii urged residents to remain vigilant and to make use of the county's healthcare services, especially during the festive period and the ongoing season of rites of passage.
Kiswahili: Gavana Dkt. Bii aliwasihi wakazi kuendelea kuwa macho na kutumia huduma za afya za kaunti, hasa wakati wa sherehe na msimu unaoendelea wa sherehe za kuaga mwili.
Dholuo: Gavana Laktar Bii nojiwo jodak mondo obed motang' kendo oti gi weche thieth mag loch gwenge, ahinya ahinya e kinde mag nyasi kod kindeni mag chenro mag tero ji nyange.
Somali: Guddoomiye Dr. Bii ayaa ku booriyay dadka deggan inay sii ahaadaan feejignaan iyo inay ka faa'iideystaan adeegyada daryeelka caafimaadka ee degmada, gaar ahaan xilliyada ciidaha iyo xilliyada socda ee xafladaha gudbinta.

English: The Commission urged all candidates and the public to maintain peace and order during the campaign period.
Kiswahili: Tume iliwasihi wagombea wote na umma kudumisha amani na utulivu wakati wa kipindi cha kampeni.
Dholuo: Komisenano nojiwo jolendo duto kaachiel gi ji duto mondo obed gi kuwe kod ler e kinde kampenno.
Somali: Guddiga ayaa ugu baaqay dhammaan musharixiinta iyo shacabka inay nabad iyo nidaam ilaaliyaan inta lagu jiro muddada ololaha.

English: Major roles of political parties include: Enhancing democratic participation through political mobilization by encouraging the public to participate in elections; and formulating public policies, recruitment and selection of political leaders.
Kiswahili: Majukumu makubwa ya vyama vya siasa ni pamoja na: Kuimarisha ushiriki wa kidemokrasia kupitia uhamasishaji wa kisiasa kwa kuhamasisha umma kushiriki katika uchaguzi; na kuunda sera za umma, kuajiri na kuchagua viongozi wa kisiasa.
Dholuo: Moko kuom gik madongo ma duod od buche mag siasa timo gin: Riwo lwedo loch mar sirkal kokalo kuom jiwo ji mondo oriwgi e yiero; kendo loso chike mag sirkal, ndiko kod yiero jotelo mag siasa.
Somali: Doorashada ugu weyn ee xisbiyada siyaasadeed waxaa ka mid ah: Kordhinta ka qaybgalka dimuqraadiyadda iyada oo loo marayo dhaqdhaqaaqa siyaasadeed iyada oo lagu dhiirigelinayo shacabka inay ka qaybgalaan doorashooyinka; iyo sameynta siyaasadaha dadweynaha, shaqaaleysiinta iyo xulashada hoggaamiyeyaasha siyaasadeed.

English: He urged residents to continue registering under the scheme to access free healthcare services, and to enable the government plan better for better health provision.
Kiswahili: Aliwasihi wakazi kuendelea kujiandikisha chini ya mpango huo ili kupata huduma za afya bila malipo, na kuwezesha mpango wa serikali kuwa bora zaidi kwa ajili ya utoaji bora wa afya.
Dholuo: Nojiwo jodak mondo odhi nyime timo chenro mar yudo thieth maonge chudo, kendo mano ne dhi miyo sirkal obed gi chenro maber mar yudo thieth.
Somali: Wuxuu dadka deggan ugu baaqay inay sii wadaan diiwaangelinta nidaamka si ay u helaan adeegyo daryeel caafimaad oo bilaash ah, iyo inay awood u yeeshaan qorshaha dowladda si ka wanaagsan si loo helo daryeel caafimaad oo wanaagsan.

English: The President said the government is constantly improving SHA to make it more efficient, weeding out criminal elements taking advantage of loopholes in the system to swindle the public.
Kiswahili: Rais alisema serikali inaboresha SHA kila mara ili kuifanya iwe na ufanisi zaidi, ikiondoa vipengele vya uhalifu kwa kutumia mianya katika mfumo huo ili kuwalaghai umma.
Dholuo: Ker nowacho ni sirkal medo timo dongruok ne chenro mar thieth mar SHA kinde ka kinde mondo omi obed gi nyak maber, kogolo timbe mahundu minyalo tigo e chenro no kaka yo mar chiko ji.
Somali: Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in dowladdu ay si joogto ah u hagaajineyso SHA si ay u noqoto mid wax ku ool ah, iyada oo la baabi'inayo qaybaha dambiyada ah iyagoo ka faa'iideysanaya godadka nidaamka si ay u khiyaanaynayaan dadweynaha.

English: Governor Mutai assured residents that measures have been put in place to ensure continuity of healthcare services.
Kiswahili: Gavana Mutai aliwahakikishia wakazi kwamba hatua zimechukuliwa ili kuhakikisha mwendelezo wa huduma za afya.
Dholuo: Jatend kaunti Mutai nosingo ne jopiny ni okang' mowinjore oseketi mar neno ni chenro mag weche thieth odhi nyime.
Somali: Guddoomiye Mutai wuxuu dadka deggan u xaqiijiyay in tallaabooyin lagu hirgaliyay si loo hubiyo joogteynta adeegyada daryeelka caafimaadka.

English: 750 million into project Thiba Dam site assets handed over to Kirinyaga County Government as Waiguru promises to convert it into hospital Waiguru backs President Ruto's Broad Based Government, urges residents to resist divisive leaders Sagana Industrial City to support farmers, create 150,000 jobs, Waiguru says as Ruto pledges to inject Ksh.
Kiswahili: Milioni 750 za mali za eneo la mradi wa Bwawa la Thiba zakabidhiwa kwa Serikali ya Kaunti ya Kirinyaga huku Waiguru akiahidi kulibadilisha kuwa hospitali Waiguru aiunga mkono Serikali ya Rais Ruto, awasihi wakazi kupinga viongozi wa mgawanyiko Sagana Industrial City ili kuwasaidia wakulima, kuunda ajira 150,000, Waiguru anasema huku Ruto akiahidi kuingiza Ksh.
Dholuo: pesa ma romo milion mia abiriyo gi prabich oket e chenro mar gero yao mar Thiba mwandu ma ochiw ne ksirkand kaunti ma Kirinyaga ka Waiguru nosingore ni gibiro loko mano obed osiptal. Waiguru osiro Sirkal ma manywanda mar President Ruto, ojiwo ji mondo okwed jotelo mag Sagana Industrial mondo okony jopur, kendo ne oketo tije alufu mia achiel gi piero aich Waiguru ne owacho ka Ruto singore mar rwako siling
Somali: 750 milyan oo doolar oo ah hantida mashruuca Thiba Dam ayaa loo wareejiyay Xukuumadda Gobolka Kirinyaga iyadoo Waiguru ay ballanqaadayso inay isbitaal ka dhigeyso Waiguru waxay taageertaa Xukuumadda Guud ee Madaxweyne Ruto, waxay ku boorineysaa dadka deggan inay iska caabinayaan hoggaamiyeyaasha kala qaybsanaanta ee Sagana Industrial City si ay u taageeraan beeraleyda, ay u abuuraan 150,000 oo shaqo, Waiguru ayaa sheegay in Ruto uu ballanqaaday inuu durbiyo Ksh.

English: He further pledged to work closely with Governor Timamy to foster unity in Lamu County, urging residents to shun divisive politics â '¬  especially those driven by tribal, religious, or regional differences â '¬  for the sake of progress.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya hayo, aliahidi kufanya kazi kwa karibu na Gavana Timamy ili kukuza umoja katika Kaunti ya Lamu, akiwahimiza wakazi kuepuka siasa za mgawanyiko - hasa zile zinazoendeshwa na tofauti za kikabila, kidini, au kikanda - kwa ajili ya maendeleo.
Dholuo: Ne omedo singore mar tiyo kanyachiel gi Gavana Timamy e jiwo winjruok e kaunti mar Lamu, kojiwo jogweng'no mondo owe siasa mag pogruok, to ahinya wuon jogo motenore gi pogruok mar oganda, din, kata alwora nikech dongruok.
Somali: Wuxuu sidoo kale ballanqaaday inuu si dhow ula shaqeyn doono Guddoomiye Timamy si kor loogu qaado midnimada Gobolka Lamu, isagoo ku booriyay dadka deggan inay ka fogaadaan siyaasadda kala qaybsanaanta - gaar ahaan kuwa ay keenaan farqiga beelaha, diimaha, ama gobollada - si loo horumariyo.

English: The County Government of Mandera encourages all eligible youth to take advantage of this life-changing opportunity and contribute to the county's development.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kaunti ya Mandera inawahimiza vijana wote wanaostahiki kutumia fursa hii inayobadilisha maisha na kuchangia katika maendeleo ya kaunti.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar kaunti ma Mandera jiwo rowere duto mowinjore mondo oti gi thuolono e kelo lokruok e ngimagi kendo okonyo e dongruok mar kaunti no.
Somali: Maamulka Degmada Mandera wuxuu ku dhiirigelinayaa dhamaan dhalinyarada u qalma inay ka faa'iideystaan fursadan nolosha beddelaya oo ay gacan ka geystaan horumarinta degmada.

English: Speaking after the awards in Nairobi, today, CECM for Finance Jones Omwenga said the county will continue engaging the public in its decisions for impact.
Kiswahili: Akizungumza baada ya tuzo hizo jijini Nairobi, leo, CECM for Finance Jones Omwenga alisema kaunti itaendelea kuwashirikisha umma katika maamuzi yake ya athari.
Dholuo: Kane owuoyo bang' yudo michgo Nairobi, kawuono CECM mar Pesa Jones Omwenga nowacho ni, kaunti no biro dhi nyime miyo ji duto thuolo mar ng'ado paro ewi gik ma biro timore kuom ber.
Somali: Isagoo ka hadlayay abaalmarinta ka dib Nairobi, maanta, CECM for Finance Jones Omwenga ayaa sheegay in gobolka uu sii wadi doono inuu dadweynaha ku lug yeesho go'aamada saameynta.

English: On behalf of the selection Panel, Mr Nyabuga assured members of the public and the governor that his team will exercise transparency and accountability when it commences to pick members of the County Service Board.
Kiswahili: Kwa niaba ya Jopo la uteuzi, Bw. Nyabuga aliwahakikishia umma na gavana kwamba timu yake itatekeleza uwazi na uwajibikaji itakapoanza kuwachagua wanachama wa Bodi ya Huduma ya Kaunti.
Dholuo: Kuom wach yiero mar Bura, Nyabuga nosingo ne ji duto kod gavana ni oganda mage biro tiyo gi thuolo kod ting' ka ochako yiero joma biro bedo e bod mar maloso chenro mar kaunti
Somali: Magaca Guddiga xulashada, Mr. Nyabuga wuxuu u xaqiijiyay shacabka iyo guddoomiyaha in kooxdiisa ay muujin doonto hufnaan iyo mas'uuliyad marka ay bilaabato xulashada xubnaha Guddiga Adeegga Gobolka.

English: ARTICLE 19 condemns Kenyan officials' use of violence and intimidation against students, the public, and journalists.
Kiswahili: KIFUNGU CHA 19 kinalaani matumizi ya vurugu na vitisho kwa maafisa wa Kenya dhidi ya wanafunzi, umma, na waandishi wa habari.
Dholuo: "Sula apar kod ochiko kwero jotend Piny Kenya tiyo kod lweny kod ayany ewi jopuonjre, oganda, koda jofwambo kod keyo.
Somali: QAYBTA 19 waxay cambaareysaa adeegsiga rabshadaha iyo cabsida ay mas'uuliyiinta Kenya u geystaan ardayda, dadweynaha, iyo suxufiyiinta.

English: We call on the policing authority to carry out immediate and transparent investigations into the actions, and for the government to be held accountable for its attempts to censor political commentary, artistic expression, and to block the public's access to information,' said Mugambi Kiai, Regional Director for ARTICLE 19 Eastern Africa.
Kiswahili: Tunatoa wito kwa mamlaka ya polisi kufanya uchunguzi wa haraka na wa uwazi kuhusu vitendo hivyo, na serikali iwajibike kwa majaribio yake ya kudhibiti maoni ya kisiasa, kujieleza kisanii, na kuzuia upatikanaji wa taarifa kwa umma,' alisema Mugambi Kiai, Mkurugenzi wa Kanda wa IBARA YA 19 Afrika Mashariki.
Dholuo: Wakwayo sirkal maloso chiek mondo otim nonro mapiyo kendo e yo maler kuom gik ma ne otimorego, kendo sirkal mondo okaw okang ' mar chiko paro mag siasa, wuoyo e yor kisera, kendo geng'o ji kik obed gi weche mang'eny ma ginyalo winjo, ' Ugwe, Mugambi Kiai mar sula apar gi ochiko sirkal mar Africa ma Ugwe nowacho.
Somali: Waxaan ugu baaqaynaa hay'adda booliiska inay fuliyaan baaritaano degdeg ah oo hufan oo ku saabsan tallaabooyinkaas, iyo in dowladda la xisaabtamo dadaallada ay ku tijaabiso faallooyinka siyaasadeed, muujinta farshaxanka, iyo xannibaadda helitaanka macluumaadka dadweynaha, "ayuu yiri Mugambi Kiai, Agaasimaha Gobolka ee ARTICLE 19 Bariga Afrika.

English: The government must facilitate people's right to protest, an important way for citizens to express themselves and participate in governance processes,' said Mugambi Kiai, ARTICLE 19 Eastern Africa Regional Director.
Kiswahili: Serikali lazima irahisishe haki ya watu ya kuandamana, njia muhimu kwa raia kujieleza na kushiriki katika michakato ya utawala,' alisema Mugambi Kiai, MAKALA YA 19 Mkurugenzi wa Kanda ya Afrika Mashariki.
Dholuo: Mugambi Kiai, sula mar apar kod ochiko Jatelo machiko gwenge ma Afrika ma Ugwe nowacho kama: ' Sirkal onego okony ratiro mar ji mar dhi e ng'anyo, ma en yo maduong ' ma raia nyalo nyisogo ni gihero loch.
Somali: "Dawladdu waa in ay fududeysaa xuquuqda dadka inay mudaaharaad sameeyaan, taas oo ah hab muhiim u ah muwaadiniinta inay ka hadlaan oo ay ka qaybqaataan geedi socodka maamulka", ayuu yiri Mugambi Kiai, Agaasimaha Gobolka ee ARTICLE 19 Bariga Afrika.

English: ARTICLE 19 urges the Independent International Fact-Finding Mission on Sudan and the International Criminal Court to specifically consider how the information war in Sudan exacerbates harm to civilians, obstructs vital documentation of gross human rights and humanitarian law violations, and contributes to the commission of crimes.
Kiswahili: KIFUNGU CHA 19 kinahimiza Ujumbe Huru wa Kimataifa wa Kutafuta Ukweli kuhusu Sudan na Mahakama ya Kimataifa ya Jinai kuzingatia mahususi jinsi vita vya habari nchini Sudan vinavyozidisha madhara kwa raia, kuzuia uandishi muhimu wa haki za binadamu na ukiukwaji mkubwa wa sheria za kibinadamu, na kuchangia katika utendaji wa uhalifu.
Dholuo: SULA MAR apar gi ochiko jiwo kamisen mar ratich oganda e piny mangima e piny Sudan kod od bura mar piny mangima mondo onon ahinya kaka lwenje mag weche e piny Sudan medo ketho ngima raia, geng'o weche motudore gi ratiro mag dhano kod ketho chike mag dhano, koda kaka gikonyo e tieko timbe mahundu.
Somali: Qodobka 19 wuxuu ku boorinayaa Howlgalka Xaqiijinta Caalamiga ah ee Madaxbanaan ee Suudaan iyo Maxkamadda Caddaaladda Caalamiga ah inay si gaar ah u tixgeliyaan sida dagaalka macluumaadka ee Suudaan uu u sii darayo waxyeelada dadka rayidka ah, u hortago dukumiintiyada muhiimka ah ee ku saabsan xadgudubyada waaweyn ee xuquuqda aadanaha iyo sharciga bani'aadamnimada, isla markaana uu gacan ka geysanayo dembiyada.

English: These violations have occurred amid deep political divisions and the fragmentation of state institutions, fostering a pervasive culture of impunity that undermines media freedom, journalists' safety, and the public's right to information.
Kiswahili: Ukiukaji huu umetokea katikati ya mgawanyiko mkubwa wa kisiasa na mgawanyiko wa taasisi za serikali, na kukuza utamaduni ulioenea wa kutokujali unaodhoofisha uhuru wa vyombo vya habari, usalama wa waandishi wa habari, na haki ya umma ya kupata habari.
Dholuo: Buono ni osetimore kata e kinde ma josiasa opogore kod riwruoge mag sirkal opogore ahinya, kendo mano osemiyo ji mang'eny ong'eyo ni onge ng'ato ang'ata ma nyalo ketho ratiro ma jondik gasede nigo mar timo yiero, rito ratiro ma jondik gasede nigo, kod ratiro ma ji nigo mar yudo weche.
Somali: Xadgudubyadaas waxay ka dhaceen khilaafyo siyaasadeed oo qoto dheer iyo kala qaybsanaanta hay'adaha dowladda, iyagoo kor u qaadey dhaqanka ciqaab la'aanta oo burburinaya xorriyadda warbaahinta, badbaadada suxufiyiinta, iyo xuquuqda shacabka inay helaan macluumaad.

English: Apr 15 - 4 min read PRIME Education CS now warns 'rogue' school officials He said co-curriculum activities should be based on the ministry's policies, guidelines and regulations.
Kiswahili: Aprili 15 - Dakika 4 za kusoma Waziri Mkuu wa Elimu sasa awaonya maafisa wa shule 'wakorofi' Alisema shughuli za mtaala sambamba zinapaswa kutegemea sera, miongozo na kanuni za wizara.
Dholuo: Dwe mar ang'wen tarik apar kod abich -ang'wen som jatend migao mar somo sani kwedo jotend skul maricho ne wacho ni weche tuke onego oketi e chike matayo somo , chike kod siem.
Somali: 15 Apr - 4 min akhri PRIME Waxbarashada CS hadda waxay uga digeysaa saraakiisha dugsiyada 'xanta' Wuxuu sheegay in waxqabadyada koorsooyinka ay ku saleysan yihiin siyaasadaha, tilmaamaha iyo xeerarka wasaaradda.

English: Accordingly, the Authority encourages members of the public to report all cases of corruption they encounter at the Authority using the following means; i.
Kiswahili: Kwa hivyo, Mamlaka inawahimiza wananchi kuripoti visa vyote vya rushwa wanavyokabiliana navyo katika Mamlaka kwa kutumia njia zifuatazo; i.

English: Members of the public are warned against engaging with fraudsters claiming to sell genuine examination papers as all official exams are securely administered and protected by strict integrity measures.
Kiswahili: Umma unaonywa dhidi ya kujihusisha na matapeli wanaodai kuuza karatasi halisi za mitihani kwani mitihani yote rasmi inasimamiwa kwa usalama na kulindwa na hatua kali za uadilifu.
Dholuo: Jopiny duto osiem kuom wach donjore gi jomibadhi mawacho ni giuso gpenj manenore ni gin adier, nikech penj duto mopwodhi itimo e yo maber kendo oriti gi chike mager matayo adiera.
Somali: Shacabka waxaa looga digay inay la xiriiraan khiyaanooyinka sheeganaya inay iibiyaan waraaqaha imtixaanka dhabta ah maadaama dhammaan imtixaannada rasmiga ah ay si ammaan ah u maamulaan oo ay ilaaliyaan tallaabooyin adag oo daacadnimo ah.

English: THE ASSEMBLY AND DEMONSTRATION BILL,2024 Read more KNCHR ADVISORY ON THE ASSEMBLY AND DEMONSTRATION BILL, 2024 Read more THE PUBLIC PARTICIPATION BILL, 2024 KNCHR in Collaboration with the Office of the Attorney General invites members of the public to give input in the draft Public participation Bill.
Kiswahili: MUSWADA WA BUNGE NA MAADHIMISHO, 2024 Soma zaidi USHAURI WA KNCHR KUHUSU MUSWADA WA BUNGE NA MAADHIMISHO, 2024 Soma zaidi MUSWADA WA USHIRIKI WA UMMA, 2024 KNCHR kwa Ushirikiano na Ofisi ya Mwanasheria Mkuu inawaalika wananchi kutoa maoni yao katika rasimu ya Mswada wa Ushiriki wa Umma.

English: Accident Investigation and WIBA Processing When an accident occurs, and an employee is injured, the employer must report to DOSHS County offices within 24 hours if the accident is fatal, and within 7 days for non-fatal accidents.
Kiswahili: Uchunguzi wa Ajali na Usindikaji wa WIBA Wakati ajali inatokea, na mfanyakazi akaumia, mwajiri lazima aripoti kwa ofisi za Kaunti ya DOSHS ndani ya saa 24 ikiwa ajali hiyo ni mbaya, na ndani ya siku 7 kwa ajali zisizo mbaya.
Dholuo: Nonro mar masich apaya kod chenro mar WIBA e kinde ma masich apaya otimore, kendo jatich oyudo hinyruok, jatelo onego ochiw ripot ne apise mar kaunti mar DOSHS motelo ne seche piero ariyo kod ang'wen ka masira no rach ahinya kendo motelo ne ndalo abiriyo ka masich apaya no ok lich ahinya.
Somali: Cilmi-baarista shilalka iyo ka baaraandegista WIBA Haddii shil dhaco, shaqaaluhuna dhaawacmay, shaqo-bixiyuhu waa inuu 24 saacadood gudahood u soo sheegaa xafiisyada Gobolka DOSHS haddii shilku yahay mid dhimasho leh, iyo 7 maalmood gudahood shilalka aan dhimasho lahayn.

English: Different electoral bodies in Kenya, from ECK, IIEC, to IEBC, have had a topsy-turvy trust relationship with the public.
Kiswahili: Miili tofauti ya uchaguzi nchini Kenya, kuanzia ECK, IIEC, hadi IEBC, imekuwa na uhusiano wa uaminifu na umma usio na matumaini.

English: The law is very clear, we must embrace every aspect of humanity in the public service, including the full inclusion and participation of persons with disabilities, Dr. Kiprono stated.
Kiswahili: Sheria iko wazi kabisa, ni lazima tukumbatie kila kipengele cha ubinadamu katika utumishi wa umma, ikiwa ni pamoja na ushirikishwaji kamili na ushiriki wa watu wenye ulemavu, Dkt. Kiprono alisema.

English: MAKE PEACE 'It's not your war': Ukraine's military ombud warns Africans against joining Russia's fight As South Africa probes how 17 of its citizens ended up in Ukraine's Donbas region, Kyiv's military ombud Olha Reshetylova urges Africans to resist Moscow's recruitment and avoid a war that offers them no protection.
Kiswahili: TENGENEZA AMANI 'Sio vita yako': Mchunguzi wa kijeshi wa Ukraine awaonya Waafrika dhidi ya kujiunga na mapambano ya Urusi Huku Afrika Kusini ikichunguza jinsi raia wake 17 walivyoishia katika eneo la Donbas nchini Ukraine, mchunguzi wa kijeshi wa Kyiv Olha Reshetylova anawasihi Waafrika kupinga kuajiriwa na Moscow na kuepuka vita ambavyo haviwapi ulinzi wowote.
Dholuo: Timuru kwe 'Ok en Lweny maru': Ombud mar jolwennj Ukraine chiwo siem ne Jo-Afrika ni kik gidonj e lweny mar Russia ka South Africa neno kaka Jo-Ukraine apr kod abiriyo osetho e Donbas, Ombud Olga jiwo Jo-Afrika mondo okwed tich ma Moscow timo kendo gitang' gi lweny ma miyo gibedo maonge arita.
Somali: Nabada samee 'Ma aha dagaalkaaga': Wasiirka ciidamada Yukreeniyaanku wuxuu uga digay dadka Afrikaanka ah inay ku biiraan dagaalka Ruushka Iyadoo Koonfur Afrika ay baaritaan ku sameyneyso sida 17 muwaadin oo ka mid ah muwaadiniinteeda ay ugu dambeyn ugu gaareen gobolka Donbas ee Ukraine, wasiirka ciidamada ee Kyiv Olha Reshetylova ayaa ku booriyay dadka Afrikaanka ah inay iska caabiyaan musuqmaasuqa Moscow iyo inay ka fogaadaan dagaal aan u bixin ilaalinta.

English: In a speech read on his behalf by the KPC General Manager Finance, Pius Mwendwa during the facility's soft launch, Sang said the successful launch of the facility heralds a new paradigm in the reticulation of the product with immense benefits to the public.
Kiswahili: Katika hotuba iliyosomwa kwa niaba yake na Meneja Mkuu wa Fedha wa KPC, Pius Mwendwa wakati wa uzinduzi wa kituo hicho, Sang alisema uzinduzi uliofanikiwa wa kituo hicho unaashiria dhana mpya katika ujumuishaji wa bidhaa hiyo yenye faida kubwa kwa umma.
Dholuo: E twak ma nogolo e loye kod meneja mar omenda ma mwanywanda KPC Pius Mwende e odiechieng ' ma ne ochakgo tijno, Sang nowacho ni chako tijno e yo maber ne dhi kelo ber mang'eny ne jopiny.
Somali: Khudbad uu ka jeediyay Agaasimaha Guud ee Maaliyadda ee KPC, Pius Mwendwa intii lagu jiray bilowgii jilicsan ee xarunta, Sang wuxuu sheegay in bilowgii guusha ee xarunta uu ku dhawaaqayo qaab cusub oo ku saabsan isku xirnaanta badeecada oo faa'iidooyin weyn u leh dadweynaha.

English: Development cooperation agreements - Norway in Kenya Skip to main content Development cooperation agreements As a means of increasing transparency and accountability, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs wishes to make all its agreements available to the public.
Kiswahili: Mikataba ya ushirikiano wa maendeleo - Norway nchini Kenya Ruka hadi maudhui kuu Mikataba ya ushirikiano wa maendeleo Kama njia ya kuongeza uwazi na uwajibikaji, Wizara ya Mambo ya Nje inataka kutoa mikataba yake yote kwa umma.
Dholuo: Winjruok mar dongruok - Norway e Kenya chikri nyaka e weche mochuno riwruok mar dongruok kaka yo mar bero ler, migao mar weche maoko gombo mondo oket winjruok mantie ne jopiny.

English: Submit a Letter of Intent If a country passes the Core Eligibility Criteria and Values Check and the government identified a lead ministry or agency, it should signal its intent to participate in OGP by sending a Letter of Intent, which formally expresses the government's intention to join OGP.
Kiswahili: Wasilisha Barua ya Nia Ikiwa nchi itapita Vigezo vya Msingi vya Ustahiki na Ukaguzi wa Maadili na serikali ikatambua wizara au shirika linaloongoza, inapaswa kuashiria nia yake ya kushiriki katika OGP kwa kutuma Barua ya Nia, ambayo inaelezea rasmi nia ya serikali ya kujiunga na OGP.
Dholuo: Chiw barua mar chiwruok kapo ni piny moro oseng'ado chike moting'o chike kod weche mochuno, kendo sirkal osefwenyo ni en gi migawo kata riwruok ma tayo tij lendo, sirkal onego onyis ni odwaro riwo lwedo OGP kuom oro barua mar chiwruok ma nyiso ni sirkal dwaro riwo lwedo OGP.
Somali: Soo gudbi Warqad Ujeeddo Haddii waddan ay ka gudubto Qiimeynta Qiimeynta iyo Qiimeynta Qiimeynta, dowladuna ay aqoonsatay wasaarad ama hay'ad hoggaamineysa, waa inay calaamadeysaa ujeeddadeeda in ay ka qaybqaataan OGP adoo soo diraya Warqad Ujeeddo, oo si rasmi ah u muujineysa ujeeddada dowladda ee ku biirista OGP.

English: Access to Justice Justice for Accountability Open Justice Public Participation Giving the public opportunities to provide input into government decision-making leads to more effective governance, improved public service delivery, and more equitable outcomes.
Kiswahili: Upatikanaji wa Haki Haki kwa Uwajibikaji Haki Huria Ushiriki wa Umma Kuwapa umma fursa za kutoa maoni katika maamuzi ya serikali husababisha utawala bora zaidi, utoaji bora wa huduma za umma, na matokeo ya usawa zaidi.
Dholuo: Bedo gi ratiro mar timo gik moko e yo makare, miyo ji thuolo mar chiwo pachgi e weche ma sirkal ong'ado, miyo sirkal bedo gi loch maber, miyo tije mag sirkal bedo maber, kendo kelo nyak machalre.
Somali: Helitaanka Cadaaladda Cadaaladda Xisaabtanka Cadaaladda Furan Kaqaybgalka Dadweynaha Fursadaha dadweynaha si ay uga qaybqaataan go'aan qaadashada dawladda waxay keenaan maamul ka shaqeyn badan, bixinta adeegyada dadweynaha oo hagaagsan, iyo natiijooyin cadaalad ah.

English: Public participation and inclusion: Governments seek to mobilize citizens to engage in public debate, provide input, and make contributions that lead to more responsive, innovative and effective governance.
Kiswahili: Ushiriki na ujumuishaji wa umma: Serikali zinalenga kuwahamasisha raia kushiriki katika mijadala ya umma, kutoa maoni, na kutoa michango inayoongoza kwa utawala sikivu zaidi, bunifu na wenye ufanisi.
Dholuo: Riwruok kod chenro mag oganda: Sirkande dwaro jiwo raia mondo oriwre e mbaka mag oganda, ochiw paro, kendo ochiw chiwo mamiyo sirkal bedo gi paro mowinjore, kendo telo maber.
Somali: Ka qaybgalka dadweynaha iyo ka mid noqoshada: Dowladaha waxay doonayaan inay shacabka u soo ururiyaan inay ka qaybqaataan doodda dadweynaha, inay bixiyaan talooyin, oo ay gacan ka geystaan maamul ka jawaab celin badan, hal-abuurnimo iyo waxtar leh.

English: Collaborate: The government and non-governmental stakeholder should hold an ongoing iterative dialogue where the public contributes to identifying priorities, setting the agenda and developing the commitments.
Kiswahili: Shirikiana: Serikali na wadau wasio wa kiserikali wanapaswa kufanya mazungumzo yanayoendelea ambapo umma huchangia katika kutambua vipaumbele, kuweka ajenda na kuendeleza ahadi.
Dholuo: Riwri: Sirkal kod riwruoge mamoko onego otim mbaka ma kinde ka kinde ma ji duto oriwe lwedo mondo ging'e gik monego giket motelo e ngimagi, gichop chenro mag gik ma gidwaro timo, kendo gitim gik ma gidwaro timo.
Somali: Iskaashi: Dowladda iyo daneeyayaasha aan dawliga ahayn waa inay wadahadal joogto ah oo soo noqnoqda sameeyaan halka ay dadweynuhu gacan ka geystaan aqoonsashada mudnaanta, dejinta ajandaha iyo horumarinta ballanqaadyada.

English: How we're helping to improve access to sexual health services We push for political participation We help women vote and participate in politics by partnering with governments, community groups and local associations.
Kiswahili: Jinsi tunavyosaidia kuboresha upatikanaji wa huduma za afya ya ngono Tunasukuma ushiriki wa kisiasa Tunawasaidia wanawake kupiga kura na kushiriki katika siasa kwa kushirikiana na serikali, vikundi vya jamii na vyama vya ndani.
Dholuo: Kaka wakonyo e miyo weche thieth mag ng'ango obed mayot, e kaka wakonyo mon mondo ochiwre e weche siasa, kendo wakonyo mon mondo ochiwre e weche siasa ka wariwore gi sirkal, riwruoge mag oganda, kod riwruoge mag alwora.
Somali: Sida aan u caawineyno hagaajinta helitaanka adeegyada caafimaadka galmada Waxaan ku riixnaa ka qaybgalka siyaasadeed Waxaan ka caawineynaa haweenka inay codeeyaan oo ay ka qeyb galaan siyaasadda iyagoo iskaashi la leh dawladaha, kooxaha bulshada iyo ururada deegaanka.

English: The result, our Anti-Corruption Enforcement Tracker helps campaigners build an evidence base for reform of anti-corruption enforcement, provides journalists and members of the public with accessible and clear statistics, and encourages the government to collect and publish its data in more accessible and accurate ways.
Kiswahili: Matokeo yake, Kifuatiliaji chetu cha Kupambana na Rushwa huwasaidia wanaharakati kujenga msingi wa ushahidi wa mageuzi ya utekelezaji wa kupambana na rushwa, huwapa waandishi wa habari na umma takwimu zinazopatikana kwa urahisi na wazi, na huhimiza serikali kukusanya na kuchapisha data yake kwa njia zinazopatikana kwa urahisi na sahihi zaidi.
Dholuo: Duoko gima nono mibadhi konyo joma kedo ne mibadhi e loso gik ma nyiso ni gisetimo mibadhi, ochiwo ne jofwambo kod jopiny weche ma ginyalo ng'eyo, kendo ojiwo sirkal mondo ochok kendo ogol weche ma kamago e yo mong'ere kendo makare.
Somali: Natiijo ahaan, raadraaca la dagaalanka la dagaalanka musuqmaasuqa wuxuu ka caawiyaa ololayaasha inay dhisaan saldhig caddeyn ah oo loogu talagalay isbeddelka la dagaalanka musuqmaasuqa, wuxuu siinayaa suxufiyiinta iyo xubnaha dadweynaha tirakoobka la heli karo oo cad, wuxuuna ku dhiiri gelinayaa dowladda inay ururiso oo daabacdo xogteeda siyaabo la heli karo oo sax ah.

English: 1:11 pm Public Health PS Mary Muthoni urges parents and communities to safeguard teens during holidays, highlighting risks of drugs and peer pressure that lead to unwanted pregnancies.
Kiswahili: Saa 1:11 usiku Katibu Mkuu wa Afya ya Umma Mary Muthoni anawasihi wazazi na jamii kuwalinda vijana wakati wa likizo, akisisitiza hatari za dawa za kulevya na shinikizo la rika zinazosababisha mimba zisizohitajika.

English: The members of the public are warned to beware of scammers who are approaching individuals on WhatsApp with their numbers showing a profile photo of the CCF Kenya, Mr Alex Lemarkoko.
Kiswahili: Umma unaonywa kuwa waangalifu na matapeli wanaowakaribia watu binafsi kwenye WhatsApp huku nambari zao zikionyesha picha ya wasifu wa CCF Kenya, Bw. Alex Lemarkoko.
Dholuo: Jopiny osenyis ni gibed motang' gi joma wuondo ji ka gitiyo gi WhatsApp kod namba ma nyiso picha mar CCF ma Kenya, Mr. Alex Lemarkoko.
Somali: Shacabka waxaa looga digay in ay ka digtoonaadaan khiyaanooyinka ku soo dhowaada dadka WhatsApp iyagoo lambarradoodu muujinayaan muuqaal muuqaal ah oo ku saabsan CCF Kenya, Mr Alex Lemarkoko.

English: On the recruitment day, candidates must report to designated centres by 8am with the original and copies of their academic certificates, ID cards, birth certificates, and, where applicable, NYS discharge certificates with at least a 'GOOD' conduct rating.
Kiswahili: Siku ya kuajiri, wagombea lazima waripoti katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa ifikapo saa 2 asubuhi wakiwa na cheti halisi na nakala za vyeti vyao vya kitaaluma, vitambulisho, vyeti vya kuzaliwa, na, inapohitajika, vyeti vya kufukuzwa vya NYS vyenye angalau ukadiriaji wa 'GOOD' wa mwenendo.
Dholuo: E odiechieng ' mar ndikruok , joma ndikore nyaka chiw ripot kuonde moyier kar sa aboro okinyi ka gin gi oboke kod kopi mag otese mag somo, opande,barua mar nyuol kod kama owinjore NYS chiwo obok man kod alama mar tim maber.
Somali: Maalinta shaqaalaysiinta, musharixiintu waa inay u soo bandhigaan xarumaha loo qoondeeyey saacadaha 8 subaxnimo iyagoo leh asalka iyo nuqulka shahaadooyinkooda waxbarasho, kaararka aqoonsiga, shahaadooyinka dhalashada, iyo, haddii ay khuseyso, shahaadooyinka ka bixitaanka NYS oo leh ugu yaraan qiimeyn "GOOD".

English: The agency also appealed to the public to report any suspicious individuals or activities that could help in ongoing investigations.

English: The President used the occasion to urge citizens to embrace their democratic rights ahead of the elections.
Kiswahili: Rais alitumia fursa hiyo kuwasihi raia kukumbatia haki zao za kidemokrasia kabla ya uchaguzi.
Dholuo: Jatelo ne otiyo gi thuolono e jiwo raia mondo oyie gi ratiro ma gin-go mar timo yiero.

Kiswahili: DCI ilisema huku ikiwahimiza umma kuripoti shughuli zozote zinazotiliwa shaka.
Dholuo: DCI nowacho ka ojiwo ji mondo ochiw ripot ewi tim moramora ma achach.
Somali: DCI waxay sheegtay iyadoo ugu baaqaysa shacabka inay soo sheegaan waxqabadyada shakiga ah.

English: By 5 months ago DIG Lagat warns officers to desist from corruption Days after prisoners escaped from lawful custody at a court in Siaya, Deputy Inspector General Eliud Lagat toured the county and urged officers to maintain professionalism and teamwork.
Kiswahili: Kufikia miezi 5 iliyopita DIG Lagat awaonya maafisa kuacha ufisadi Siku chache baada ya wafungwa kutoroka kutoka kizuizini halali katika mahakama huko Siaya, Naibu Inspekta Jenerali Eliud Lagat alizuru kaunti hiyo na kuwasihi maafisa kudumisha weledi na ushirikiano.
Dholuo: Dweche abich mosekalo ka ne ogolo gwenge mag Lagat, ne osiemo jotelo mondo owe timbe mag mibadhi bang ' ka joma otwe ne oseyudo thuolo mar tony e kot e taon mar Siaya, Jachiwo mar jatend obila Eliud Lagat ne ofwenyo gweng'no kendo ne odwaro ni jotelogo odhi nyime gi tijgi mar tiegruok.
Somali: 5 bilood ka hor DIG Lagat ayaa ka digay saraakiisha inay ka tanaasulaan musuqmaasuqa Maalmo ka dib markii maxaabiista ay ka baxsadeen xadhiga sharciga ah ee maxkamad ku taal Siaya, Taliye ku xigeenka Guud Eliud Lagat ayaa booqday gobolka wuxuuna ku booriyay saraakiisha inay ilaaliyaan xirfadda iyo shaqada kooxda.

English: EACC reaffirms its commitment to combating fraud and safeguarding integrity within the public service sector, a statement from the commission said.
Kiswahili: EACC inathibitisha tena kujitolea kwake kupambana na ulaghai na kulinda uadilifu ndani ya sekta ya utumishi wa umma, taarifa kutoka kwa tume hiyo ilisema.
Dholuo: EACC osesingore mar kedo gi mibadhi kendo rito tim makare e tije mag sirkal, kaluwore gi weche mowuok kuom kamisona.
Somali: EACC waxay dib u xaqiijineysaa ballanqaadkeeda la dagaalanka khiyaanada iyo ilaalinta daacadnimada qeybta adeegyada dadweynaha, sida lagu sheegay bayaan ka soo baxay guddiga.

English: In a schedule provided by the Chief Justice Martha Koome-led JSC, the public interviews will run from January 12 to March 23 2026.

Somali: Sida ku cad jadwalka ay soo bandhigtay Garsoorka Sare ee Martha Koome, JSC, wareysiyada dadweynaha waxay socon doonaan 12-ka Janaayo ilaa 23-ka Maarso 2026.

English: The CRJ said members of the public are invited to avail in writing any information of interest in respect to any of the shortlisted candidates.
Kiswahili: CRJ ilisema umma unakaribishwa kutoa taarifa yoyote ya kimaandishi inayomhusu yeyote kati ya wagombea walioorodheshwa.
Dholuo: CRJ ne owacho ni ji duto ne ogwel mondo okonygi kuom ndiko weche moro amora motenore kod jogo mane osekaw mondo ondiki.

Kiswahili: EACC inawasihi raia kutowachagua watu wanaokabiliwa na mashtaka ya ufisadi.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo ji mondo kik giyier jotelo ma itudo gi weche mag mibadhi.
Somali: EACC waxay muwaadiniinta ugu baaqeysaa inaysan dooran dadka lagu eedeeyay musuq maasuq.

English: IEBC urges students to take this opportunity to register as voters.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawasihi wanafunzi kutumia fursa hii kujiandikisha kama wapiga kura.
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo jopuonjre mondo oti gi thuoloni e ndikruok kaka jogo ombulu.
Somali: IEBC waxay ardayda ugu baaqeysaa inay fursadan ka faa'iideystaan inay iska diiwaangeliyaan codbixiyayaasha.

English: Director Voter Education, Partnerships and Communication Rasi Masudi urges participants to cover all activities of the electoral process in a workshop to review Frequently Asked Questions and Voter Education Guide
Kiswahili: Mkurugenzi Elimu ya Mpiga Kura, Ushirikiano na Mawasiliano Rasi Masudi anawasihi washiriki kuangazia shughuli zote za mchakato wa uchaguzi katika warsha ili kupitia Maswali Yanayoulizwa Mara kwa Mara na Mwongozo wa Elimu ya Mpiga Kura
Dholuo: Jatelo mar Puonjo weche yiero, Komiti mag Winjruok kod Wuoyo, Rasi Masudi, jiwo jokanyo mondo owuo e wi weche duto motudore gi yiero e chokruok mar nono penjo ma ji penjoga ahinya kod puonj motenore kod weche yiero.
Somali: Agaasimaha Waxbarashada Codbixiyayaasha, Wada-hawlgalayaasha iyo Isgaarsiinta Rasi Masudi ayaa ka codsaday kaqeybgalayaasha inay daboolaan dhammaan hawlaha geedi socodka doorashada ee aqoon isweydaarsi lagu eego dib u eegista Su'aalaha Badanaa La Is Weydiiyo iyo Tilmaamaha Waxbarashada Codbixiyayaasha

English: EACC urges Kenyans to report all forms of corruption for investigation.
Kiswahili: EACC inawasihi Wakenya kuripoti aina zote za ufisadi kwa ajili ya uchunguzi.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo Jo-Kenya mondo ochiw ripot e wi kit mibadhi duto.
Somali: EACC waxay ku boorineysaa dadka Kenya inay soo sheegaan dhammaan noocyada musuqmaasuqa si baaritaan loogu sameeyo.

English: The Commission urges all agencies involved in the issuance of National Identity cards to fast-track the issuance and distribution of the IDs to enable Kenyans who have attained the age of 18 to be registered as voters.
Kiswahili: Tume inazihimiza mashirika yote yanayohusika katika utoaji wa vitambulisho vya kitaifa kuharakisha utoaji na usambazaji wa vitambulisho hivyo ili kuwawezesha Wakenya waliofikisha umri wa miaka 18 kusajiliwa kama wapiga kura.
Dholuo: Kamisen jiwo riwruoge duto motudore gi chiwo opande mondo otim kinda mapiyo e chiwo kod pogo opande mondo omi Jo-Kenya ma osetieko higni apar kod aboro ondiki kaka jogo ombulu.
Somali: Guddiga ayaa ku boorinaya dhammaan hay'adaha ku lug leh soo saarista kaararka aqoonsiga qaranka inay si dhakhso leh ula socdaan soo saarista iyo qaybinta aqoonsiga si ay u oggolaadaan dadka Kenya ee gaadhay da'da 18 sano inay u diiwaangeliyaan sida codbixiyeyaasha.

English: EACC urges every Kenyan to always uphold integrity and proactively participate in the fight against corruption.
Kiswahili: EACC inamsihi kila Mkenya kudumisha uadilifu na kushiriki kikamilifu katika vita dhidi ya ufisadi.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo ji duto manie piny Kenya mondo omak tim makare kendo okonygi kedo gi mibadhi.
Somali: EACC waxay ku boorineysaa qof kasta oo reer Kenya ah inuu had iyo jeer ilaaliyo daacadnimada iyo inuu si firfircoon uga qaybqaato la dagaalanka musuqmaasuqa.

English: YOUR ROLE AS A CITIZEN 1. Shun corruption, do not tolerate or support it 2. Report any suspected corrupt conduct 3. Desist from glorifying corruptly acquired wealth. 5. Demand accountability from leaders 6. Return any stolen public property in your possession 7. Obey the law
Kiswahili: JUKUMU LAKO KAMA RAIA 1. Epuka ufisadi, usivumilie au kuuunga mkono 2. Ripoti mwenendo wowote unaoshukiwa wa ufisadi 3. Epuka kusifu utajiri uliopatikana kwa ufisadi. 5. Dai uwajibikaji kutoka kwa viongozi 6. Rudisha mali yoyote ya umma iliyoibiwa uliyonayo 7. Tii sheria
Dholuo: Ting' ma in-go kaka raia mokwongo. We timbe mag mibadhi, geng'gi, kata riwogi lwedo. mar airyo . Land timbe duto mag mibadhi. mar adek. We miyo mwandu ma ji yudo nikech mibadhi duong'. mar abich. Chiko jotelo mondo gikonygi. mar auchiel. Duoko mwandu duto mag sirkal ma in-go. mar abiriyo. Luwo Chik
Somali: 1. Ka fogow musuqmaasuqa, ha u dulqaadanina ama ha u taageerinina. 2. Warbixi wax kasta oo lagu tuhmo in musuqmaasuq lagu sameeyay. 3. Iska daaya in aad ammaanto hantida musuqmaasuq lagu helay. 5. Madaxda ka codso xisaabinta. 6. Soo celi hantida dawladda ee lagaa xaday. 7. Xeerka addeeca.

English: (EACC) urges Kenyans to be vigilant and avoid falling prey to fraudsters issuing fake integrity clearance letters at a fee
Kiswahili: (EACC) inawahimiza Wakenya kuwa macho na kuepuka kunaswa na matapeli wanaotoa barua bandia za uadilifu kwa ada
Dholuo: IECC jiwo jokenya mondo obed motang' kendo kik giyudre kod achudhe machiwo kad ma adiera kuom kawo omenda.
Somali: (EACC) waxay ugu baaqeysaa dadka Kenya inay feejignaadaan oo ay ka fogaadaan inay noqdaan dhibanayaasha khiyaanooyinka soo saara waraaqaha saxda ah ee loo yaqaan 'integrity clearance letters' oo lacag lagu bixiyo

English: IEBCKenya urges eligible diaspora voters in USA, Germany, South Africa, Tanzania, Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi & South Sudan to come out & register before Feb 4 deadline
Kiswahili: IEBCKenya yawahimiza wapiga kura wanaostahiki kutoka nje ya nchi nchini Marekani, Ujerumani, Afrika Kusini, Tanzania, Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi na Sudan Kusini kujitokeza na kujiandikisha kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya Februari 4.
Dholuo: Duol mar yiero mar IEBC e piny Kenya ojiwo jotelo mag pinje mag Amerka, Germany, Afrika ma milambo , Tanzania, Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi kod South Sudan mondo owuog e pinyno kapok tarik ang'wen dwe mar ariyo ochopo .
Somali: IEBCKenya waxay ku boorineysaa codbixiyayaasha u qalma dibadda ee ku nool Mareykanka, Jarmalka, Koonfur Afrika, Tansaaniya, Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi & South Sudan inay soo baxaan oo ay iska diiwaangeliyaan ka hor 4da Febraayo.

English: IEBCKenya urges citizens who are not registered but are eligible to take advantage of this last week to enlist as voters
Kiswahili: IEBCKenya inawasihi raia ambao hawajajiandikisha lakini wanastahili kutumia fursa ya wiki hii iliyopita kujiandikisha kama wapiga kura
Dholuo: Duol mar yiero e piny kenya jiwo ji duto ma ok osendikore kaka jogo ombulu mondo okaw thuolo mar juma mogik mar ndiko nyinggi kaka jogo ombulu.
Somali: IEBCKenya waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta aan diiwaangelin laakiin xaq u leh inay ka faa'iideystaan todobaadkii la soo dhaafay si ay u diiwaangeliyaan codbixiyayaasha

English: IEBCKenya urges voters, candidates and agents to maintain order at polling stations and avoid wearing or carrying campaign materials
Kiswahili: IEBCKenya inawasihi wapiga kura, wagombea na mawakala kudumisha utulivu katika vituo vya kupigia kura na kuepuka kuvaa au kubeba vifaa vya kampeni
Dholuo: Duol mar yiero e piny kenye jiwo jogo ombulu, joslar kombe kod jochung' mondo oket arita kwe e kuonde goyo ombulu kendo kik girwak kata ting'o gige kampen
Somali: IEBCKenya waxay codbixiyayaasha, musharixiinta iyo wakiillada ku boorineysaa in ay nidaamka ka ilaaliyaan goobaha codbixinta isla markaana ay ka fogaadaan inay xirtaan ama qaataan qalabka ololaha

English: IEBC urges citizens to unconditionally embrace peaceful elections & shun violence that is retrogressive to our economic growth and social cohesion.
Kiswahili: IEBC inawasihi raia kukumbatia uchaguzi wa amani bila masharti na kuepuka vurugu ambazo zinarudisha nyuma ukuaji wetu wa uchumi na mshikamano wa kijamii.
Dholuo: Duol mar yiero e piny kenya jiwo raia mondo orwak yiero mar kwe maonge chik kendo gitang' gi timbe mahundu ma nyalo thiro dongruok mar ohala kod winjruok e kind oganda.
Somali: IEBC waxay muwaadiniinta ugu baaqeysaa inay si shuruud la'aan ah u aqbalaan doorashooyinka nabadeed & ka fogaadaan rabshadaha ka soo horjeeda koritaanka dhaqaalaha iyo isdhexgalka bulshada.

English: Kenya Wildlife Service urges all our amazing visitors to our breathtaking National Parks to join hands in preserving the beauty of our wildlife and natural landscapes.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Wanyamapori ya Kenya inawasihi wageni wetu wote wa ajabu kwenye Hifadhi zetu za Kitaifa za kuvutia kuungana mkono katika kuhifadhi uzuri wa wanyamapori wetu na mandhari ya asili.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar le mag bunge e piny Kenya jiwo ji duto ma biro limowa e pewe magwa mag le mondo oriwre lwedo e rito kit le kod yiende mabeyo ma wan - go.
Somali: Hay'adda Kenya Wildlife Service waxay ku boorineysaa dhamaan booqdayaasheena cajiibka ah ee ku yimaada jardiinooyinkayaga qaranka inay iskaashi ku sameeyaan ilaalinta quruxda duurjoogta iyo muuqaalada dabiiciga ah.

English: EACC urges all professional bodies in the country to infuse integrity and accountability in their self-regulatory mechanisms to enhance corruption intolerance among Kenyan professionals
Kiswahili: EACC inazihimiza taasisi zote za kitaaluma nchini kuingiza uadilifu na uwajibikaji katika mifumo yao ya kujidhibiti ili kuongeza uvumilivu wa ufisadi miongoni mwa wataalamu wa Kenya.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo jolony duto e pinyno mondo otim gik moko e yo makare kendo e yo mowinjore mondo omi joma olony e Kenya obed gi chuny mar tiyo maonge gi mibadhi
Somali: EACC waxay ugu baaqeysaa dhamaan hay'adaha xirfadeed ee dalka inay daacadnimo iyo mas'uuliyad ku darsadaan nidaamyadooda is-xakamaynta si kor loogu qaado dulqaadka musuqmaasuqa ee ka dhexeeya xirfadlayaasha Kenya

English: The Commission urges Machakos voters to turn out & exercise their democratic right
Kiswahili: Tume yawahimiza wapiga kura wa Machakos kujitokeza na kutumia haki yao ya kidemokrasia
Dholuo: Kamisen'no dwaro ni josiasa ma Machakos owuog oko kendo giti gi ratiro ma gin-go mar timo yiero.
Somali: Guddiga ayaa ugu baaqay codbixiyayaasha Machakos inay soo baxaan oo ay adeegsadaan xuquuqdooda dimuqraadiga ah

English: The registrar @ORPPKenya, Anne Nderitu urges parliament to fast track the enactment of election-related legislation. Late enactments negatively affect the planning of elections.
Kiswahili: Msajili @ORPPKenya, Anne Nderitu anahimiza bunge kuharakisha utekelezaji wa sheria zinazohusiana na uchaguzi. Kupitishwa kwa sheria kuchelewa kunaathiri vibaya upangaji wa uchaguzi.
Dholuo: Anne Nderitu, ma en jagoro mar @orppkenya, jiwo Bura mondo orit mapiyo kaka chike motudore gi yiero tiyo. Keto chike modeko thiro chenro mag yiero.
Somali: Diiwaanka @ORPPKenya, Anne Nderitu waxay Baarlamaanka ugu baaqeysaa inay si dhakhso leh ula socdaan ansixinta sharciyada la xiriira doorashooyinka.

English: NGECKenya representative Winnie Wambua calls for collaboration & asks participants to work together to ensure violence does not impede women from vying for political seats & urges participants to start a campaign to have men support women secure positions of leadership
Kiswahili: Mwakilishi wa NGECKenya Winnie Wambua atoa wito wa ushirikiano na kuwaomba washiriki kufanya kazi pamoja ili kuhakikisha vurugu hazizuii wanawake kugombea viti vya kisiasa na kuwahimiza washiriki kuanzisha kampeni ili wanaume wawaunge mkono wanawake kupata nafasi za uongozi.
Dholuo: Jachung' mar NGECKenya, Winnie Wambua, ogwelo ji duto mondo oriwre lwedo mondo timbe mahundu kik geng' mon kik donj e loch mag siasa kendo ojiwo ji duto mondo ochak kampen mar konyo chwo mondo oriw lwedo mon e migepe mag telo.
Somali: Wakiilka NGOECKenya Winnie Wambua waxay ku baaqeysaa wada shaqeyn & waxay ka codsaneysaa ka qaybgalayaasha inay wada shaqeeyaan si loo hubiyo in rabshaduhu aysan ka hortagin haweenka inay ku tartamaan kuraasta siyaasadda & waxay ka codsaneysaa ka qaybgalayaasha inay bilaabaan olole ay raggu ku taageeraan haweenka si ay u helaan jagooyin hoggaamineed oo ammaan ah

English: Canada wishes IEBC success in #ECVR2021, urges citizens to register as their vote matters.
Kiswahili: Kanada inaitakia IEBC mafanikio katika #ECVR2021, inawasihi raia kujiandikisha kwani kura zao ni muhimu.
Dholuo: Kanada dwaro ni IEBC otim dongruok e #ECVR2021, dwaro ni ji duto odonjre kaka joma biro goyo ombulu nikech ombuchgi en gima duong ahinya.
Somali: Kanada waxay u rajeyneysaa IEBC guul #ECVR2021, waxay ku boorineysaa muwaadiniinta inay isdiiwaangaliyaan sida codkooda ay muhiim u tahay.

English: The Commission Chairman Wafula Chebukati urges Faith Based Organizations to have a collective responsibility to ensure we have a peaceful free and fair election in August 2022.
Kiswahili: Mwenyekiti wa Tume Wafula Chebukati anahimiza Mashirika ya Kidini kuwa na jukumu la pamoja la kuhakikisha tuna uchaguzi huru na wa haki wa amani mwezi Agosti 2022.
Dholuo: Jakom mar Komiti miluongo ni Wafula Chebukati, jiwo riwruok mar dinde mondo obed gi ting ' mar neno ni yiero e dwe mar Aboro higa mar alufu ariyo piero ariyo kod ariyo otim e yo ma ayanga.
Somali: Guddoomiyaha guddiga Wafula Chebukati wuxuu ugu baaqay ururada ku saleysan iimaanka inay lahaadaan mas'uuliyad wadajir ah si loo hubiyo inaan helno doorasho nabadeed oo xor ah oo cadaalad ah bisha Agoosto 2022.

English: Evans Misati, Chairperson of Political Parties Liaison Committee (PPLC) National Steering Committee urges PWDs to register as members of political parties to claim their rightful share in national representation
Kiswahili: Evans Misati, Mwenyekiti wa Kamati ya Uongozi ya Kitaifa ya Kamati ya Uhusiano ya Vyama vya Siasa (PPLC) anawasihi watu wenye ulemavu kujiandikisha kama wanachama wa vyama vya siasa ili kudai sehemu yao halali katika uwakilishi wa kitaifa.
Dholuo: Evans Misati, ma en jakom mar Komiti mar Riwruok mar duond od buche (PPLC) komiti matayo sirkal mamalo jiwo PWDs mondo odonjre kaka jokanyo mag riwruoge mag siasa mondo giyud migawo mowinjore mar bedo jokanyo mag pinje
Somali: Evans Misati, Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Xiriirka Xisbiyada Siyaasadeed (PPLC) Guddiga Hogaaminta Qaranka ayaa ku booriyay dadka PWD inay iska diiwaangeliyaan xubnaha xisbiyada siyaasadeed si ay u codsadaan saamigooda sharciga ah ee wakiilka qaranka

English: Commissioner Wanderi urges women to remain united and support their own candidates in big numbers but also ensure they develop and mentor the youth to be responsible to take up leadership positions in the upcoming August 9, General Election.
Kiswahili: Kamishna Wanderi anawasihi wanawake kubaki wamoja na kuwaunga mkono wagombea wao kwa wingi lakini pia kuhakikisha wanawaendeleza na kuwapa ushauri vijana ili kuwajibika kuchukua nafasi za uongozi katika Uchaguzi Mkuu ujao wa Agosti 9.
Dholuo: Kamisona Wanderi jiwo wakeini mondo osik ka gin gi winjruok achiel kendo gichiw kony maduong ' ne joma gidwaro, to bende gijiwo kendo gijiwo rowere mondo obed gi ting ' mar telo e yiero maduong ' mabiro tarik ochiko dwe mar aboro.
Somali: Guddoomiye Wanderi wuxuu ku boorinayaa haweenka inay sii midoobaan oo ay taageeraan musharixiintooda tiro badan, laakiin sidoo kale inay hubiyaan in ay horumariyaan oo ay tababaraan dhalinyarada si ay u noqdaan kuwo mas'uul ka ah inay qabtaan jagooyinka hoggaanka doorashada guud ee soo socota 9ka Ogosto.

English: Commissioner Cherera urges women to mobilise and bring out those not registered to enlist as voters
Kiswahili: Kamishna Cherera awahimiza wanawake kuhamasisha na kuwaleta nje wale ambao hawajajiandikisha kujiandikisha kama wapiga kura
Dholuo: kamisona Cherera jiwo wakeini mondo ojiw kendo ochiw joma pok ondikre kaka joma biro yiero.
Somali: Guddoomiye Cherera wuxuu ku booriyay haweenka in ay soo uruuriyaan oo ay soo saaraan kuwa aan diiwaangashanayn si ay u diiwaangeliyaan codbixiyeyaasha

English: In the meantime, KRA urges all the patriotic citizens of Kenya to stand with the Government, especially during this difficult and unprecedented time.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo huo, KRA inawasihi raia wote wazalendo wa Kenya kusimama na Serikali, hasa wakati huu mgumu na usio wa kawaida.
Dholuo: E kindeno bende, KRA jiwo raia duto mag Kenya mondo ochung ' kor sirkal, to moloyo e kinde matekni.
Somali: Dhanka kale, KRA waxay ugu baaqeysaa dhammaan muwaadiniinta wadaniyiinta ah ee Kenya inay taageeraan dowladda, gaar ahaan xilligan adag oo aan hore loo arag.

English: Commissioner Francis Wanderi urges media, in the spirit of transparency, to send staff in all polling station to report results as declared by Presiding & Returning Officers.
Kiswahili: Kamishna Francis Wanderi anahimiza vyombo vya habari, kwa roho ya uwazi, kutuma wafanyakazi katika vituo vyote vya kupigia kura kuripoti matokeo kama yalivyotangazwa na Wasimamizi na Maafisa wa Kurudi.
Dholuo: kamisona Francis Wanderi jiwo jofwambo e chuny mar ler e tich mondo oor jotich e kombe duto mag yiero mondo ochiw ripode kaka ne oland gi jotelo mochung' ne lendo mag yiero.
Somali: Guddoomiye Francis Wanderi wuxuu warbaahinta ugu baaqayaa inay si hufan u dirto shaqaale dhammaan goobaha codbixinta si ay u soo sheegaan natiijooyinka sida ay ku dhawaaqeen madaxweyneyaasha iyo saraakiisha soo celinta.

English: Director SCM, Harley Mutisya urges suppliers and service providers to communicate with accuracy on any issues that may hinder their ability to deliver on time to IEBCKenya
Kiswahili: Mkurugenzi SCM, Harley Mutisya anawasihi wasambazaji na watoa huduma kuwasiliana kwa usahihi kuhusu masuala yoyote ambayo yanaweza kuzuia uwezo wao wa kuwasilisha kwa wakati kwa IEBCKenya.
Dholuo: Jatend SCM, Harley Mutisya ojiwo jouso kod jochiw mwandu mondo owuo e yo makare e wi weche duto manyalo monogi chwalo mwandu e kinde mowinjore ne duol mar yiero e piny kenya.
Somali: Agaasimaha SCM, Harley Mutisya wuxuu ku boorinayaa alaab-qeybiyeyaasha iyo bixiyeyaasha adeegyada inay si sax ah ula xiriiraan arrimaha kasta oo caqabad ku noqon kara awooda ay ku gaarsiiyaan IEBCKenya waqtigeeda

English: IEBC Chairman Wafula Chebukati urges political parties to familiarize with the Elections Operation Plan (EOP), which provides a roadmap and key timelines of the election calendar.
Kiswahili: Mwenyekiti wa IEBC Wafula Chebukati anahimiza vyama vya siasa kufahamu Mpango wa Uendeshaji wa Uchaguzi (EOP), ambao hutoa ramani ya barabara na ratiba muhimu za kalenda ya uchaguzi.
Dholuo: Jakom mar IEBC Wafula Chebukati jiwo riwruoge mag siasa mondo ong'e chenro mar Yiero (EOP), ma loso chenro mar luwo yore kod seche mag yiero.
Somali: Guddoomiyaha IEBC Wafula Chebukati wuxuu xisbiyada siyaasadeed ugu baaqay inay la kulmaan Qorshaha Howlgalka Doorashooyinka (EOP), kaas oo bixiya khariidad iyo jadwalka muhiimka ah ee jadwalka doorashada.

English: EACC urges any person with actionable information on corruption to REPORT it for processing in accordance with the law.
Kiswahili: EACC inamsihi mtu yeyote mwenye taarifa zinazoweza kushughulikiwa kuhusu ufisadi kuripoti kwa ajili ya kushughulikiwa kwa mujibu wa sheria.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo ng'ato ang'ata ma nigi weche ma nyalo konyo e wi mibadhi mondo ochiw ripot mar loso gik moko kaluwore gi chik.
Somali: EACC waxay ku boorineysaa qofkasta oo haysta macluumaad la xiriira musuqmaasuqa in uu soo sheegayo si loo baaraandego si waafaqsan sharciga.

English: The Commission urges voters, candidates and agents to maintain order at all polling stations, avoid wearing or carrying campaign materials and to avoid campaigning while on the queue #October14thBy-elections.
Kiswahili: Tume inawasihi wapiga kura, wagombea na mawakala kudumisha utulivu katika vituo vyote vya kupigia kura, kuepuka kuvaa au kubeba vifaa vya kampeni na kuepuka kufanya kampeni wakiwa kwenye foleni #UchaguziMdogo wa Oktoba14.
Dholuo: Komisenano jiwo jogo ombulu,joland kombe kod jochung' mondo orit kwe e kuonde duto mag goyo ombulu , kik girwak kata ting'o gige kampen kendo kik girwak gige kampen ka gin e opara mar yiero #Oktoba14th By elections.
Somali: Komishanku wuxuu codbixiyayaasha, musharixiinta iyo wakiillada ku boorinayaa inay nidaamka ku ilaaliyaan dhammaan goobaha codbixinta, ka fogaadaan inay xirtaan ama qaataan qalabka ololaha iyo inay ka fogaadaan ololaha inta ay safka ku jiraan doorashada #October14thBy.

English: Did you know? That you can apply for special number plates? Apply online via the serviceportal.ntsa.go.ke
Kiswahili: Je, unajua? Kwamba unaweza kuomba nambari maalum za simu? Tuma maombi mtandaoni kupitia serviceportal.ntsa.go.ke
Dholuo: Be ing'eyo ni inyalo kwayo mondo omiyi plede makenda ? kwa e mbui kokalo kuom tond mbui mar serviceportal.ntsa.go.ke
Somali: Ma ogtahay in aad codsan karto lambarrada gaarka ah? Codso khadka tooska ah adigoo adeegsanaya bogga adeegga.ntsa.go.ke

English: Commissioner Francis Wanderi urges the POs and DPOs to respect the law and be impartial to all candidates and pledged to support them to deliver a credible Nguu/Masumba County Assembly Ward (CAW) by-election for #October14thBy-elections
Kiswahili: Kamishna Francis Wanderi anawasihi PO na DPO kuheshimu sheria na kutokuwa na upendeleo kwa wagombea wote na kuahidi kuwaunga mkono ili kutoa uchaguzi mdogo wa Bunge la Kaunti ya Nguu/Masumba (CAW) unaoaminika kwa ajili ya uchaguzi mdogo wa #Oktoba14.
Dholuo: Kamisona Francis Wanderi osayo POS kod DPOs mondo oluw chik kendo kik gidonjre gi ng'ato gi ng'ato kendo gisesingore ni gibiro riwo lwedo jogo mabiro chiwo kad mar loch mar waod mar kaunti (CAW) ne yiero ma adundo mar dwe mar apar tarik apar kod ang'wen yiero ma adundo.
Somali: Guddoomiye Francis Wanderi wuxuu ku booriyay POs-yada iyo DPOs-yada inay ixtiraamaan sharciga oo ay yihiin kuwo aan kala sooc lahayn dhammaan musharixiinta wuxuuna ballanqaaday inay taageeraan si ay u gaaraan doorasho qayb ah oo lagu kalsoonaan karo oo ka dhacda degmada Nguu/Masumba ee #October14thBy-doorashooyinka.

English: Returning Officer for the Nguu/Masumba County Assembly Ward (CAW) by-election Moureen Kerebi Oyaro urges voters and media to observe Covid-19 protocol.

English: IEBC calls upon all eligible citizens-especially young people who have recently attained voting age-to visit the nearest constituency office and register.
Kiswahili: IEBC inatoa wito kwa raia wote wanaostahiki - hasa vijana ambao wamefikia umri wa kupiga kura hivi karibuni - kutembelea ofisi ya eneobunge iliyo karibu na kujiandikisha.

English: Why wait inline when you can register online. Apply for special purpose vehicle today.
Kiswahili: Kwa nini usubiri kwenye mstari wakati unaweza kujiandikisha mtandaoni? Tuma maombi ya gari la matumizi maalum leo.

English: The Commission calls upon candidates and members of the public to maintain peace and order during the campaign period.

English: EACC urges Cooperatives that for them to remain commercially viable and sustainable enterprises for socio-economic development, they must embrace tenets of good governance; realized through selfless delivery, embracing integrity, transparency and accountability
Kiswahili: EACC inahimiza Vyama vya Ushirika kwamba ili viendelee kuwa na faida kibiashara na biashara endelevu kwa ajili ya maendeleo ya kijamii na kiuchumi, lazima vikumbatie kanuni za utawala bora; zinazopatikana kupitia utoaji usio na ubinafsi, kukumbatia uadilifu, uwazi na uwajibikaji.
Dholuo: EACC jiwo riwruoge mag ohala ni mondo gidhi nyime bedo gi ohala maber kendo ma dhi nyime e dongruok mar oganda koda mar ohala, nyaka giyie gi chenro mag loch maber; ma nyaka timre kokalo kuom chiwruok mar chiwruok, luwo tim makare, ng'eyo tiend weche, kod ting' mar ting'o ting'
Somali: EACC waxay ugu baaqeysaa iskaashatada in ay sii ahaadaan shirkado ganacsi ahaan ku habboon oo macquul ah horumarinta bulshada iyo dhaqaalaha, ay u baahan yihiin inay qaataan mabaadi'da maamul wanaagsanaanta; taas oo lagu fulin karo iyada oo la adeegsanayo adeegyo aan iskaa u dhigin, oo ay ku jiraan daacadnimo, hufnaanta iyo xisaabtanka.

English: KRA urges all licensed manufacturers, importers, distributors, retailers and general public that all bottled water beverages manufactured in or imported into Kenya from 13th November 2019 must be affixed with an Excise Stamp in compliance with the EGMS Regulations.
Kiswahili: KRA inawasihi wazalishaji wote walioidhinishwa, waagizaji, wasambazaji, wauzaji rejareja na umma kwa ujumla kwamba vinywaji vyote vya maji ya chupa vinavyotengenezwa au kuingizwa nchini Kenya kuanzia tarehe 13 Novemba 2019 lazima viambatishwe na Stempu ya Ushuru kwa mujibu wa Kanuni za EGMS.
Dholuo: KRA jiwo kambe man gi otiko mar loso gik moko, joma kelo gik moko e pinje mamoko, jochwal mwandu , jolok ohala, kod ji duto mondo ong'e ni chakre dwe mar apar gi achiel tarik apr kod adek higa amr alufu ariyo kod apar kod ochiko, gik moko duto mitiyogo e chamo pi modhi e piny Kenya, kata ma gigolo e pinyno, nyaka ketnegi alama mar osuru kaluwore gi chike mag EGMS.
Somali: KRA waxay ugu baaqeysaa dhammaan soosaarayaasha, soo dejinta, qaybiyeyaasha, tafaariiqleyda iyo dadweynaha guud in dhammaan cabitaannada biyaha lagu dhalo ee laga soo saaro Kenya ama laga soo dhoofiyo Kenya laga bilaabo 13ka Nofeembar 2019 ay ku dhejiyaan Stamp excise si waafaqsan Xeerarka EGMS.

English: Ag. Kenya High Commissioner in Rwanda Philip Githiora urges over 6,000 Kenyans living in Rwanda to register kenyaHCrwanda offices. Diaspora Voter Registration is going on in Kigali & the ambassador has urged Kenyans in different districts in Rwanda to enlist as voters

Usajili wa Wapiga Kura wa Diaspora unaendelea mjini Kigali na balozi huyo amewahimiza Wakenya katika wilaya tofauti nchini Rwanda kujiandikisha kama wapiga kura
Dholuo: Kamisona ma kenya e piny Rwanda Philip Githiora osenyiso Jo-Kenya mokalo alufu auchiel modak Rwanda ni gidonj e ofis mar Kenyahcrwanda. Ndikruok mar oko mar Kenya dhi nyime e Kigali kendo jambetre ojiwo jokenya manie gwenge mopogore opogore e Rwanda ondikre kaka jogo ombulu.
Somali: Ag. Kenya Taliyaha sare ee Rwanda Philip Githiora wuxuu ku booriyay in ka badan 6,000 oo reer Kenya ah oo ku nool Rwanda inay diiwaangeliyaan xafiisyada KenyaHCrwanda. Diaspora Voter Registration ayaa ka socda Kigali & safiirku wuxuu ku booriyay reer Kenya ee degmooyinka kala duwan ee Rwanda inay isu diiwaangeliyaan codbixiyayaasha

English: We remain steadfast in ensuring the safety and well-being of Kenyans and urges anyone who spots problematic wildlife to immediately report the sighting through the KWS 24/7 hotline on 0800 597 000 or WhatsApp number +254 726 610509
Kiswahili: Tunabaki imara katika kuhakikisha usalama na ustawi wa Wakenya na tunamsihi yeyote anayeona wanyamapori wenye matatizo kuripoti mara moja tukio hilo kupitia simu ya dharura ya KWS saa 24/7 kwa 0800 597 000 au nambari ya WhatsApp +254 726 610509.

Kiswahili: Mkurugenzi Mkuu Awahimiza Mabalozi Wapya Kudumisha Uadilifu na Utaalamu

English: EACC urges professionals to apply their expertise in advancing public good and desist from facilitating corruption or other conduct harmful to society.
Kiswahili: EACC inawahimiza wataalamu kutumia utaalamu wao katika kuendeleza manufaa ya umma na kuacha kuwezesha ufisadi au tabia nyingine zenye madhara kwa jamii.

English: Defence Principal Secretary Mr. Patrick Mariru has implored the newly employed civilian staff and interns to serve the Ministry with diligence, zeal and energy saying it is an uncommon privilege to serve in the public service.

English: IEBC urges Kenyan youth to register as voters
Kiswahili: IEBC yawahimiza vijana wa Kenya kujiandikisha kama wapiga kura
Dholuo: IEBC jiwo rowere mag Kenya mondo ondikre kaka jogo ombulu.

English: The Commission invites all new eligible voters and those seeking transfer of registration status and update of voter particulars/information to visit their preferred IEBCKenya constituency offices with their national identity card or valid Kenyan passport to register.
Kiswahili: Tume inawaalika wapiga kura wote wapya wanaostahiki na wale wanaotaka kuhamisha hadhi ya usajili na kusasisha maelezo/taarifa za wapiga kura kutembelea ofisi zao za jimbo la IEBCKenya wanazopendelea wakiwa na kitambulisho chao cha kitaifa au pasipoti halali ya Kenya ili kujiandikisha.

Kiswahili: IEBC yatangaza kuanza tena kwa usajili wa wapiga kura kuanzia Septemba 29

English: Kisero Kennedy, Secretary-General of KeMUSA, calls on Kenyan youth to take up voter registration in masses.
Kiswahili: Kisero Kennedy, Katibu Mkuu wa KeMUSA, anatoa wito kwa vijana wa Kenya kuandikisha wapiga kura kwa wingi.

Somali: Kisero Kennedy, oo ah Xoghayaha Guud ee KeMUSA, ayaa ugu baaqay dhalinyarada Kenya in ay ku biiraan diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha.

English: Mandera County leaders urge residents to embrace IEBC voter registration drive.
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa Kaunti ya Mandera wawahimiza wakazi kukumbatia kampeni ya usajili wa wapiga kura ya IEBC.

English: Govt warns that citizens should brace themselves for a bumpy ride ahead, as an additional 10 to 15 billion shillings will be required to subsidise fuel in the coming months

English: Governor Wanga urges Kasipul residents to maintain peace during by-election campaigns
Kiswahili: Gavana Wanga awahimiza wakazi wa Kasipul kudumisha amani wakati wa kampeni za uchaguzi mdogo
Dholuo: Gavana Wanga jiwo ji duto modak e KasIpuL mondo odag gi kwe e kinde kampen mag yiero ma adundo.

English: Governor Fatuma Achani urges residents of Kwale to plant trees.

Kiswahili: Katibu Mkuu wa Mifugo awahimiza wasimamizi kuwafahamisha wakazi kuhusu miradi ya serikali

English: SHA favorable to marginalized communities, MP Geoffrey Ruku urges Mbeere North residents to register with Social Health Authority (SHA).
Kiswahili: Mbunge Geoffrey Ruku, ambaye ni mshirika wa SHA anayependelea jamii zilizotengwa, anawasihi wakazi wa Mbeere Kaskazini kujiandikisha na Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii (SHA).

English: Conservationist Jim Nyamu urges residents of Marsabit County to protect elephants.
Kiswahili: Mhifadhi Jim Nyamu anawasihi wakazi wa Kaunti ya Marsabit kuwalinda tembo.

Somali: Jim Nyamu oo ah ilaalinta deegaanka ayaa dadka deggan degmada Marsabit ku booriyay in ay ilaaliyaan fillada.

English: Leaders say President Ruto will deliver on projects in Mt. Kenya region. PSS from Mt. Kenya continue with town hall meetings. PS Mary Muthoni urges residents to support the government
Kiswahili: Viongozi wasema Rais Ruto atatekeleza miradi katika eneo la Mlima Kenya. PSS kutoka Mlima Kenya inaendelea na mikutano ya halmashauri ya mji. Katibu Mkuu Mary Muthoni awahimiza wakazi kuunga mkono serikali

Kiswahili: Ahueni Tiaty: Tiaty yapata ofisi kwa ajili ya usajili wa vizazi na vifo Ofisi ya kuwaokoa wakazi zaidi ya kilomita 230 za usafiri Katibu Mkuu Bitok awahimiza wakazi kutumia ofisi

English: UDA PARTY ELECTIONS Homabay residents urged to exercise peace as UDA party elections gets underway.

English: Tharaka Nithi residents urged to plant more trees particularly in community lands.

English: Tana River residents urged to reject attempts by politicians to divide them along ethnic lines for personal gain.

English: Kakamega County residents urged to sign up for affordable housing
Kiswahili: Wakazi wa Kaunti ya Kakamega wahimizwa kujisajili kwa nyumba za bei nafuu

English: Laikipia residents urged to join NHIF to avoid seeking hospital waivers
Kiswahili: Wakazi wa Laikipia wahimizwa kujiunga na NHIF ili kuepuka kuomba msamaha wa hospitali

English: Lamu residents urged to protect wildlife for future generations' benefit
Kiswahili: Wakazi wa Lamu wahimizwa kulinda wanyamapori kwa manufaa ya vizazi vijavyo
Dholuo: Jodak Lamu okwa mondo orit le mag bungu mondo okony tieng' mabiro.

Dholuo: Konyo bungu mar Masabit: Chenro mag rito bunge kod yiende mag pi e kaunti'no ne ojiw jokanyo ne ojwi mondo owuo kod jodak mondo okony e rito lowo ojiw jodak mondo opidh yiende mondo oywa pi.

English: COVID-19 MASS TESTING NMS launches two mass testing in Nairobi Residents urged to turn up to be tested
Kiswahili: UPIMAJI WA WALIMU WA COVID-19 NMS YAZINDUA UPIMAJI WA WALIMU WAWILI jijini Nairobi Wakazi wahimizwa kujitokeza kupimwa

English: Commission on administrative justice opens Garissa office; residents urged to report issues that need attention.

English: NAROK FOREST CONSERVATION: Residents urged to plant more trees to increase forest cover in the county
Kiswahili: UHIFADHI WA MSITU WA NAROK: Wakazi wahimizwa kupanda miti zaidi ili kuongeza eneo la misitu katika kaunti hiyo
Dholuo: Rito bungu ma Narok: Jodak ojiw mondo opidh yiende mang'eny mondo omi bunge omedre e kaunti'no.

English: Embu residents urged to register with NHIF to scale up UHC
Kiswahili: Wakazi wa Embu wahimizwa kujisajili na NHIF ili kuongeza UHC
Dholuo: Jodak Embu ne ojiw mondo ondikre gi NHIF mondo gimed bedo gi UHC
Somali: Dadka deggan Embu ayaa lagu booriyay inay iska diiwaangeliyaan NHIF si loo kordhiyo UHC

English: Citizens urged to register with the new medical cover (SHA)
Kiswahili: Raia wahimizwa kujiandikisha na bima mpya ya matibabu (SHA)
Dholuo: Ne ojiw raia mondo odonj e chenro manyien mar thieth (SHA)
Somali: Muwaadiniinta waxaa lagu booriyay inay iska diiwaangeliyaan caymiska caafimaadka cusub (SHA)

English: Leaders from Tana River County urged to collaborate to ensure citizens benefit from development projects.
Kiswahili: Viongozi kutoka Kaunti ya Tana River wamehimizwa kushirikiana ili kuhakikisha raia wananufaika na miradi ya maendeleo.
Dholuo: Jotelo ma Kaunti ma Tana River ojiw mondo oti kanyachiel mondo gine ni ji duto yudo ber kuom chenro mag dongruok.

English: SHA ENROLLMENT Deputy Gov't Spokesperson Mwanaisha Chidzuga has urged citizens to enroll in SHA, which aims to improve healthcare services and provide protection against high medical costs.
Kiswahili: UANDIKISHAJI WA SHA Naibu Msemaji wa Serikali Mwanaisha Chidzuga amewasihi raia kujiandikisha katika SHA, ambayo inalenga kuboresha huduma za afya na kutoa ulinzi dhidi ya gharama kubwa za matibabu.
Dholuo: Ndikruok e SHA Jalup jaloso elo sirkal Mwanaisha Chidzuga osenyiso ji ni gidonj e SHA, ma dwaro ni ji otim dongruok e weche thieth kendo gimi ji ritruok kuom nengo mag thieth.
Somali: SHA ENROLLMENT Afhayeenka ku xigeenka Dowladda Mwanaisha Chidzuga ayaa muwaadiniinta ugu baaqay inay iska diiwaangeliyaan SHA, taas oo ujeedkeedu yahay hagaajinta adeegyada daryeelka caafimaadka iyo bixinta ilaalinta kharashaadka sare ee caafimaadka.

English: NATIONAL ID PROCESSING Public urged to collect documents from respective constituencies Mwaura: 660,000 IDs awaiting collection 600,000 citizens have applied for new documents
Kiswahili: USAFIRISHAJI WA VItambulisho VYA TAIFA Umma wahimizwa kukusanya hati kutoka maeneo bunge husika Mwaura: Vitambulisho 660,000 vinasubiri kuchukuliwa Raia 600,000 wameomba hati mpya

Somali: DHAGEYSO NATIONAL ID PROCESSING Dadweynaha oo lagu baaqay in ay soo ururiyaan dukumiintiyo ka socda gobalada doorashada ee kala duwan Mwaura: 660,000 ID oo sugaya in la soo ururiyo 600,000 oo muwaadin ayaa dalbaday dukumiintiyo cusub

English: The Director highlighted the role of Missions in harnessing Diaspora Investments. He Urged Kenyans abroad to register at their nearest Kenya Embassy, stressing that the missions are the first point of contact between the nation and its diaspora citizens.
Kiswahili: Mkurugenzi huyo aliangazia jukumu la Misheni katika kutumia Uwekezaji wa Diaspora. Aliwahimiza Wakenya walio nje ya nchi kujiandikisha katika Ubalozi wao wa karibu wa Kenya, akisisitiza kwamba misheni hizo ndizo sehemu ya kwanza ya mawasiliano kati ya taifa na raia wake walio nje ya nchi.
Dholuo: Jatelono nojiwo migawo ma dinde nigo mar tiyo gi pesago e konyo joma odak e pinje mamoko, kendo nojiwo Jo-Kenya modak e pinje mamoko mondo odonj e ofisgi man machiegni gi Kenya, kojiwo ni misonari e okang' mokwongo mar tudruok e kind pinyno gi joma odak e pinje mamoko.
Somali: Agaasimaha ayaa carabka ku adkeeyay doorka Misionnadu ka ciyaaraan ka faa'iideysiga Maalgashiga Diaspora. Wuxuu ugu baaqay dadka Kenya ee dibedda jooga inay iska diiwaangeliyaan safaaradda Kenya ee ugu dhow, isagoo carabka ku adkeeyay in misionnadu yihiin barta ugu horreysa ee xiriirka u dhexeysa qaranka iyo muwaadiniintiisa ku nool dalkaasi.

English: Citizens are urged to participate in this historic Madaraka Day celebration set to take place in Bungoma County for the first time. - PS Interior Dr. Raymond Omollo
Kiswahili: Raia wanahimizwa kushiriki katika sherehe hii ya kihistoria ya Siku ya Madaraka inayotarajiwa kufanyika katika Kaunti ya Bungoma kwa mara ya kwanza. - Katibu Mkuu wa Mambo ya Ndani Dkt. Raymond Omollo
Dholuo: Ji duto igwelo mondo oriwre kodgi e nyasi maduong' mar chieng' madaraka Ji ma ne ochakore e kaunti ma Bungoma . - jagoro mar weche mag arita Laktar Raymond Omollo
Somali: Muwaadiniinta waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay ka qeyb galaan xafladan taariikhiga ah ee Maalinta Madaraka oo markii ugu horreysay ka dhici doonta degmada Bungoma. - PS Gudaha Dr. Raymond Omollo

English: EACC does not condone any form of corruption among staff. Kindly report the case you refer to through eacc@integrity.go.ke. Citizens are urged to beware of fraudsters impersonating EACC staff.
Kiswahili: EACC haikubaliani na aina yoyote ya ufisadi miongoni mwa wafanyakazi. Tafadhali ripoti kesi unayoirejelea kupitia eacc@integrity.go.ke. Raia wanahimizwa kuwa waangalifu dhidi ya wadanganyifu wanaojifanya wafanyakazi wa EACC.
Dholuo: EACC ok oyie gi mibadhi moro amora e kind jotich. Riwruogno orwako wachno kokalo kuom eacc@integrity.go.ke. Ojiw ji mondo otang' gi joma wuondore ni gin jotich e riwruok mar EACC.
Somali: EACC ma aqbalo nooc kasta oo musuqmaasuq ah shaqaalaha. Fadlan soo sheeg kiiska aad tixraacayso iyada oo loo marayo eacc@integrity.go.ke.

English: Mwananchi views: Members of the public advised to read and understand the BBI report
Kiswahili: Maoni ya Mwananchi: Umma washauriwa kusoma na kuelewa ripoti ya BBI

Somali: Aragtida Mwananchi: Shacabka waxaa lagula talinayaa inay akhriyaan oo fahmaan warbixinta BBI

English: Thank you for your feedback. Please report all cases of corruption and bribery to EACCKenya
Kiswahili: Asante kwa maoni yako. Tafadhali ripoti kesi zote za ufisadi na rushwa kwa EACCKenya
Dholuo: Erokamano kuom dwoko mari. nyis weche duto motudore gi mibadhi kod asoya ne riwruok mar EACC Kenya.

English: You are most welcome to Integrity Centre or any of our regional offices. You can visit to report corruption or share knowledge on how best we can fight corruption.
Kiswahili: Karibu sana katika Kituo cha Uadilifu au ofisi yoyote ya mkoa wetu. Unaweza kutembelea ili kuripoti ufisadi au kushiriki maarifa kuhusu jinsi tunavyoweza kupambana na ufisadi.

Somali: Waad soo dhaweyn kartaa Xarunta Daacadnimada ama mid ka mid ah xafiisyadeena gobolka.Waxaad booqan kartaa si aad u soo sheegto musuqmaasuqa ama aad u wadaagto aqoonta ku saabsan sida ugu fiican ee aan u la dagaallanaan karno musuqmaasuqa.

English: You are welcome to report corruption please call Toll Free line 1551 or email report@integrity.go.ke.
Kiswahili: Mwaareganigwe mwensi koenana amang'ana igoro y'obokurumi ase enchera yesimu ya bosa 1551 gose otome rirube riembeo report@integrity.go.ke

Somali: Fadlan wac khadka lacag la'aanta ah 1551 ama email report@integrity.go.ke.

English: Good morning. We process number plates within 7 working days. Never deal with brokers. Report cases of corruption to @EACCKenya

English: You don't need to deal with a broker to access any NTSA service. Kindly report corruption and bribery related
Kiswahili: Huna haja ya kushughulika na dalali ili kupata huduma yoyote ya NTSA. Tafadhali ripoti kuhusu ufisadi na rushwa zinazohusiana

English: Kindly proceed to apply for a duplicate logbook from your account. Please reach out if your require any more information.

English: No room for corruption or laziness,  CS Geoffrey Ruku has urged all public servants to uphold professionalism, report to work on time, and treat Kenyans with dignity and respect.
Kiswahili: Hakuna nafasi ya ufisadi au uvivu,  Waziri Geoffrey Ruku amewasihi watumishi wote wa umma kudumisha weledi, kuripoti kazini kwa wakati, na kuwatendea Wakenya kwa utu na heshima.

Somali: Ma jiro meel musuqmaasuq ama caajis ah, CS Geoffrey Ruku wuxuu ugu baaqay dhammaan shaqaalaha dowladda inay ilaaliyaan xirfadda, u soo gudbiyaan warbixin si ay u shaqeeyaan waqtigeeda, oo ay ula dhaqmaan dadka Kenya leh sharaf iyo ixtiraam.

English: Call Toll Free line 1551 or email report@integrity.go.ke to report cases of corruption.
Kiswahili: Piga simu ya bure 1551 au tuma barua pepe kwa report@integrity.go.ke ili kuripoti visa vya ufisadi.
Dholuo: Tudri gi namba mar 1551 maonge chudo kata or e-mail report@integrity.go.ke mondo inyis ji weche mag mibadhi.
Somali: Wac lambarka Toll Free 1551 ama email u dir report@integrity.go.ke si aad u soo sheegto kiisaska musuqmaasuqa.

English: Please feel free to report any cases of forgery or corruption via email report@integrity.go.ke or call 1551.
Kiswahili: Tafadhali jisikie huru kuripoti visa vyovyote vya kughushi au ufisadi kupitia barua pepe report@integrity.go.ke au piga simu 1551.
Dholuo: Inyalo oro ripot moro amora mar gik mochuogi kata mibadhi kitiyo gi e-mail@integrity.go.ke kata igo simo e namba mar 1551.
Somali: Fadlan si xor ah u soo sheega kiisaska been abuurka ama musuqmaasuqa emailka report@integrity.go.ke ama wac 1551.

English: Report via email report@integrity.go.ke or call 1551 in case you have specific corruption cases which need action.
Kiswahili: Ripoti kupitia barua pepe report@integrity.go.ke au piga simu 1551 ikiwa una kesi maalum za ufisadi zinazohitaji hatua.
Dholuo: Chiw lipot kitiyo gi e-mail report@integrity.go.ke kata luong namba 1551 kapo ni in gi weche moko ma nyiso ni idwaro kawo okang'.
Somali: Ka warbixi emailka report@integrity.go.ke ama wac 1551 haddii aad qabtid kiisas musuqmaasuq gaar ah oo u baahan tallaabo.

English: If you have any particular cases of corruption you need to report, please do so via email report@integrity.go.ke or call 1551.
Kiswahili: Ikiwa una visa vyovyote maalum vya ufisadi unavyohitaji kuripoti, tafadhali fanya hivyo kupitia barua pepe report@integrity.go.ke au piga simu 1551.
Dholuo: Kapo ni in gi wach moro ma chandi, inyalo ndiko wachno e adres mar@integrity.go.ke kata inyalo ywayo tol e namba mar 1551.
Somali: Haddii aad qabtid kiisas gaar ah oo musuqmaasuq ah oo aad u baahan tahay inaad soo sheegto, fadlan sidaas ku samee emailka report@integrity.go.ke ama wac 1551.

English: Meru Huduma Centre launches Customer Service Week: Members of the public have been urged to seek various Government services.
Kiswahili: Kituo cha Huduma cha Meru chazindua Wiki ya Huduma kwa Wateja: Umma umehimizwa kutafuta huduma mbalimbali za Serikali.
Dholuo: Kar chiwo chenro mag sirkal mar Huduma Center ma Meru chako Juma mar chiwo chenro ne jonyiewo: Oganda osejiw mondo omany tije mopogore opogore mag sirkal.
