English: We have very many uncollected IDs in our Huduma Centres. I want to strongly urge all Kenyans who have not yet collected their IDs to do so without delay, as it is the first step towards registering for the Social Health Authority (SHA) and accessing vital government services." Geoffrey Ruku, Cabinet Secretary for Public Service, Human Capital Development and Special Programmes
Kiswahili: Tuna vitambulisho vingi sana ambavyo havijachukuliwa katika Vituo vyetu vya Huduma. Ninataka kuwasihi sana Wakenya wote ambao bado hawajachukua vitambulisho vyao kufanya hivyo bila kuchelewa, kwani ni hatua ya kwanza kuelekea kujiandikisha kwa Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii (SHA) na kupata huduma muhimu za serikali." Geoffrey Ruku, Katibu wa Baraza la Mawaziri wa Huduma za Umma, Maendeleo ya Rasilimali Watu na Programu Maalum.
Dholuo: Wan gi opande mang'eny mapok okaw e kuonde mag Huduma centers. Adwaro jiwo ahinya Jo-Kenya duto ma pok ochoko gik ma gisetimo mondo gitim kamano maok gideko, nimar mano en okang' mokwongo mar dhi e riwruok mar oganda mangima (SHA) kendo yudo kony mag sirkal. " Geoffrey Ruku, jatend migawo mar tije , dongruok mar pes jopiny kod chenro mowinjore.
Somali: Waxaan haynaa aqoonsiyo badan oo aan la soo aruurin Xarumaha Huduma. Waxaan si adag ugu boorinayaa dhammaan dadka Kenya ee aan weli soo aruurin aqoonsigooda inay sidaas sameeyaan si deg deg ah, maadaama ay tahay tallaabada ugu horreysa ee diiwaangelinta Hay'adda Caafimaadka Bulshada (SHA) iyo helitaanka adeegyada muhiimka ah ee dowladda. " Geoffrey Ruku, Xoghayaha Golaha Wasiirada ee Adeegga Dadweynaha, Horumarinta Maalgashiga Aadanaha iyo Barnaamijyada Gaarka ah

English: Need assistance with your taxes? Our services are also available at all Huduma Centres during the extended hours. Drop by at your convenience and let us help you stay compliant.
Kiswahili: Unahitaji usaidizi kuhusu kodi zako? Huduma zetu zinapatikana pia katika Vituo vyote vya Huduma wakati wa saa zilizoongezwa. Tembelea kwa urahisi wako na tukuruhusu kukusaidia kuendelea kufuata sheria.
Dholuo: Be dwaro kony gi pesa michulo mar osuru? chenrowa bende yudore e kuonde duto mag Huduma centers kuom seche mochwalore chop e saa mowinjore kendo wamiyi wach mowinjore.
Somali: Waxaad u baahan tahay caawimaad canshuurtaada? Adeegyadeena ayaa sidoo kale laga heli karaa dhammaan Xarumaha Huduma inta lagu jiro saacadaha dheeraadka ah.

English: ALERT: Application for various NTSA services by National and County Government entities. The Authority has set up a dedicated help desk at NTSA HQ, all NTSA regional offices and Huduma Centres. For email enquiries reach us through numberplates@ntsa.go.ke
Kiswahili: TAARIFA: Maombi ya huduma mbalimbali za NTSA kutoka kwa vyombo vya Serikali ya Kitaifa na Kaunti. Mamlaka imeanzisha dawati maalum la usaidizi katika Makao Makuu ya NTSA, ofisi zote za mkoa wa NTSA na Vituo vya Huduma. Kwa maswali ya barua pepe, wasiliana nasi kupitia numberplates@ntsa.go.ke
Dholuo: Lendo : Lendo mag tije mopogore opogore mag NTSA kod riwruoge mag sirkal. Sirkal osechako loso mesa mar konyruok e mesa mar apis maduong' mar NTSA, ofise duto mag gweng' kod kuonde mag Huduma centres. Kuom tudruok mar mbui chopnwa kitiyo kod mbui mar numberplates@ntsa.go.ke
Somali: Digniin: Codsiga adeegyada kala duwan ee NTSA ee hay'adaha Dowladda Qaranka iyo Degmada. Hay'addu waxay ka sameysay xafiis caawimaad gaar ah xarunta NTSA, dhammaan xafiisyada gobolka ee NTSA iyo Xarumaha Huduma. Su'aalaha emaylka naga soo xiriir lambarka numberplates@ntsa.go.ke

English: Did you know that all KRA Services are free? You can receive our services from our contact centre, KRA offices or Huduma Center near you Find out more here
Kiswahili: Je, unajua kwamba Huduma zote za KRA ni bure? Unaweza kupokea huduma zetu kutoka kituo chetu cha mawasiliano, ofisi za KRA au Kituo cha Huduma kilicho karibu nawe. Pata maelezo zaidi hapa.

Dholuo: Weche momedi mag mibadhi EACC okelo mwandu mag ker bilion abich mwandu mokaw kowuok kerRuto jood bura mondo okal chochni mar paro e chik yie.

English: EACC rubbishes KERRA employees defence that he raised 21 M for dowry urges court not to unfreeze.
Kiswahili: EACC yapinga utetezi wa wafanyakazi wa KERRA kwamba alikusanya 21 M kwa ajili ya mahari yaitaka mahakama isifungue mashtaka.
Dholuo: EACC rucho defence mar jotije mar KERRA ma osegolo milion piero ariyo gi achiel mar dhiang' jiwo od bura mondo ogol ageng'a.
Somali: EACC burburinta shaqaalaha KERRA difaaca in uu soo ururiyey 21 M oo ah hadiyad ku booriyay maxkamadda in aan la qaboojiyo.

English: EACC ORDERS all State entities to stop payment of terminal dues to civil servants resigning from government to evade prosecution for forging academic papers.
Kiswahili: EACC INAAGIZA mashirika yote ya Serikali kusitisha malipo ya ada ya mwisho kwa watumishi wa umma wanaojiuzulu kutoka serikalini ili kukwepa mashtaka kwa kughushi hati za masomo.
Dholuo: EACC chiwo chik ne riwruoge duto mag sirkal mondo owe chulo osuru mag jotelo mag sirkal ka gidwaro weyo tijegi mag sirkal mondo kik ng'ato yawne bura kuom barupe somo ma bandia.
Somali: EACC waxay amartay dhamaan hay'adaha dowladda in ay joojiyaan bixinta deeqaha dhameystirka ah ee shaqaalaha dawladda ee iska casilay dowladda si looga fogaado dacwad lagu soo oogay warqado waxbarasho oo been abuur ah.

English: NTSA urges motorists to complete pending transactions on TIMS by Friday, December 15, 2023 ahead of integration of all service access on e-Citizen by January 2, 2024.
Kiswahili: NTSA inawasihi madereva kukamilisha miamala inayosubiriwa kwenye TIMS ifikapo Ijumaa, Desemba 15, 2023 kabla ya kuunganishwa kwa huduma zote kwenye e-Citizen ifikapo Januari 2, 2024.
Dholuo: NTSA jiwo joriembo mondo otiek chudo kod TIMS chieng' tich abich dwe mar apar kod ariyo tarik apar kod abich higa mar alufu ariyo piero ariyo kod adek motelo ne riwo chenro duto e mbui mar ecitizen chieng' tarik ariyo dwe mar achiel higa mar alufu ariyo piero ariyo kof ang'wen.
Somali: NTSA waxay ku boorineysaa taraafikada inay dhammaystiraan macaamil ganacsi oo la sii wado oo ku saabsan TIMS ilaa Jimcaha, 15-ka Diseembar 2023, ka hor inta aan la gelin dhammaan adeegyada adeegga ee e-Citizen illaa Janaayo 2, 2024.

English: Government rolls out e-Citizen Mpesa payments for Inua Jamii beneficiaries starting January; Social Protection PS Motari urges beneficiaries to register Safaricom lines.
Kiswahili: Serikali yazindua malipo ya Mpesa ya kielektroniki kwa wanufaika wa Inua Jamii kuanzia Januari; Katibu Mkuu wa Ulinzi wa Jamii Motari anawasihi wanufaika kusajili laini za Safaricom.
Dholuo: Sirkal chiwo mich kokalo kuom E-Citizen Mpesa ne joma yudo kony mar INUA Jamii chakre dwe mar achiel jagoro mar ratiro mar oganda Motari jiwo joma yudo kony mondo odhi oka laind safarikom.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay bixisaa lacag bixinta e-Citizen Mpesa ee ka faa'iideystayaasha Inua Jamii laga bilaabo Janaayo; Badbaadada Bulshada PS Motari waxay ku boorineysaa ka faa'iideystayaasha inay diiwaangeliyaan khadadka Safaricom.

English: Govt Urges Pensioners to Register on e-Citizen by May 10 to Avoid Payroll Suspension To all government pensioners: You are urged to register on the e-Citizen platform by the extended deadline of 10th May." Isaac Mwaura Gov't Spokesman
Kiswahili: Serikali Yawahimiza Wastaafu Kujiandikisha kwenye Mtandao wa Kielektroniki ifikapo Mei 10 ili Kuepuka Kusimamishwa kwa Mishahara Kwa wastaafu wote wa serikali: Mnahimizwa kujiandikisha kwenye mfumo wa Kielektroniki wa Kiraia ifikapo tarehe ya mwisho iliyoongezwa ya Mei 10." Isaac Mwaura Msemaji wa Serikali
Dholuo: Sirkal kwayo joyudo pes rutaya mondo ondikre e-Citizen e dwe mar abich mondo kik gikos chiwone jotelo duto mag sirkal pesa Ijiwi mondo idhi e pension e e-Citizen e dwe mar abich tarik apar jaloso e lo sirkal Isaac Mwaura nowacho.
Somali: Dowladda waxay ku boorineysaa dadka hawlgabka ah inay diiwaangeliyaan e-Citizen 10-ka Maajo si looga fogaado joojinta mushaarka Dhamaan dadka hawlgabka ah ee dowladda: Waxaad ku boorineysaa inaad ka diiwaangeliso barnaamijka e-Citizen 10-ka Maajo marka la kordhiyo waqtiga. "Isaac Mwaura Afhayeenka Dowladda

English: Government urges pensioners to register to avoid payroll suspension To all government pensioners, you are urged to register on the e-Citizen platform by the extended deadline of 10th May, the government spokesperson said.
Kiswahili: Serikali inawasihi wastaafu kujiandikisha ili kuepuka kusimamishwa kwa mishahara. Kwa wastaafu wote wa serikali, mnahimizwa kujiandikisha kwenye jukwaa la kielektroniki la Citizen ifikapo tarehe ya mwisho iliyoongezwa ya Mei 10, msemaji wa serikali alisema.
Dholuo: Sirkal jiwo joma yudo pes rutaya mondo ondikre mondo gikwed chudo duto ma sirkal chiwo, kendo gidwaro ni gidonj e e-Citizen e giko dwe mar abich tarik apar , jaloso e loo sirkal nowacho.
Somali: Dowladda waxay ku boorineysaa dadka hawlgabka ah inay isdiiwaangaliyaan si looga fogaado joojinta mushaarka Dhamaan dadka hawlgabka ah ee dowladda, waxaan ku boorineynaa inaad isdiiwaangaliyaan barta e-Citizen marka la gaaro waqtiga la kordhiyay ee May 10, ayuu yiri afhayeenka dowladda.

English: A section of the Isiolo "Meru community has raised concerns over what they describe as rampant bad governance within the county administration. The leaders accused local officials of mismanagement and failing to fulfill key development pledges.
Kiswahili: Sehemu ya jamii ya Isiolo "Meru" imeibua wasiwasi kuhusu kile wanachokielezea kama utawala mbaya uliokithiri ndani ya utawala wa kaunti. Viongozi hao waliwashutumu maafisa wa eneo hilo kwa usimamizi mbaya na kushindwa kutimiza ahadi muhimu za maendeleo.
Dholuo: Moko kuom joma odak e alwora mar Isiolo osechako bedo gi luoro e wi gima giwacho ni en loch marach ahinya e kauntino. Jotelo go seyo jotelo ma aluorano kuom telo marach kod koso chopo singo mag dongruok.
Somali: Qeyb ka mid ah bulshada Isiolo "Meru ayaa walaac ka muujiyay waxa ay ku tilmaamaan maamul xumo aan caadi ahayn oo ka jirta maamulka degmada. Hoggaamiyeyaashu waxay ku eedeeyeen mas'uuliyiinta deegaanka in ay maamusho xun oo ay ku guuldareysteen inay buuxiyaan ballanqaadyada horumarinta muhiimka ah.

English: Amid a rise in suicides and killings believed to be linked to mental health challenges, clerics and local leaders are calling on government to lower the cost of living and establish more counselling centres to help address the growing crisis.
Kiswahili: Huku kukiwa na ongezeko la kujiua na mauaji yanayoaminika kuhusishwa na changamoto za afya ya akili, viongozi wa dini na viongozi wa mitaa wanatoa wito kwa serikali kupunguza gharama ya maisha na kuanzisha vituo zaidi vya ushauri nasaha ili kusaidia kushughulikia mgogoro unaokua.
Dholuo: To nikech kwan momedore mar derruok kod nek mosetudi kod wich molokore , jolemo kod jotend gweng 'jiwo sirkande mag dhano mondo oket nengo mag ngima piny kendo ochak kuonde ma ji nyalo yudoe kony e tieko chandruogno mamedore.
Somali: Iyadoo ay sii kordhayaan isdilka iyo dilalka la rumeysan yahay inay ku xiran yihiin dhibaatooyinka caafimaadka dhimirka, culimada iyo hoggaamiyeyaasha deegaanka ayaa ugu baaqay dowladda inay hoos u dhigto qiimaha nolosha iyo in la dhiso xarumo la talin badan si ay uga caawiyaan xallinta dhibaatada sii kordheysa.

English: Self-help-groups in Thika, Kiambu county have received posho mills from well wishers in collaboration with local leaders. This was in a bid to help the cluster groups comprising youths and women start generating income. #NTVAtOne
Kiswahili: Vikundi vya kujisaidia huko Thika, kaunti ya Kiambu vimepokea vinu vya posho kutoka kwa wasamaria wema kwa ushirikiano na viongozi wa eneo hilo. Hii ilikuwa katika juhudi za kusaidia vikundi vya makundi vinavyojumuisha vijana na wanawake kuanza kupata mapato. #NTVAtOne
Dholuo: Grube mag kosalo e kaunti ma Thika, kaunti ma Kiambu oseyudo kony moa kuom jochiwo mang'won ka gitiyo gi jotelo mag gweng'no. Mano ne en e tiegruok mar konyo grube moting'o rowere kod mon mondo ochak golo pesa. #Ntvatone
Somali: Kooxaha is caawinta ee degmada Thika ee degmada Kiambu waxay ka heleen warshadaha posho oo ay ka helaan shaqaale faraxsan oo kaashanaya hoggaamiyeyaasha deegaanka. Tani waxay ahayd dadaal ay ku caawinayaan kooxaha kooxaha ka kooban dhalinyarada iyo haweenka inay bilaabaan inay helaan dakhli. #NTVAtOne

English: Insecurity in Baringo: Security committee on tour to assess security situation. Local leaders want victims of banditry compensated #CitizenWeekend
Kiswahili: Ukosefu wa usalama Baringo: Kamati ya usalama ikifanya ziara ya kutathmini hali ya usalama. Viongozi wa eneo hilo wanataka waathiriwa wa ujambazi walipwe fidia #CitizenWikendi
Dholuo: Rohcruok mar arita e kaunti ma Baringo: Komiti mar Ritruok dhi nono chal mar ritruok. Jotelo mag gweng'no dwaro ni joma ne odonjo e timbe mahundu oyud resruok. #giko juma mar jopiny.
Somali: Nabadsugida Baringo: Guddiga amniga ayaa booqasho ku socda si ay u qiimeeyaan xaaladda amniga Madaxda deegaanka waxay rabaan in dhibanayaasha tuugada lagu magdhowdo #CitizenWeekend

English: Rescue Centre Torture Probe: Human rights activists call on local leaders to stop politicising the alleged torture claims being perpetrated at the Eldoret Rescue Centre.
Kiswahili: Uchunguzi wa Mateso wa Kituo cha Uokoaji: Wanaharakati wa haki za binadamu watoa wito kwa viongozi wa eneo hilo kuacha kuhusisha siasa na madai ya mateso yanayodaiwa kufanywa katika Kituo cha Uokoaji cha Eldoret.
Dholuo: Puonjruok ma ne otim e kambi mar Resruok : Joma kedo ne ratiro mag dhano dwaro ni jotelo mag gweng'no owe timbe mag sand ma ne itimo e kambi mar Resruok scue e taon mar Eldoret.
Somali: Tijaabada Cadaadis ee Xarunta Badbaadinta: Dhaqdhaqaaqayaasha xuquuqda aadanaha waxay ugu baaqdaan hoggaamiyeyaasha deegaanka inay joojiyaan siyaasadeynta sheegashada lagu eedeeyay in cadaadis lagu sameeyay Xarunta Badbaadinta Eldoret.

English: Kilifi Rejects Nuclear Project Kilifi leaders have unanimously opposed the proposed multibillion-shilling Uyombo nuclear power plant, citing environmental risks to local communities.
Kiswahili: Kilifi Yakataa Mradi wa Nyuklia Viongozi wa Kilifi wamepinga kwa kauli moja pendekezo la mtambo wa nyuklia wa Uyombo wenye thamani ya mabilioni ya shilingi, wakitaja hatari za kimazingira kwa jamii za wenyeji.
Dholuo: Kilifi okwedo chenro mar nyuklia ma jotelo mag Kilifi oseng'ado mar kwedo gi chuny achiel chenro moketi e paro mar bilionde modhawo mar nyuklia mar Uyombo, ka gichiwo ranyisi mar pek ma onyalo kelo e aluora mar oganda.
Somali: Hogaamiyayaasha Kilifi ayaa si wadajir ah uga soo horjeestay xarunta korontada nukliyeerka ee loo soo jeediyay in ay ku kacdo dhowr bilyan oo shillings, iyagoo tixraacaya khataraha deegaanka ee bulshooyinka maxalliga ah.

English: West Pokot Governor Simon Kachapin has criticized a section of local leaders, accusing them of engaging in divisive, toxic, and deceitful politics intended to derail development and promote sabotage.
Kiswahili: Gavana wa Pokot Magharibi Simon Kachapin amekosoa sehemu ya viongozi wa eneo hilo, akiwashutumu kwa kujihusisha na siasa za mgawanyiko, sumu, na udanganyifu zinazolenga kuvuruga maendeleo na kukuza hujuma.

English: While Kenya has made remarkable progress in reducing new HIV infections and AIDS-related deaths, we must remain focused on the populations we are leaving behind.
Kiswahili: Wakati Kenya imepata maendeleo ya ajabu katika kupunguza maambukizi mapya ya VVU na vifo vinavyohusiana na UKIMWI, ni lazima tuendelee kuzingatia idadi ya watu tunaowaacha nyuma.
Dholuo: Kata obedo ni piny Kenya osetimo dongruok maduong' ahinya e duoko piny tuoche manyien mag HIV kod tho ma luwore gi tuo mar AIDS, nyaka wabed ka waketo pachwa kuom kwan mar ji ma waweyo bang'wa.
Somali: Iyadoo Kenya ay horumar la taaban karo ka samaysay dhimista caabuqyada cusub ee HIV iyo dhimashada la xiriirta AIDS-ka, waa inaan diiradda saarno dadka aan ka tagayno.

English: Progress is not success until every child, every adolescent, every young person and every vulnerable Kenyan has access to the services they need."
Kiswahili: Maendeleo si mafanikio hadi kila mtoto, kila kijana, kila kijana na kila Mkenya aliye hatarini apate huduma anazohitaji."
Dholuo: Dhi nyime ok en ber nyaka nyathi ka nyathi, ng'ato ka ng'ato ma jahigni apar gi aboro, ng'ato ka ng'ato ma rawera kod ng'ato ka ng'ato ma nigi pek e piny Kenya yudo kony ma gidwaro."
Somali: Horumarku ma aha guul ilaa ilmo kasta, qof kasta oo qaan-gaar ah, qof kasta oo dhallinyaro ah iyo qof kasta oo nugul Kenyan ah ay helaan adeegyada ay u baahan yihiin."

English: "The resilience demonstrated by counties during the funding disruptions proved that Kenya's HIV response is not built on donor support alone, it is anchored in committed healthcare workers, empowered communities, and strong county leadership.
Kiswahili: "Ustahimilivu ulioonyeshwa na kaunti wakati wa kutatizwa kwa ufadhili ulithibitisha kuwa mwitikio wa VVU nchini Kenya hautegemei usaidizi wa wafadhili pekee, unaegemezwa na wafanyikazi wa afya waliojitolea, jamii zilizoimarishwa, na uongozi thabiti wa kaunti.
Dholuo: "Kinda ma ne onyis gi kaunti e kinde ma ne okethore gi pesa nonyiso ni dwoko mar HIV e piny Kenya ok ogere kuom kony mar jochiw kende, ochung'ne jotich mag thieth ma nigi gombo, oganda ma nigi teko, kod telo motegno mar kaunti."
Somali: "Adkeysi ay muujiyeen gobollada intii lagu jiray carqaladaynta maalgelinta waxay caddeeyeen in jawaabta HIV-ga Kenya aysan ku dhisnayn taageerada deeq-bixiyeyaasha oo keliya, waxay ku qotontaa shaqaale daryeel caafimaad oo go'an, bulshooyin awood leh, iyo hoggaan xooggan oo gobolka ah.

English: "The launch of the 47 County Syndemic Operational Plans marks a defining moment in Kenya's health journey.
Kiswahili: "Kuzinduliwa kwa Mipango ya Uendeshaji ya Kaunti 47 inaashiria wakati mahususi katika safari ya afya ya Kenya.
Dholuo: "Chakruok mar chenro mag tich mag 47 mag kaunti nyiso kinde maduong' ahinya e safar mar thieth e piny Kenya.
Somali: "Daah-furka qorshayaasha hawlgelinta ee 47 County Syndemic Syndemic waxay calaamad u tahay waqti qeexan safarka caafimaadka Kenya.

English: These plans move us from commitment to action and place counties firmly at the centre of ending AIDS and other syndemic diseases as public health threats by 2030."
Kiswahili: Mipango hii inatusogeza kutoka kwa kujitolea kwa vitendo na kuweka kaunti katika kitovu cha kukomesha UKIMWI na magonjwa mengine kama matishio ya afya ya umma ifikapo 2030."
Dholuo: Pango gi miyo waweyo bedo gi gombo mar timo gimoro kendo keto kaunti matek e diere mar tieko tuo mar AIDS kod tuoche mamoko ma nyalo kelo luoro ne ngima mar oganda nyaka higa mar 2030."
Somali: Qorshayaashani waxay naga dhaqaajiyeen go'aan qaadashada iyo inay gobolada si adag u dhigaan xudunta soo afjarida AIDS-ka iyo cudurada kale ee halista ah ee caafimaadka bulshada 2030."

Somali: Guddida Caafimaadka Oo Baadhista Xalka Waara ee Kiiniya ee HIV iyo Ka-jawaabista Cudurrada Saamaynta.

English: The National Syndemic Diseases Control Council (NSDCC) is a State Corporation established under Section 3 of the State Corporations Act, Cap 446, through the National AIDS Control Council Order, 1999 as amended by legal notice number 143 of 2022.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Kitaifa la Kudhibiti Magonjwa ya Kuambukiza (NSDCC) ni Shirika la Serikali lililoanzishwa chini ya Kifungu cha 3 cha Sheria ya Mashirika ya Serikali, Sura ya 446, kupitia Agizo la Baraza la Taifa la Kudhibiti UKIMWI, 1999 kama ilivyorekebishwa na notisi ya kisheria nambari 143 ya 2022.
Dholuo: Od bura mar piny mangima mar geng'o tuoche ma landore (NSDCC) en riwruok mar piny ma ochung' e bwo chik mar 3 mar chik mar riwruoge mag piny, Cap 446, kokalo kuom chik mar bura mar piny mangima mar geng'o tuoche mag AIDS, 1999 kaka oloki gi oboke mar chik namba 143 mar higa mar 2022.
Somali: Golaha Qaranka ee Xakamaynta Cudurada Syndemic (NSDCC) waa Hay'ad Dawladeed oo lagu aasaasay Qaybta 3 ee Sharciga Shirkadaha Gobolka, Cap 446, iyada oo loo marayo Amarka Golaha Xakamaynta AIDS-ka Qaranka, 1999 sida lagu beddelay ogaysiis sharci lambar 143 ee 2022.

English: The Council is mandated to manage the following syndemic diseases; HIV, sexually transmitted infections, malaria, leprosy, tuberculosis and lung disease.
Kiswahili: Baraza limepewa jukumu la kusimamia magonjwa yafuatayo; VVU, magonjwa ya zinaa, malaria, ukoma, kifua kikuu na magonjwa ya mapafu.
Dholuo: Kanisa omiye tich mar rito tuoche ma luwogi ma nyalo kelo tuoche mathoth; HIV, tuoche ma omako kokalo kuom nindruok, maleria, tuoche mag lepra, tuoche mag ng'ut kod tuoche mag obo.
Somali: Golaha waxa loo igmaday inuu maareeyo cudurada soo socda; HIV, cudurada galmada lagu kala qaado, duumada, baraska, qaaxada iyo cudurada sambabada.

English: Media plays a crucial role in shaping positive health outcomes, contributing significantly to Kenya's success in combating HIV and AIDS.
Kiswahili: Vyombo vya habari vina jukumu muhimu katika kuunda matokeo chanya ya afya, na kuchangia kwa kiasi kikubwa mafanikio ya Kenya katika kupambana na VVU na UKIMWI.
Dholuo: Oboke mag lando wach nigi tich maduong' ahinya e loso gik mabeyo mag thieth, kendo gikonyo ahinya e loch mar piny Kenya e lweny mar HIV kod AIDS.
Somali: Warbaahintu waxa ay door muhiim ah ka ciyaartaa qaabaynta natiijooyinka caafimaadka togan, iyada oo si weyn uga qayb qaadanaysa guusha Kenya ee la dagaalanka HIV iyo AIDS.

English: Strategic and continuous media engagement has driven structured conversations on these critical issues.
Kiswahili: Ushirikiano wa kimkakati na endelevu wa vyombo vya habari umeendesha mazungumzo yaliyopangwa kuhusu masuala haya muhimu.
Dholuo: Tiyo gi yore mag lando wach kendo ma dhi nyime osemiyo ji bedo gi mbaka ma ochung' motegno e wi weche madongogi.
Somali: Ka-qaybgalka istaraatiijiga ah iyo ka-qaybgalka warbaahinta ee joogtada ah ayaa horseeday wada-hadallo habaysan oo ku saabsan arrimahan muhiimka ah.

English: Interactive forums, featuring diverse panels of experts, are moderated to address audience questions.
Kiswahili: Mijadala shirikishi, inayojumuisha paneli tofauti za wataalam, inasimamiwa ili kushughulikia maswali ya hadhira.
Dholuo: Forum mag tudruok, ma nigi grup mopogore opogore mag jolony, iloso mondo odwoko penjo mag jowinjo.
Somali: Golayaasha is-dhex-galka ah, oo ay ku jiraan khubaro kala duwan, ayaa loo habeeyey si ay wax uga qabtaan su'aalaha dhagaystayaasha.

English: This comprehensive approach aims to maximize outreach, fostering ongoing discussions on HIV prevention, and treatment, as well as addressing issues like sexual and gender-based violence, teen pregnancies, and COVID-19.
Kiswahili: Mbinu hii ya kina inalenga kuongeza uhamasishaji, kukuza mijadala inayoendelea kuhusu uzuiaji wa VVU na matibabu, pamoja na kushughulikia masuala kama vile unyanyasaji wa kingono na kijinsia, mimba za utotoni na COVID-19.
Dholuo: Yo ma opong'o wechego nigi gombo mar medo chopo e piny, loso mbaka ma dhi nyime e wi geng'o tuo mar HIV, kod thieth, kaachiel gi loso weche kaka ng'anjo mar nindruok kod ng'anjo mar ng'ato gi ng'ato, bedo gi ich e kind joma tin, kod COVID-19.
Somali: Habkan dhammaystiran ayaa ujeedadiisu tahay in la kordhiyo wacyigelinta, kobcinta doodaha socda ee ka hortagga HIV, iyo daawaynta, iyo sidoo kale wax ka qabashada arrimaha sida galmada iyo rabshadaha ku salaysan jinsiga, uurka dhallinta, iyo COVID-19.

English: Engaging boys and men in the HIV response and promoting gender equality in Kenya is crucial for sustainable health outcomes and addressing gender disparities.
Kiswahili: Kushirikisha wavulana na wanaume katika mwitikio wa VVU na kukuza usawa wa kijinsia nchini Kenya ni muhimu kwa matokeo endelevu ya afya na kushughulikia tofauti za kijinsia.
Dholuo: Kuong'o nyithindo ma yawuowi kod chwo e dwoko mar HIV kendo keto puonj maromre e kind chwo gi mon e piny Kenya en gima duong' ahinya e yudo duoko maber mag thieth kendo loso pogruok ma nitie e kind chwo gi mon.
Somali: Ka-qaybgalka wiilasha iyo ragga jawaabta HIV-ga iyo horumarinta sinnaanta jinsiga ee Kenya ayaa muhiim u ah natiijooyinka caafimaad ee waara iyo wax ka qabashada farqiga jinsiga.

English: End New HIV infections, Adolescents Pregnancies and Sexual and Gender-Based Violence
Kiswahili: Kukomesha Maambukizi Mapya ya VVU, Mimba za Vijana na Ukatili wa Kijinsia na Kijinsia
Dholuo: Tieko yudo midhiero manyien mag HIV, bedo gi ich e kind joma tin kod tim ng'anjo mag nindruok kod tim ng'anjo
Somali: Jooji caabuqyada cusub ee HIV, Uurka Dhallinta iyo Rabshadaha Galmada iyo Ku Salaysan Jinsiga

English: G-Jali is a comprehensive digital platform aimed at addressing the critical issues of HIV, Sexual and Reproductive Health (SRH), and other emerging health concerns among adolescents and young people in Kenya.
Kiswahili: G-Jali ni jukwaa la kina la kidijitali linalolenga kushughulikia masuala muhimu ya VVU, Afya ya Ngono na Uzazi (SRH), na masuala mengine yanayoibuka ya kiafya miongoni mwa vijana na vijana nchini Kenya.
Dholuo: G-Jali en mbui ma ng'ato nyalo ng'eyogo gik moko duto ma ochung'ne loso weche madongo mag HIV, thieth mar nindruok kod nyuol (SRH), kod weche mamoko ma nyalo kelo pek mag thieth e kind joma tin kod joma tindo e piny Kenya.
Somali: G-Jali waa qalab dhijitaal ah oo dhammaystiran oo loogu talagalay in lagu wajaho arrimaha halista ah ee HIV, Caafimaadka Galmada iyo taranka (SRH), iyo welwelka caafimaad ee kale ee soo ifbaxaya ee dhallinta iyo dhalinyarada Kenya.

English: (Dr.) James Nyikal, MP, visited the National Syndemic Diseases Control Council (NSDCC) for a briefing on Kenya's coordinated response to HIV and other syndemic diseases.
Kiswahili: (Dkt.) James Nyikal, Mbunge, alitembelea Baraza la Kitaifa la Kudhibiti Magonjwa ya Sindemic (NSDCC) kwa muhtasari wa mwitikio ulioratibiwa wa Kenya kwa VVU na magonjwa mengine ya sindemic.
Dholuo: (Dr.) James Nyikal, MP, nodhi e bura mar piny mangima mar rito tuoche ma nyalo landore (NSDCC) mondo oyud puonj kuom kaka piny Kenya ochung' motegno e wi tuoche mag HIV kod tuoche mamoko ma nyalo landore.
Somali: (Dr.) James Nyikal, MP, ayaa booqday Golaha Qaranka ee Xakamaynta Cudurrada Syndemic Diseases (NSDCC) si uu warbixin uga siiyo jawaabta isku dubaridka ah ee Kenya ee HIV iyo cudurrada kale ee syndemic.

English: Within the organisation's national preparedness plan, KRCS has effectively responded to human and animal disease outbreaks including Cholera, Rift Valley Fever, Yellow Fever, and Kala-azar (Leishmaniasis).

English: The country operates a devolved health system across 47 counties, with the national government responsible for health policy and county governments managing service delivery.
Kiswahili: Nchi inaendesha mfumo wa afya uliogatuliwa katika kaunti 47, huku serikali ya kitaifa inayohusika na sera ya afya na serikali za kaunti zikisimamia utoaji wa huduma.

English: Kenya has made significant strides in improving health outcomes over the past two decades, though substantial challenges remain in achieving Universal Health Coverage (UHC) and addressing persistent health inequities between regions and populations.
Kiswahili: Kenya imepiga hatua kubwa katika kuboresha matokeo ya afya katika miongo miwili iliyopita, ingawa changamoto kubwa zimesalia katika kufikia Huduma ya Afya kwa Wote (UHC) na kushughulikia ukosefu wa usawa wa afya kati ya mikoa na idadi ya watu.
Dholuo: Kenya osetimo dongruok maduong' e bero gik ma kelo thieth kuom higni piero ariyo mosekalo, kata obedo ni pod nitie pek madongo e yudo thieth mar piny mangima (UHC) kod loso gik ma ok owinjore e kind kuonde kod oganda.
Somali: Kenya waxay samaysay horumarro la taaban karo oo ku aaddan hagaajinta natiijooyinka caafimaadka labaatankii sano ee la soo dhaafay, in kasta oo caqabado la taaban karo ay weli ku jiraan gaaritaanka Caymiska Caafimaadka Caalamiga ah (UHC) iyo wax ka qabashada sinnaan-la'aanta caafimaad ee joogtada ah ee u dhexeysa gobollada iyo dadka.

English: WHO Kenya works through three strategic clusters; (1) Health Promotion, Disease Prevention and Control, (2) Health Emergencies, and (3) Health Systems and Services, to support the Government of Kenya in building resilient health systems and advancing toward UHC.
Kiswahili: WHO Kenya inafanya kazi kupitia makundi matatu ya kimkakati; (1) Ukuzaji wa Afya, Kuzuia na Kudhibiti Magonjwa, (2) Dharura za Kiafya, na (3) Mifumo na Huduma za Afya, ili kusaidia Serikali ya Kenya katika kujenga mifumo thabiti ya afya na kusonga mbele kuelekea UHC.
Dholuo: WHO Kenya tiyo kokalo kuom grup adek ma nigi chenro; (1) Keto chenro mag thieth, geng'o kod geng'o tuoche, (2) Gik ma kelo pek mag thieth, kod (3) Sistem mag thieth kod tich, mondo okony Sirkal mar Kenya e gero chenro mag thieth ma nyalo geng'o kendo dhi nyime e UHC.
Somali: WHO Kenya waxay ka shaqeysaa saddex kooxood oo istiraatijiyadeed; (1) Horumarinta Caafimaadka, Ka Hortagga iyo Xakamaynta Cudurrada, (2) Xaaladaha Degdegga ah ee Caafimaadka, iyo (3) Nidaamyada iyo Adeegyada Caafimaadka, si ay u taageeraan dawladda Kenya si ay u dhisto nidaamyo caafimaad oo adkeysi leh iyo u sii socoshada UHC.

English: Kenya's Ministry of Health and the World Health Organization (WHO) handed over 108 electric obstetric theatre beds and a package of women's cancer screening and management equipment at Kenyatta National Hospital on 9 June 2026, in a move intended to strengthen the country's capacity to manage obstetric emergencies and expand access to cervical and breast cancer services.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya ya Kenya na Shirika la Afya Duniani (WHO) zilikabidhi vitanda 108 vya maonyesho ya uzazi na kifurushi cha vifaa vya uchunguzi na udhibiti wa saratani ya wanawake katika Hospitali ya Kitaifa ya Kenyatta tarehe 9 Juni 2026, katika hatua iliyokusudiwa kuimarisha uwezo wa nchi wa kudhibiti dharura za uzazi na kupanua ufikiaji wa huduma za saratani ya mlango wa kizazi na matiti.
Dholuo: Od thieth mar piny Kenya kod Riwruok mar Thieth mar Pinyruoth (WHO) nomiyo otanda 108 mag ot mar nyuol kod gik ma itiyogo e ng'iyo kendo rito tuo mar kansa mar mon e Od thieth maduong' mar Kenyatta tarik 9 dwe mar auchiel higa mar 2026, e chenro ma ne ochung'ne jiwo nyalo mar pinyno mar nyuol kendo rito tuoche mag kansa. tich mar thieth mar kansa.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Kenya iyo Hay’adda Caafimaadka Adduunka (WHO) ayaa 9-kii Juun 2026 ku wareejiyay 108 sariirood oo koronto ah oo lagu daweeyo dhalmada iyo dhallaanka iyo xirmo qalabka lagu baaro kansarka haweenka oo lagu qabtay Isbitaalka Qaranka ee Kenyatta National Hospital 9-kii Juun 2026, tallaabadaas oo loogu talagalay in lagu xoojiyo awoodda dalka ee lagu maareeyo xaaladaha degdegga ah ee dhalmada iyo ballaarinta helitaanka adeegyada kansarka ilmo-galeenka iyo naasaha.

English: In Lolmolong village, in Samburu County in northern Kenya, Neshoo Leaungokiok laboured through the night, far from the nearest health facility.

English: In this remote part of Kenya, long distances, difficult terrain and insecurity continue to limit access to skilled care during childbirth, placing mothers and newborns at significant risk.

English: It was the case with the shipment of cargo from World Health Organization (WHO)'s Emergency Preparedness and Response hub in Nairobi, Kenya, on 20 May 2026.

English: Countries in the African region faced more than 140 health emergencies in 2025, ranging from infectious disease outbreaks to climate-related shocks and humanitarian crises.
Kiswahili: Nchi za kanda ya Afrika zilikabiliwa na zaidi ya dharura 140 za kiafya mwaka 2025, kuanzia milipuko ya magonjwa ya kuambukiza hadi mishtuko inayohusiana na hali ya hewa na majanga ya kibinadamu.
Dholuo: Pinje mantie e alwora mar Afrika ne oromo gi masira mag thieth mokalo 140 e higa mar 2025, chakre e tuoche ma nyalo mako ng'ato nyaka e masira ma luwore gi yamo kod masira mag dhano.

English: World Health Organization (WHO)'s regional Emergency Preparedness and Response Hub in Nairobi, Kenya, plays a critical role in preparing for and responding to these health emergencies, providing operational support and logistics, storing and distributing medical supplies and equipment, and facilitating rapid response.
Kiswahili: Kitovu cha Maandalizi na Majibu ya Dharura cha Shirika la Afya Ulimwenguni (WHO) kikanda Nairobi, Kenya, kina jukumu muhimu katika kujiandaa na kukabiliana na dharura hizi za afya, kutoa usaidizi wa uendeshaji na vifaa, kuhifadhi na kusambaza vifaa vya matibabu na vifaa, na kuwezesha mwitikio wa haraka.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar Pinyruoth mar Thieth (WHO) mar Kambi mar Ikruok kod Duoko Masira ma Nairobi, Kenya, nigi tich maduong' ahinya e ikruok kod duoko mapiyo mag thieth gi, chiwo kony mar tich kod loso gikmoko, kano kod chiwo mwandu mag thieth kod gige thieth, kod konyo dwoko mapiyo.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka Adduunka (WHO) xarunteeda u diyaar garowga iyo u diyaar garowga xaaladaha degdega ah ee gobolka ee Nairobi, Kenya, ayaa door muhiim ah ka ciyaarta u diyaargarowga iyo ka jawaabista xaaladaha degdegga ah ee caafimaadka, bixinta taageero hawleed iyo saadka, kaydinta iyo qaybinta sahayda iyo qalabka caafimaadka, iyo fududaynta jawaab celinta degdega ah.

English: Strengthening clinical care for high-consequence infectious diseases in East Africa
Kiswahili: Kuimarisha utunzaji wa kimatibabu kwa magonjwa ya kuambukiza yenye matokeo ya juu katika Afrika Mashariki

Somali: Xoojinta daryeelka bukaan-socodka ee cawaaqib xumada ka dhalan karta cudurrada faafa ee Bariga Afrika

English: Nairobi - Following successive Ebola and Marburg outbreaks across East Africa, countries are shifting how preparedness is defined, placing greater emphasis on the quality of clinical care delivered to patients.
Kiswahili: Nairobi - Kufuatia milipuko mfululizo ya Ebola na Marburg kote Afrika Mashariki, nchi zinabadilisha jinsi utayari unavyofafanuliwa, na kutilia mkazo zaidi ubora wa huduma za kimatibabu zinazotolewa kwa wagonjwa.
Dholuo: Nairobi - Bang' tuoche mag Ebola kod Marburg ma ne opong'o piny Afrika ma Wuokchieng' duto, pinje moko loko kaka inyalo ng'e ni ng'ato oikruok, kendo giketo geno maduong' ahinya e ng'ado bura maber ma imiyo jotuwo.
Somali: Nayroobi – Ka dib markii uu si isdaba joog ah uga dillaacay Ebola iyo Marburg guud ahaan Bariga Afrika, dalalku waxa ay isbeddelayaan sida diyaargarowga loo qeexo, iyaga oo xoogga saaraya tayada daryeelka caafimaad ee la siiyo bukaannada.

English: The World Health Organization (WHO) and Aga Khan University-Kenya (AKU) today launched a new partnership to accelerate the fight against breast and cervical cancer, the two leading cancers claiming women's lives in Africa.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Afya Duniani (WHO) na Chuo Kikuu cha Aga Khan-Kenya (AKU) leo wamezindua ushirikiano mpya ili kuharakisha vita dhidi ya saratani ya matiti na mlango wa kizazi, saratani mbili zinazoongoza kwa kupoteza maisha ya wanawake barani Afrika.
Dholuo: Riwruok mar piny mangima mar thieth (WHO) kod Aga Khan University-Kenya (AKU) kawuono ochako riwruok manyien mar keto lweny mapiyo mar kedo kod kansa mar thuno kod kansa mar thuno, ma gin kansa ariyo madongo ma kawo ngima mag mon e Afrika.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka Adduunka (WHO) iyo Jaamacadda Aga Khan-Kenya (AKU) ayaa maanta bilaabay iskaashi cusub oo lagu dardargelinayo la dagaallanka kansarka naasaha iyo ilmo-galeenka, oo ah labada kansar ee horseeda dhimashada haweenka Afrika.

Dholuo: Riwruok mar Pinyruoth mar Thieth (WHO) oikre mar bedo gi tich maduong' e chokruok mabiro mar piny mangima mar thieth mar piny mangima (WHS) e higa mar 2026 ma biro bedo e piny Kenya.
Somali: Ururka Caafimaadka Adduunka (WHO) wuxuu diyaar u yahay inuu si mug leh uga qayb galo Shir-madaxeedka Caafimaadka Adduunka (WHS) ee soo socda ee Shirka 2026 ee Nairobi, Kenya.

English: For the first time at either a global or regional level, WHO is co-organizing a meeting with the World Health Summit.
Kiswahili: Kwa mara ya kwanza katika ngazi ya kimataifa au ya kikanda, WHO inaandaa mkutano na Mkutano wa Kilele wa Afya Duniani.
Dholuo: En e okang' mokwongo e rang'iny mar piny mangima kata mar ng'om, WHO loso romo gi riwruok maduong' mar piny mangima mar weche thieth.
Somali: Markii ugu horeysay heer caalami ama heer gobol, WHO waxa ay wada qabanqaabinaysaa kulan ay la yeelanayso Shirka Caafimaadka Adduunka.

English: This initiative has been spearheaded by WHO in the African region and is the result of an innovative partnership with WHS and Aga Khan University, Kenya.
Kiswahili: Mpango huu umeongozwa na WHO katika kanda ya Afrika na ni matokeo ya ushirikiano wa kibunifu na WHS na Chuo Kikuu cha Aga Khan, Kenya.
Dholuo: Chenro ni osetelne gi WHO e ong'om mag Afrika kendo en duoko mar riwruok manyien gi WHS kod Yunivasiti mar Aga Khan, Kenya.
Somali: Qorshahan waxaa hormuud ka ahaa WHO gobolka Afrika waana natiijada ka dhalatay iskaashi hal abuur leh oo ay la yeesheen WHS iyo Jaamacadda Aga Khan, Kenya.
